Beef Bulgogi.item_story_marketing:
An eminent icon of Korean cuisine, bulgogi’s origins date back over two thousand years ago to the Goguryeo period, where it was especially popular among the noble classes. Luckily, nowadays, you don’t need a particular pedigree to enjoy the savory, texturally tantalizing qualities of bulgogi—in fact, all you need to do is head to your Trader Joe’s freezer section. That’s where you’ll find Trader Joe’s Beef Bulgogi, which our supplier makes with super thinly-sliced beef that’s been marinated in a traditional blend of soy sauce, mirin, and sesame oil, along with onion, garlic, and apple, pear, and pineapple juices.

After a matter of minutes in the microwave, or a touch longer on the stovetop, our Beef Bulgogi is aromatic and umami-rich, with a complex blend of sweet and savory in every tender, toothsome bite. It makes a remarkably easy center-of-the-plate protein option for dinner, especially when served atop a bed of fluffy white rice. Try it alongside a refreshing green salad, some roasted Baby Broccoli, or one of our many Korean and Korean-inspired appetizers and sides, like our Japchae, Tteok Bok Ki, or Kimchi.

Toaster Waffles.item_story_marketing:
Our freezers have long been a destination for waffle lovers, but until now, there’s been a notable gap: a truly plain waffle that plays well with everything. Trader Joe’s Toaster Waffles step neatly into that space. Made in Belgium (where they know a thing or two about waffles), these Waffles are built for the Toaster first and foremost; while classic Belgian waffles are thick with deep pockets, these are thinner, with shallow pockets. Crafted with whole eggs, wheat flour, and oat flour, they deliver a tender, satisfying bite and a subtle sweetness that works equally well with sweet or savory toppings.

Designed to go straight from freezer to toaster (or oven, or air fryer...), these Waffles crisp up quickly and evenly, emerging golden on the outside and tender on the inside. Keep things classic with butter and syrup, layer on fruit and yogurt, or take a savory turn with mashed avocado and a fried egg. Whether you’re craving breakfast, dessert, or anything in between, they’re a simple, sturdy staple you’ll be happy to have on hand. They’re also an incredible value, especially compared to the leading brand on the market. Not only are TJ’s Toaster Waffles tastier, they offer more protein per serving and feature a far less lengthy ingredients list— which is to say, much of their value lies in what they don’t have. (Like artifical food dyes, for example—we’ll never waffle on that one.) In a Waffle-on-waffle competition, the odds are stacked in our favor.

Spicy Cheese Crunchies.item_story_marketing:
Blazing back to our shelves after an extended absence, Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheese Crunchies have officially returned—and we couldn’t be more fired up. In case you didn’t have the chance to try them the first time around, now’s a great time to get in on the fiery hot fun. They’re made with a base of crunchy, craggy corn, flavored with a savory mix of seasonings that includes Cheddar Cheese powder, garlic powder, and chili pepper, while their signature red-hot hue is achieved thanks to a blend of paprika, vegetable juice, and turmeric. What better way could there be to bring the heat to your next potluck, tailgate, or picnic?

We enjoy munching on these gluten free Crunchies by the bowlful while watching a movie, lazing on a weekend afternoon, or sipping on something nice and chilled to balance out the burn. They make a great, Spicy little side for a hot dog, hamburger, or taco, and when crumbled up fine, they make an able ingredient for breaded chicken tenders, elote, or phenomenally full-flavored macaroni and cheese. We’ve even known a few folks who are partial to sprinkling crushed Spicy Cheese Crunchies over ice cream. Join us in welcoming Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheese Crunchies back by grabbing a bag today!

Marshmallow Eggs.item_story_marketing:
Current climatic conditions leaving you longing for sunnier skies? Consider the arrival of Trader Joe’s Marshmallow Eggs a sweetly timed signifier that spring is on its way! Of course, even the most transcendent Trader Joe’s treats cannot hasten the passage of time (lest you confuse our mild case of cabin fever with delusions of grandeur)... but they sure can brighten your day. From their fantastically fluffy, awesomely airy texture, to their sweet (but not too sweet!) flavor and colorful, Easter-basket-ready appearance, there’s nothing not to love about these wonderfully whimsical Eggs.

At first glance, TJ’s Marshmallow Eggs look a lot like other brightly colored, often anthropomorphized sugar- dusted marshmallows on the market. But turn the package over, and you’ll see that the similarities end well before the first bite. Our Marshmallow Eggs are hatched, er, made without the use of corn syrup or gelatin, yet they’re still playfully pillowy and sumptuously soft. They’re coated in colorful, fine-grain sugar, yet their pink, purple, green, and golden hues come from vegetable juice, spirulina extract, and turmeric, not artificial dyes. See? They really do fly a flock above the rest... which makes them an Eggs-cellent choice for tucking into Easter baskets, slipping into school lunches, serving at spring soirées, topping cakes & cupcakes, and more.

Korean Bugak Sticky Rice and Seaweed Cri.item_title: Korean Bugak Sticky Rice and Seaweed Crisps
Korean Bugak Sticky Rice and Seaweed Cri.item_story_marketing:
Like many traditional dishes from the Korean culinary oeuvre, bugak (a savory treat made with dried seaweed or various veggies coated with glutinous rice, then deep-fried) originated as a form of temple cuisine. Typically served as a kind of banchan, or appetizer, bugak was likely invented by vegeterian Buddhist monks as a way to extend the shelf life of fresh seaweed and vegetables long into the winter months. Centuries later, this tasty snack has become a pillar of Korean cuisine, enjoyed across the world—and it’s a snack you can now add to your TJ’s shopping list, in the form of Trader Joe’s Korean Bugak Sticky Rice and Seaweed Crisps.

They’re made for us by a supplier in the Republic of Korea, who dries discs of combined Seaweed and Sticky Rice for a whopping fifteen hours to ensure a light and well-puffed consistency once cooked. Then, they fry them to a satisfyingly crisp texture, before seasoning them with sesame seeds, sugar, sea salt, onion powder, and kelp powder. It all results in an alluringly umami-rich and crunchy eating experience that still makes a great bit of banchan for a bowl of Organic Silken Tofu soup, a fantastic base for a spicy tuna or salmon hors d’oeuvre, as well as an excellent anytime snack.

Jambalaya.item_story_marketing:
It’s always a delight when a dish has a name that perfectly captures its character, and jambalaya is most certainly one of those dishes. Even beyond its inherent musicality (it’s as fun to say as it is to eat), the term jamabalaya is largely thought to be derived from the Provençal word “jambalaia,” meaning “jumble” or “mish-mash,” referring to the mix of ingredients used in its preparation. And wouldn’t you know it, jambalaya is itself a culinary jumble, an ebulliently eclectic mix of West African, Spanish, and French influences—much like the city of New Orleans itself! You can taste each of these influences in every forkful of Trader Joe’s Jambalaya, our easy-to-prep version of this iconic (and aptly-named) Louisiana treat.

Our Jambalaya starts with a base of captivatingly aromatic, savory-seasoned, long-grained white rice, along with diced onion, tomato, green bell pepper, and green onion, and finishes with slices of spicy, smoky, uncured Andouille sausage. It takes only a few minutes on the stovetop or in the microwave to become steamy, satisfying, and ready to serve as an entrée or side dish. We recommend enjoying this Jambalaya alongside a leafy green salad or crisp Haricots Verts, or topped with a similarly NOLA-inspired protein, like barbecued shrimp or blackened Chicken Breast.

Greek Style Chicken Salad.item_story_marketing:
Like a collection of greatest hits from the Mediterranean gastronomic canon, Trader Joe’s Greek Style Chicken Salad is packed with tender artichoke hearts, tangy sundried tomatoes, and briny Kalamata olives, all set against a backdrop of savory-seasoned, roasted and pulled white Chicken meat. To finish each batch, our supplier also adds bits of garlic, parsley, and dill, then mixes it all together with mayo and lemon juice for a Chicken Salad that’s zesty, tart, herby, toothsome, hearty, and phenomenally full-flavored, all at once. And as if that weren’t enough, its also ready to enjoy as an entrée, topping, sandwich filling, or snack, right out of the package.

Available in our refrigerators every day, Trader Joe’s Greek Style Chicken Salad makes a lovely lunch option when scooped into lettuce cups, spread onto a Pretzel Bun or croissant, or even simply eaten on its own with a fork. It makes it an especially smart choice to use as a topper for salad greens or a sliced tomato, and as an appetizer, it serves splendidly with crackers, crudités, and bits of Pita or Lavash.

Freeze Dried Apricots.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Apricots are Turkish Apricots, harvested at peak ripeness, cut into slices, and Freeze Dried. Nothing else is added to this single-ingredient snack. Inside the bag, you’ll find lots of non- uniform shapes, all of them bite-sized, all of them crunchy & light. Each bite delivers fruity Apricot flavor, along with a healthy measure of tartness, puncuated by sweetness that varies from piece to piece.

Munch them straight from the bag for heightened crunch value, or for a more laid-back approach, let them dissolve on your tongue for a few seconds as you meditate on the flavor. Enjoy their tangy, crunchy character atop sweet, creamy ice cream or yogurt; mix them into a bowl of hot or cold cereal; add them to homemade muffins or pancakes; toss them with your favorite TJ’s trail mix...

You’ll find 1.4-ounce, resealable pouches of Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Apricots in our nuts & dried-fruit section for a limited time. They’ll be available February through June to top your list of dried-fruit favorites!

Chicken Breast Bites.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken Breast Bites take grab-n-go to the next level! These Fully Cooked Bites of boneless Chicken Breast are not frozen, so they don’t require any heating at all. They’re unfussily Seasoned with garlic powder, salt, and pepper, then Cooked until tender and tasty—allowing you to enjoy them right out of the package, wherever your day takes you! Our reserved seasoning approach makes way for the flavorful Dipping Sauce—a complementary condiment that blends Honey, Mustard, white wine, and savory spices, including coriander and cumin.

Use the included bamboo skewer utensil to spear each juicy piece, dip it in the sweet-savory-tangy Sauce, and pop it in your mouth. It’ll be a welcome break from your regular sandwich or leftovers lunch routine. Boasting fewer calories per package than a typical energy bar, these Chicken Bites still promise 22 grams of protein to help power your afternoon tasks. If you have a heartier appetite, it’s super easy to pair these Bites with your favorite TJ’s salad, perhaps a Classic Greek, or Chickpea, Kale and Crispy Red Rice Salad. If it’s a hot lunch you want (and you’re not on-the-go), simply heat your TJ’s Chicken Breast Bites on a microwave-safe plate for about 30 seconds. Delicious!

Breakfast Bowl.item_story_marketing:
We know mornings can be a scramble, and with that comes a culinary conundrum—a real breakfast bind, if you will: Do you risk tardiness to enjoy a truly tasty, made-from-scratch meal? Or, do you let the need for speed sideline your satisfaction? We say, neither—grab one of our brand-new Breakfast Bowls instead! With a Trader Joe’s Breakfast Bowl, time and taste are on your side... 

This savory, best-ever Breakfast Bowl offers a classic combination of fluffy scrambled eggs, tender roasted potatoes, melty Cheddar cheese, crumbled pork sausage and uncured bacon pieces We took our time developing this Bowl, tasting and testing until we got the balance of ingredients juuust right (a delicious errand, indeed). We even opted to add a creamy Cheddar-based cheese sauce to the recipe; it ties the various components together nicely, and prevents them from drying out when you heat the Bowl in the microwave. Speaking of which, since the Bowl comes fully cooked, you can take it from freezer to table in mere minutes—2-3 minutes in the microwave, plus 30 seconds to stand, and perhaps a few more for it to cool to your comfort level. Grab a fork and get ready: this Breakfast will Bowl you over at first bite!

Thai Style Yellow Curry Flavored Potato.item_title: Thai Style Yellow Curry Flavored Potato Chips
Thai Style Yellow Curry Flavored Potato.item_story_marketing:
The bold Curry flavor of Trader Joe’s Thai Style Yellow Curry Flavored Potato Chips will curry favor with anyone who loves a savory, aromatic, spice-forward snack. Just like authentic Thai Yellow Curry, these golden-hued Chips convey the mild heat of chili pepper, with the subtle tang of lime, plus a hint of brown-sugar—along with garlic, onion, and a host of other spices. All of this is delivered with the crisp crunch of thin, classic-cut Potato Chips.

Enjoy these flavorful Chips straight out of the bag—or out of a bowl, if that’s how you take your Curry! And if you’re feeling curry-ative, crumble some atop an omelet, or perhaps over a bowl of Thai Style Red Curry Soup. Though delicate, these Chips can also carry dip, as long as it isn’t too dense. If you’re looking for extra heat, try dunking them in Zhoug. For a cooler, creamier condiment, try a dip in TJ’s Tzatziki. You’ll find six-ounce bags of Trader Joe’s Thai Style Yellow Curry Flavored Potato Chips on our shelves February through April.

Sweet Onion Style Pretzel Twists.item_story_marketing:
There's something beautiful to us about the dialectical quandry presented by the pretzel. On one end of the pretzel spectrum, you have the big, soft, freshly baked form. On the other, the tiny, crisp and crunchy twist form. While both are undeniably pretzels, they couldn't be more different. Yet in their differences, they somehow embody the ideal of their forms—soft pretzels are superlatively soft, while Trader Joe's Sweet Onion Style Pretzel Twists, for instance, are consummately crisp and crunchy. And in the case of the latter, our supplier has also flavored these totally tasty Twists with an alluringly aromatic and umami-tinged Sweet Onion Style seasoning to accentuate the satisfying snap in their texture even further.

Speaking of ideals, we find that our Sweet Onion Style Pretzel Twists make optimal accessories to sandwiches, burgers, and, of course, a frosty glass of beer, where their Sweet, salty, and allium-rich notes will truly sing. They can be enjoyed entirely on their own, as an anytime treat, and can also be dunked most deliciously into all sorts of savory, creamy dips—our frozen Spinach & Artichoke Dip or Pimento Cheese Dip make a particualrly excellent pairing.

Spicy Spuds.item_story_marketing:
It’s true that Trader Joe’s Spicy Spuds are about as exciting as a side dish can get. It’s true that they’re made with creamy-textured potatoes, which are conveniently cut into bite-sized chunks, then seasoned with a complex, capsaicin-rich blend of spices including cayenne pepper, Parmesan cheese, lime juice, and smoked paprika. And it’s equally true that they’re a cinch to cook from frozen, and crisp up wonderfully no matter if they’re sautéed in a skillet, roasted in an oven, or popped into an air fryer. But did you know that they’re also remarkably versatile beyond their uses as a side? Truly, they are!

For example, while our Spicy Spuds will stun when served next to practically any entrée, be it a plate of chilaquiles at breakfast, a pan-fried patty melt at lunch, or a fillet of Miso Marinated Cod at dinner, they’ll also wow when used as an ingredient in a homemade breakfast hash, a hearty burrito, or an easy, cheesy casserole. And if you’re already prepping something with a kick of heat, like a seafood boil, buffalo wings, or chili, these Spicy Spuds’ savory, zesty, and slightly smoky flavor profile will be just the thing to make that meal feel complete.

Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kern.item_title: Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kernels
Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kern.item_story_marketing:
Direct from the “why hadn’t we thought of that before?” department and right into our candy section come Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kernels! Made for us by an esteemed Colombian chocolatier, these sweet, savory, oh-so-satisfyingly Crunchy morsels of roasty, toasty Corn smothered in rich Dark Chocolate represent a snacking synthesis that we’re utterly excited to explore. Too often solely relegated to the realm of road-trip or sports-spectation snacking, the lightly salty edge and crisp texture of a Crunchy Corn Kernel makes a surprisingly intuitive foil to the subtly fruity and floral undertones of Colombian Dark Chocolate, forging ahead on a fun, flavorful, confectionary frontier.

Ideal for practically any situation that calls for sweet snacking, we can’t wait for you to enjoy these Dark Chocolate Covered Crunchy Corn Kernels while enjoying a board game with friends, reading a book on a lazy weekend, bingewatching the latest streaming sensation, or even simply munching by the handful whenever the mood suits you. And for those who’d like to experiment even further on the sweet-savory spectrum, we recommend sprinkling a few Kernels over a bowl of French Vanilla Ice Cream along with some flaky sea salt.

Toasted Coconut Mini Sheet Cake.item_story_marketing:
What does Trader Joe’s Toasted Coconut Mini Sheet Cake have that the other eight Trader Joe's Mini Sheet Cakes don’t? Clearly, it’s Coconut, and you get the wonderful essence of that giant tropical palm seed in a couple innovative ways. First, instead of buttermilk alone, the Cake recipe calls for Coconut milk. Coconut milk’s high fat content curbs gluten formation, helping to create a creamy, tender texture in the crumb, while also contributing a light, Coconut flavor. Second, Toasted Coconut flakes are incorporated throughout. These tender bits add a lovely textural component to both the moist cake and the rich, cream-cheese frosting—not to mention the hint of caramelized nuttiness they bring to the overall flavor.

Treat yourself to a slice of this Mini Sheet Cake as the sweet finish to your bowl of Thai Green Curry. If you’re just having dessert, top the Cake with fresh slices of banana and pineapple, and serve with a scoop of Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert, or a seasonal TJ’s Sorbet, such as Calamansi Mango, or Super Strawberry. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Toasted Coconut Mini Sheet Cake on our bakery shelves, February through April!

Blonde Bar.item_story_marketing:
Let’s take a moment to appreciate the sheer range of chocolate, shall we? Beyond the classic milk and dark chocolates (which already present an extraordinarily wide variety of expressions between them), there’s a whole world of fantastically flavored white chocolate out there, too. By making use of the creaminess of cocoa butter as a base, chocolatiers the world over have been able to explore flavor profiles ranging from mild and mellow to big and bold. One such example of such wizardry is Trader Joe’s Blonde Bar. It’s made for us by a third-generation, bean-to-bar confectioner in Italy, who flavors their white chocolate with rich, lightly salty caramel to achieve its beautifully Blonde hue, and mixes in bits of crumbled-up sugar cookies to provide pleasant pops of crispiness as you eat.

Our panel tasted through twenty-five iterations before agreeing on the final version of Trader Joe’s Blonde Bar, because we knew we needed to get it just right. With one taste, we know that you’ll agree that it was well worth it. Each and every bite is creamy, sweet, and silky-textured, with nice little bits of cookie to engage the palate throughout. It can be enjoyed, by the square, entirely on its own, it can serve as the star of a wine-and-chocolate tasting, and it truly excels when paired with a bold-flavored coffee drink or creamy milk tea.

Marinated Fresh \r\nMozzarella Cheese.item_story_marketing: Ah, Mozzarella, those savory southern Italian spheres. They make pizza pizza, they make a Caprese salad more than just tomatoes and basil. They’re unmistakable, and undeniably delicious…so could anything make these gorgeous globes better? How about an olive-oil-based Marinade flavored with herbs and spices? We couldn’t agree more! Which is how we ended up with Trader Joe’s Marinated Fresh Mozzarella. It pairs delicate ciliegini (Italian for “small cherries” denoting the size of each Mozzarella ball) with an elegantly seasoned oil. This item is a true two-in-one purchase. Not only do you get delicately flavored Mozzarella balls that are ideal for Caprese salads, slicing and serving on a sandwich, or adding to your favorite pasta; you also get a spiced olive oil that is great for drizzling on a green salad, dipping a fresh baguette into, or enhancing a sauce for that aforementioned pasta! Fresh Mozzarella and seasoned olive oil are both delicious on their own, and even better together. Our biggest piece of advice: grab a second tub so you can dip, skewer, serve, and melt without worrying about the road not taken–or rather, the recipe not followed!

Chopped Salad Blend.item_story_marketing:
While its name might seem generic, or even redundant (aren’t all salads chopped, in some manner or another?), the chopped salad has a rather specific history, originating in Beverly Hills during the Golden Age of Hollywood. It’s said that its inventor, conscious of the finery worn by the stars that frequented his restaurant, first served a salad where every ingredient had been chopped into bite-sized pieces as a way to minimize mess. In the decades since, the chopped salad has retained a certain sense of elegance, maintaining a presence on trendy bistro menus the world over. For our part, we’re happy to add a bit of convenience to its long legacy via the introduction of Trader Joe’s Chopped Salad Blend to our produce section. 

Made with a mix of finely chopped bits of peppery escarole, earthy endive, crunchy red cabbage, lightly spicy radicchio, and slightly sweet carrot, this expertly balanced Blend works wonderfully as a base for an easy side salad on any given weeknight. Simply toss with your favorite dressing (like our Organic Italian) and toppings (like our Rosemary Croissant Croutons), and you’re all set. And if you want to make a meal out of that salad, just add your favorite protein to the proceedings—we’re particularly fond of featuring Organic Garbanzo Beans and diced Uncured Applewood Smoked Salami.

Butter Caramel Hard Candies.item_story_marketing:
If someone asked you to close your eyes and think of the most classic, old-fashioned, reliably delicious candy you could, you’d probably end up picturing something like Trader Joe’s Butter Caramel Hard Candies. And if someone then offered one of these Candies to you, you would instantly realize why they’re so classic: starting with their round, rich, and Butter-y flavor, and ending with the elegant way they melt upon the tongue, they’re like an elevated version of a timelessly tasty treat, brought to us by an expert candy supplier in Poland. 

Made in small batches using the time-honored hard-boiling method, these Butter Caramel Hard Candies hit just the right balance of sweetness and creaminess on the palate, with just a touch of salt to bring the whole flavor profile into focus. They’re great for snacking on while on the go, packing into a work or school lunch for an after-meal sweet treat, or keeping in your purse or briefcase (they’re individually wrapped, we ought to mention) for whenever your sweet tooth strikes. This time-honored candy comes with another time-honored Trader Joe’s tradition—a great price!

Patagonian Scallops.item_story_marketing:
Off the coast of Argentina, Patagonian scallops (Zygochlamys patagonica) amass on the floor of the Atlantic Ocean, like little sunken treasures waiting to be discovered. Prized by chefs for their sweet flavor, tender texture, and bite-sized stature, these beloved bivalves are gathered by fishers using a conical net known as an “otter trawl,” which is designed to preserve the integrity of each pint-sized scallop while also reducing bycatch. That’s how our supplier brings in Trader Joe’s Patagonian Scallops, which we particularly prize for their versatility, ease of preparation, and, of course, remarkable value.

Owing to their smaller proportions, these frozen Scallops easily thaw inside the refrigerator or placed in a bag and submerged in cold water, after which they’re ready for all manner of recipes. We especially enjoy getting them super dry with a paper towel, then pan-searing them in a screaming-hot skillet with Ghee until they develop a beautiful, golden crust on both sides. They’re also great for plopping into seafood chowders, serving over pastas, or simply baking with butter, breadcrumbs, and Organic Sicilian Lemon Juice.

Stuffed Peppers.item_story_marketing:
This fridge-to-table entrée from Trader Joe’s is the Stuffed dreams are made of—Stuffed Peppers, that is! The dream becomes reality when you see how easy it is to have a ready-to-eat, hearty meal, after just minutes in the microwave or oven.

The Pepper is a red bell, halved & loaded with seasoned ground beef, long grain & wild rice, and veggies (including spinach, celery, carrots, and shiitake mushrooms). Italian seasonings heighten the flavors, and the whole thing is topped with panko breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese. 

Don’t be surprised if you are Stuffed (pleasantly, so) after eating Trader Joe’s Stuffed Peppers. We think you will be surprised to learn that the whole container (2 servings) is only 400 calories—and that includes 20 grams of protein and 6 grams of fiber!

Organic Sour Apple Cherry Fruit Leather.item_title: Organic Sour Apple Cherry Fruit Leather Wrap
Organic Sour Apple Cherry Fruit Leather.item_story_marketing:
If fruit had personalities, we’d like to think that apples and cherries would be fast friends. They have so much in common, after all! Both come from trees that blossom beautifully in the spring, both are delicious in pastries, pies, and other baked desserts, and both have notable (and well-loved) sour varietals, like Granny Smith and Montmorency. It’s this last bit of potential compatability that inspired Trader Joe’s Organic Sour Apple Cherry Fruit Leather Wraps, the latest addition to our line of fun and flavorful Fruit Leathers. Made with a base of Organic Apple, Cherry, and elderberry juices, which are then dried to a soft, chewy, and satisfying texture, these Wraps represent a harmonious meeting of sweet and Sour that lets the personalites of both featured fruits truly shine.

These tart and tangy Wraps make superb snacks for all sorts of occasions, and we especially like packing them into a school or work lunch as an alternative to candy or cookies. And if you’re looking for a great pick-me-up on a long road trip, plane ride, or even your everyday (seemingly interminable) commute, look no further than these Wraps. Because they’re both so kid-friendly and remarkably reasonable in price, they’re also an easy choice for buying by the handful and distributing out at sports practices and playdates.

For the Love of Chocolate Mousse Cake.item_title: For the Love of Chocolate Mousse Cake
For the Love of Chocolate Mousse Cake.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s For the Love of Chocolate Mousse Cake has a festive appearance that is well-suited for the ‘season of love’ that is upon us. Baked and assembled with love (isn’t it obvious?), this is a rich, chocolatey, layer cake. Two moist layers have been cut into the shape of a heart and enrobed in a dark-brown, cocoa-flavored, confectioners icing. And the top is decorated with a pink cake crumble, lending some vivid playfulness to the presentation.

But the real love is found inside. Sandwiched between the cake layers is a light and airy chocolate mousse, which provides a creamy contrast to the spongy cake and to the smooth, exterior icing. The mousse also bolsters the overall chocolate effect with additional cocoa flavor. For the Love of [insert object of your affections here], we recommend securing one of these Chocolate Mousse Cakes in a timely manner. Give it as a decadent gift to your one-and-only. Or, let it be the perfect finish to a romantic meal for two. In the case that your Valentine may be absent (or perhaps, has never yet been found), we prescribe precisely one of these Cakes as the perfect consolation—for both your heart and for your wallet.

Ice Cube Baby Iceberg Lettuce.item_story_marketing:
Ever heard of a Baby Iceberg? Well, it’s a thing. Only you won’t find it in the Arctic—you’ll find it at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Full disclosure: we’re not talking about a mini-sized, partially submerged block of ice. We’re talking about Baby Iceberg Lettuce, a.k.a. Trader Joe’s Ice Cube Lettuce, a.k.a. the cutest little Lettuce heads you ever did see! They’re cultivated for us in California and Arizona, using a unique seed variety bred to produce purposely petite Iceberg Lettuce. Like chips off the ol’ ice block—or Cubes off the ol’ ’berg, as it were—these shrunken heads possess the same firm crunchiness and mild (although slightly sweeter) flavor as their big-headed cousins. Their wee size isn’t just for show, though—it also helps reduce waste. (Have you ever had to toss the wilted remains of an extra-large lettuce head, simply because you couldn’t eat it all fast enough? Every bit counts, Baby!)

Cut each little Lettuce head in half to make classic-yet-compact wedge salads, or to create snack-sized cups you can fill with TJ’s tuna. Or use it in the myriad ways you’d use larger-leaf lettuce—tossed salads and turkey sandwiches are just the tip(s) of the Iceberg!

Jubilant Sprinkle Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Jubilant Sprinkle Cookies might be small, but we think they call for big-time celebration, confetti and all. Shaped like teeny-tiny ice cream cones, presents, rainbows, and balloons, they taste like birthday cake (yum!), pack a buttery crunch, and feature festive rainbow sprinkles throughout. More reason(s) to celebrate: the birthday cake flavor comes from natural flavors, the buttery crunch is courtesy of butter (go figure), and the sprinkles get their color from turmeric, annatto extract, and fruit & veggie juices!

These cute lil’ Cookies are great for lunchboxes, after-school snacking, and anytime sweet-treat enjoyment. Plus, they were practically made for passing out at birthday parties, whether the guest of honor is turning one or one hundred. And here’s yet another reason to celebrate: we’re selling each 10-ounce resealable bag of Jubilant Sprinkle Cookies for a fraction of what similar sprinkle cookies sell for elsewhere. Let the everyday jubilation begin!

Hot Honey Goat Milk Cheese.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s customers just love our cheese logs made from Goat Milk, and we offer a variety of flavors, not to mention the revolving seasonal options. We’re excited to introduce another flavor, and honey, it’s sure to be the hot new thing: Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Goat Milk Cheese!

Our supplier brings together pasteurized Goat Milk Cheese, Honey, red pepper flakes, and habanero pepper powder to create a combination that definitely hits that Hot-sweet spot—not too sweet, with a spiciness that builds, but plateaus before taking over. Underlying this scrumptious, sweet heat is the cool tang of the Goat Milk, creating a complex flavor profile that is the simplest of pleasures when enjoyed on Pita Bite Crackers. Spread it on toasted slices of Organic Baguette and top with some Bruschetta Sauce for a delicious, savory-sweet appetizer. Or drop dollops of this Cheese on a roasted Organic Butternut Squash to add a touch of tangy, honeyed heat.

You’ll find Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Goat Cheese in our refrigerators for a limited time, January through March. Get it while it’s Hot (and sweet)!

Dill•icious Cream Cheese Spread.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes, when it comes to naming a new product, it can take a few rounds of brainstorming before we settle on something we like. And sometimes, as with this particular product, the name comes to us right away. Because when the cool and tangy flavors and luxuriously lush textures of cream cheese meet with the herby, aromatic excellence of dill, what else can you call it but Trader Joe’s Dillicious Cream Cheese Spread?

This awesomely herbaceous spread was designed expressly with bagels and lox in mind—we find the notes of Dill are particularly suited to bringing out the best in smoked salmon or Steelhead Trout. That said, it also happens to be great when simply enjoyed with crackers or charcuterie, and a mixed-in spoonful will add all kinds of depth to a pan of soft, scrambled eggs. However you choose to enjoy it, you can count on it being dependably Dillicious.

Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Snackers.item_story_marketing:
What is it, exactly, about having a little bit of cheese that brightens one’s day? Don’t get us wrong, we’re also tremendous proponents of having a great deal of cheese. But there’s something so charming—so modern, perhaps—about enjoying just a fragment of fromage that makes it one of life’s unexpected little joys. So it’s only appropriate that we celebrate this fact with Trader Joe’s Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Snackers, a convenient collection of eight, ¾-ounce, amuse-bouche-sized, individually-wrapped medallions of our TJ’s-Hall-of-Fame- honored Unexpected Cheddar.

Celebrated for its sharp, nutty, faintly Parmesan-like flavor, Unexpected Cheddar is a natural choice for savoring in this perfectly portioned, on-the-go format. Snackers are ideal for packing into lunches, serving as afternoon snacks, or simply grabbing out of the fridge whenever the ineffable urge for a little bit of cheese strikes. At 80 calories and five grams of protein each, they’re sound and satisfying—which is also how we’d describe their price. You’ll find Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Snackers in our cheese case of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, all year round.

Spicy Alfredo Fusilloni Pasta.item_story_marketing:
As Korean foods continue to grow in popularity, our buyers continue searching for creative ways to bring those characteristically spicy, sweet, and savory flavors—often with a fermented flair—into more TJ’s products. The latest achievement on this culinary fusion adventure is Trader Joe’s Spicy Alfredo Fusilloni Pasta. Our supplier in Italy starts with Fusilloni (giant fusilli) made of durum wheat semolina that’s cooked to an ideal al dente texture. For the fusion part, they’ve crafted a Spicy Alfredo sauce that mixes traditional cream, grated cheese, and butter with gochujang (fermented red chili paste).

The sauce is frozen into little “pucks” and packed right in with the Fusilloni. All you have to do is heat everything together in the microwave or on the stovetop, and you’ll be rewarded with a mouthwatering melding of flavors—rich, ultra-creamy Alfredo with a spicy, fermented kick in every big-spiral bite. While Italian-Korean culinary fusion is quite unique, the fusion of quality products with unbeatable prices is an everyday occurrence at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Smoked Steelhead Trout.item_story_marketing:
Though quite similar in appearance and taste, steelhead trout and Atlantic salmon actually belong to two totally different genera of fish. And while they tend to be used interchangeably at the dinner table, there are some key differences that go beyond the taxonomical: steelhead trout tends to be leaner, less oily, and milder in flavor, making it a popular choice for those who like their fish to be less “fishy.” We find that steelhead’s more overall delicate profile makes it an apt candidate for serving smoked, which is precisely why we’ve brought Trader Joe’s Smoked Steelhead Trout to our refrigerators.

It’s brought to us by a sustainable fish supplier in Norway, who smokes this firm, yet silky and tender Steelhead Trout in facilities within just a few miles of their fisheries. They then slice it into a thicker cut—reminiscent of sashimi—to accentuate its toothsome texture and subtle smoky notes on the palate. It can be used in any situation that calls for smoked salmon, and particularly excels in applications that let its gentler flavors shine, like over a slice of avocado toast, atop a leafy green salad, or, of course, a crisp and chewy bagel with Whipped Cream Cheese and Capers.

Chicken Sausage Ravioli.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Chicken Sausage Ravioli is made for us by a supplier who uses extra thin sheets of pasta to create the ideal, toothsome texture when cooked al dente. Each Raviolo is filled with a mix of savory seasoned chicken sausage and a blend of ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheeses, so that every bite is rich and full-flavored, to complement said satisfying texture. Together, a package takes only 3-4 minutes of cook time in boiling water before it’s ready to be served, and can be accessorized with your favorite pasta sauce, or even just quickly drizzled with EVOO. Add to that its amazing everyday value, and you’ve got proof that these Chicken Sausage Ravioli are a phenomenon in their own right.

Soft Pretzel Stick.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick is shaped kind of like a short baguette. Despite its lack of a twist, it’s unmistakably pretzel-y; with pillowy insides, and that classic, dark- brown exterior, first innovated by 16th century monks who used a pure form of lye to boost the Maillard reaction. Fancy as this may sound, Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick is really just a yummy, yeasty bun that can be enjoyed in several tasty ways.

Heat up some White Queso Dip, then tear off pieces of the Stick to dunk and enjoy. You could also slice it in half lengthwise, toast it, then spread with Cultured Salted Butter. Or perhaps you’re in the mood for a sandwich, in which case we recommend a healthy spread of Organic Yellow Mustard and several slices of Uncured Pastrami. Of course, you could always just open up the package and take a bite!

Sourdough Bread Sliced.item_story_marketing: Toast sounds simple, and in a way, it is simple. But, when you consider that the source of good toast is really good bread, it suddenly sounds not so simple after all. After testing a wide variety of contenders, we’ve come to the unanimous decision that the very best bread for toast-making is sourdough. And because toast requires slices of bread, our conclusion also included the rationale that sliced sourdough is the most practical sourdough for this particular endeavor. And thus, Trader Joe’s Sourdough Bread Sliced tops our list of “Best Breads for Toast” for this and every year. Our Sourdough Bread is made exclusively for us and will be slightly different depending on where in Trader Joe’s country you pick up your loaf—the flavor of sourdough depends largely on the “starter,” which is a living culture that lends the bread its signature sour profile. Because every starter is different, every bakery produces a slightly different flavor profile. If you visit a Trader Joe’s in Tennessee, your Sliced Sourdough toast will be just a bit different from the sourdough toast you make with the Sourdough you buy in San Francisco. What they all have in common is their excellence—especially when toasted. So, slather on some butter, a bit of jam, or make a PB&J on Sourdough toast. You may even take that toasting to a higher level and make a scrumptious grilled cheese… on Sourdough. Toast away. You’ll be glad you did.

Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth is a flavorful broth that’s made for us from organically raised chickens and organic vegetables like celery, onions, and carrots. We have this Low Sodium Organic version as well as a straight Organic version because some folks like to have the option to add their own salt (or not). It adds terrific flavor to basics like mashed potatoes or rice, and make great bases for sauces, gravies, and all kinds of soups. It's gluten free (believe it or not, some broths have added gluten), and comes with a mere 50mg of sodium per serving. So whether you’re mashing potatoes, boiling rice or making a signature soup creation, you’ll find a helping hand in Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth. No can opener required.

Pizza Bianca.item_story_marketing:
Though its crust is inspired by the airy, raised crust common in Southern Italy, the flavor profile and elegant appearance of Trader Joe’s Pizza Bianca is inspired by one of our product developer’s favorite pies in all of Los Angeles. (Fun fact: there’s a sauceless, focaccia-based pie in Italy also called pizza bianca—this, however, is not that). The dough that forms the base of this Pizza Bianca is allowed to naturally rise for 24 hours before it’s spread with a creamy Parmesan cheese sauce and topped with mozzarella and sharp Parmesan cheeses, onion, and fragrant rosemary, at which point it’s baked in a wood burning oven. Dreamy, indeed.

From there, about 15 minutes in your oven is all it takes to unleash Pizza Bianca’s allium-y allure and rich, savory cheesiness. (Be warned: guests or roommates will roam into the kitchen to investigate the enticing aroma, so prepare to share!) A juxtaposition of understated sophistication and satisfying, savory finger food, Pizza Bianca would be equally at home served alongside an aperitif at a cocktail party, or as the main course enjoyed while hunkered down on the couch during movie night.  

We aren’t here to argue if Pizza Bianca can truly be called pizza without a classic tomato sauce (that conversation is better left to the bots in the comments section), but we’ll confidently assert that you won’t find a better value on frozen pizza of this quality anywhere but your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Onion Flowers.item_story_marketing:
Nearly every one of Shakespeare’s 154 sonnets makes some mention of flowers—roses, most frequently of all. Just imagine, then, how rhapsodic he would have waxed at the sight of Trader Joe’s Onion Flowers! “From sav’ry snackings we desire increase/That these breaded Onions might be air-fried/But appetizers should by time release/At Trader Joe’s, where they can be tried,” he might have said. Of course, since the Bard of Avon sadly never had access to a Trader Joe’s, we’ll simply have to wax for him—as will you, once you try these crispy, crunchy, blossom-cut Onions for yourself.

This classic appetizer is brought to us by a supplier in Thailand, who cuts each Onion into an attractive, flower- like pattern, dunks it in a savory-spiced (and also, as it happens, vegan) batter, and fries it to a golden brown. At home, it takes less than 15 minutes in an air-fryer (or a little longer in a conventional oven) to crisp up beautifully. We recommend serving them as hearty hors d’oeuvres at a game day get-together, cocktail party, or board game night. We also emphatically recommend pairing them with something savory, spicy, and/or creamy to dunk the Onion “petals” into—our (also vegan) Spicy Dynamite Sauce is always an excellent option.

Morning Buns.item_story_marketing:
First created in French American bakeries in the 1970s (though which one exactly remains up for debate), the morning bun is experiencing a resurgence in recent days, and Trader Joe’s Morning Buns live up to the hype. Laminated dough (made through an intense process of rolling, layering with butter, folding, and repeating the steps many times) creates the delicate, flaky crust akin to a croissant. In fact, our Morning Buns are made with the very same dough as our Chocolate Croissants and Almond Croissants. The twenty divine layers of dough are then covered with a cinnamon and brown sugar mix that is accented by vibrant orange zest to awaken your sun-up senses. The dough is finally cut, rolled into Buns, frozen, and packaged, leaving just the proofing and baking to you. 

Before you go to bed, place each frozen Morning Bun on a baking tray in the provided paper cup and let rise at room temperature for 7-9 hours. In the Morning, the Buns will have about doubled in size, ready to bake in the oven a 375°F oven for 14-16 minutes. This “muffin” format makes it so easy to take a fresh-baked Bun with you as you rush out the door. On the other hand, you may find yourself unable to resist the flaky, buttery outsides and tender-as-a-pillow insides for even as long as it takes to get to the car—we heartily endorse enjoying as soon as desired!

Strawberry Strained Thick & Creamy Greek.item_title: Strawberry Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt
Strawberry Strained Thick & Creamy Greek.item_story_marketing: The secret to Trader Joe's Thick & Creamy Strawberry Greek Yogurt is our supplier’s special straining process; the excess whey is carefully removed from the finished Yogurt, resulting in an exceptionally Thick & Creamy texture and a less tangy flavor than our other Greek yogurt offerings. It’s sweetened just so and mixed with a Strawberry fruit base, then pasteurized and cultured, in that order. Like its predecessor, it’s kosher-certified and offers 14 grams of protein in a ¾-cup serving, making it an excellent assist anytime you need to refuel.

Raspberry Muffins.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Raspberry Muffins have a lot going for them. They are loaded with Raspberries, which provide a pop of color, a fruity aroma, and a burst of naturally sweet berry flavor in every bite. Also, the blonde Muffin base that carries these berries is enhanced by one of the hardest working ingredients in the batter biz: sour cream. Since it’s thicker than other dairy options, sour cream can add significant moisture without making the batter too runny. Plus, the natural acid in the sour cream helps tenderize gluten strands, while also reacting with the baking soda to create carbon dioxide bubbles, ultimately resulting in an airier crumb. Muffin science!

Finally, the buttery, crumbly, brown-sugar streusel we put on the Muffin top really takes this bakery treat over the top. Whether you enjoy them while sipping a mug of French Roast Coffee, Matcha Latte, or chilled glass of milk, Trader Joe’s Raspberry Muffins will make your morning, mid-afternoon, or midnight snack more than memorable.

You’ll find 14-ounce containers of four Raspberry Muffins on the bakery shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, through March. And just like that, you have a lot going for you, too!

Cookies 'n Cream Mini Sheet Cake.item_story_marketing:
Combining our favorite aspects of a classic chocolate creme sandwich cookie with the marvelously moist textures of a well-frosted sheet cake, every bite of this synergistic sweet treat brings the best of both worlds to your palate.

Our supplier starts with a classic vanilla cake batter, into which they mix bits of chocolate ceme sandwich cookies right before baking. Once done, they top the cake with a rich and sweet cream cheese frosting and yet more bits of crumbled-up cookie for even more flavor. An especially apt choice for fans of our Chocolate Vanilla Creme Joe-Joe’s, Trader Joe's Cookies n’ Creme Mini Sheet Cake makes an excellent addition to a dessert table at a potluck, a delightful after-dinner treat (espeically when paired with coffee), and an unbeatable anytime indulgence. Purse fork enthusiasts, get ready. Just be sure to pick up a cake will supplies last—they’re only available in our bakery section through the end of winter.

Alfredo Pasta Sauce.item_story_marketing: Alfredo sauce dates back to Italy in the 1920’s, when Alfredo di Lello perfectly merged heavy cream, butter and garlic to create an international sensation. We searched far and wide for an Alfredo sauce that could live up to this reputation and found one with just the right blend of these classic ingredients – Trader Joe’s Alfredo Pasta Sauce. This zesty, creamy Alfredo Sauce is perfect with long-cut pasta like TJ’s Italian Linguine or TJ’s Papardelle, but you can also go with TJ’s Italian Penne Rigate or TJ’s Italian Farfalle. Serve it flanked with TJ’s Just Chicken [sku 43020], TJ’s Medium Cooked Shrimp [sku 01206], and topped with TJ’s Shaved Parmigiano Reggiano. Not in the mood for pasta? TJ’s Alfredo is also as delicious as a sauce for stand-alone seafood or chicken. This full-flavored Alfredo is perfectly delicious as a traditional sauce, but we’re never shy to add some mushrooms, broccoli, or whatever you may be in the mood for. That’s the great thing about it, you can add this or that, or not add anything at all but pasta or chicken, either way your dish will turn out delish!

Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast.item_title: Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast
Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast.item_story_marketing:
When we say we listen to our customers, it’s not just lip service—we truly mean it. Your feedback guides us in our quest to provide the best quality products at incredible prices in our stores, every day. With this in mind, we’re positively tickled to announce the arrival to our shelves of the number one requested item on our customers’ fresh meat wish list: Boneless Chuck Roast is now available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! The key to highlighting the savory flavor and fall-apart texture of this USDA Choice Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast is slow roasting or braising, making it a must-have for cozy season grocery lists.

Impressively sized and budget-friendly to boot, Chuck Roast is ideal for feeding large groups or meal-prepping for a busy week ahead. Combine the Roast with Mirepoix, potatoes, garlic, rosemary, and a splash of Charles Shaw Cab in a slow cooker or pressure cooker for a no-fail pot roast dinner. Slow-roast this hearty protein with Enchilada Sauce and beef broth, then shred the meat for tacos or enchilada filling. Or, make Chuck Roast the star player on a baked potato bar, complete with all the fixings. Yum.

This high-quality Chuck Roast’s largely hands-off prep (Look, Ma—no bones!) will leave you with more time to relax with a good book or board game, while filling your kitchen with mouthwatering aromas. What’s more, its fantastic per-pound price will leave more money in your wallet. You’ll find random-weight packages of Trader Joe’s Boneless Chuck Roast in our refrigerators.

Raspberry Oat Bites.item_story_marketing:
Finding the time to prep a snack for yourself can be quite a challenge nowadays, and especially so in the morning. Between getting ready, getting the kids to school, and getting to work, there’s hardly any room for getting a snack ready. That’s why we love easy, on-the-go options like Trader Joe’s Raspberry Oat Bites. These hearty, gluten-free treats have a dense and toothsome exterior (courtesy of a base of soft-baked, lightly rolled, whole grain Oats—the first listed ingredient, we should mention) and sweet, fruity interior (courtesy of the raspberry filling inside), making them a super satisfying, sweet and savory snack for grabbing on your way out the door, and enjoying whenever the mood to munch strikes.

We recommend enjoying an Oat Bite on your morning commute, as a supplement to a packed lunch, or as a post-work pick-me-up on your way home. A treat for kids and adults alike, they’re also helpful for handing out on playdates, administering as a movie snack, or serving as a delicious distraction during long car rides. And since each box contains six Bites, they’re great for sharing with a group of friends or family while on vacation, or even just a weekend outing.

\"PB&J\" Oat Bites.item_story_marketing:
Finding the time to prep a snack for yourself can be quite a challenge nowadays, and especially so in the morning. Between getting ready, getting the kids to school, and getting to work, there’s hardly any room for getting a snack ready. That’s why we love easy, on-the-go options like Trader Joe’s “PB & J” Oat Bites. These hearty, gluten-free treats have a dense and toothsome exterior (courtesy of lightly salted Peanut Butter and rolled, whole grain Oats—the first listed ingredient, we should mention) and sweet, fruity interior (courtesy of the strawberry filling inside), making them a super satisfying, sweet and savory snack for grabbing on your way out the door, and enjoying whenever the mood to munch strikes.

We recommend enjoying an Oat Bite on your morning commute, as a supplement to a packed lunch, or as a post-work pick-me-up on your way home. A treat for kids and adults alike, they’re also helpful for handing out on playdates, administering as a movie snack, or serving as a delicious distraction during long car rides. And since each box contains six Bites, they’re great for sharing with a group of friends or family while on vacation, or even just a weekend outing.

Dark Chocolate Sticks with Crispy Rice.item_title: Dark Chocolate Sticks with Crispy Rice
Dark Chocolate Sticks with Crispy Rice.item_story_marketing:
Combining the consummate richness of Colombian Chocolate with the captivatingly Crispy crunch of puffed Rice, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Sticks with Crispy Rice are truly triumphant on both a taste and textural level. They’re made especially for us by a bean-to-bar supplier in Colombia, who uses 60% Dark Chocolate so that every bite strikes a balance between approachable sweetness and deep, fruity, almost floral complexity. After they mix this molten Dark Chocolate with airy, Crispy Rice, they pour it into bite-sized, Stick-shaped molds, so that once they cool, they’ve taken on the ideal form for a quick and easy anytime indulgence.

We’re particularly fond of bringing a bag of Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Sticks as a movie snack, pairing a Stick or two with a shot of espresso, or using them to provide some sayifyingly sweet contrast on a charcuterie board or cheese plate. They’re great for sharing with friends and family during a board game night, or accessorizing a dessert plate during a dinner party. We also find that their Stick format makes them an especially apt choice for dunking into something sweet, like ice cream or a ricotta-based dessert dip, or something semi-savory, like a bit of Creamy No Stir Peanut Butter Spread.

Sliced Porridge Bread.item_story_marketing:
What is Porridge Bread, you ask? Most importantly, it’s delicious. Heck, it may be the best thing since sliced bread. (Okay, it is sliced bread, but stay with us.) Inspired by the traditional morning fare of oat porridge with a drizzle of honey, Trader Joe’s Porridge Bread is made exclusively for us with a sourdough starter and a carefully calibrated combination of wheat flour, chewy rolled oats, and rye flour, balanced with the sweetness of honey and brown sugar.

Consider this the just right loaf for sandwiches and slices-on-the-side. (Stumped as to a pairing partner? Check out the tasty selection of soups in our refrigerators!) It’s a swell snack, toasted and topped with a swoosh of Whipped Feta Spread and a drizzle of your favorite TJ’s honey.

Bird's Eye Chile Hot Sauce.item_story_marketing:
Also known as piri-piri or peri-peri (from “pilipili,” the Swahili word for “pepper,”) the African bird’s eye chile is a cultivar of the species Capsicum frutescens that’s primarily known within the culinary world for three things. First, it’s celebrated for its remarkable spice level (with a Scoville rating somewhere between 50,000 and 175,000, it’s just shy of habanero-level heat). Second, it’s adored for its naturally fruity, tangy flavor. And third, when pickled and mashed into a hot sauce, it’s famous for pairing almost unbelievably well with chicken. All three of these elements are certainly accounted for within Trader Joe’s Bird’s Eye Chile Hot Sauce, a delightfully flavorful, capsaicin-rich condiment that’s available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Fiery and fruity, with just enough of an acidic presence from vinegar to provide a bit of balance, our Bird’s Eye Chile Hot Sauce brings a serious spike of spice to anything it’s drizzled over. And while it’s true that it’s as delicious as you’d expect on roast chicken, buffalo wings, or our Organic Chicken Nuggets, it’s equally excellent on tacos, burritos, scrambled eggs, omelets, pizza, clam chowder—we could absolutely go on all day, if you’d let us. Instead, though, we recommend you grab a bottle of Bird’s Eye Chile Hot Sauce from our grocery shelf and spice things up for yourself.

Extra Choice California Apricots.item_story_marketing: The 'Extra Choice' here refers to the fine quality of these Apricots. In contrast to Slabs Apricots, they’re harvested earlier, which means they are less sticky and sweet. They appeal to customers who prefer a firmer and more balanced, sweet-tart taste. They’re also incredibly delicious!

California Slab Apricots.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s California Slab Apricots are harvested late, when the fruit is extremely ripe. The natural sugar content is higher, which makes them very soft, super sweet, and almost gooey in texture. In fact, they end up looking less like defined Apricot halves and more like flat Slabs of dried, pitted fruit. And they are mouthwatering!

Just Mango Slices.item_story_marketing: When we named this product Just Mango Slices we weren’t messing around. Inside the bag you will find Just Mango Slices, and nothing else. Our supplier dries several varieties of mango for us, so depending on what’s most ripe when it’s drying time, you could find slices of Kent, Haden, Keitt, or Ataulfo mangoes inside the bag. Still, that’s all you’ll find. No additives, no preservatives, no colors. Just Mango Slices. Trader Joe’s Just Mango Slices are dried and packed for us by a supplier that’s been in the business of drying tropical fruit for more than 20 years. The fruit is peeled, seeded, and sliced by hand – the slices aren’t uniform in size or shape, but they are loaded with fresh, naturally-sweet mango flavor. Fun fruit fact: it takes five pounds of tree-ripened, fresh mangoes to make each six ounce bag of Trader Joe’s Just Mango Slices.

Cha Siu Bao Steamed Pork Buns.item_title: Cha Siu Bao Steamed Pork Buns
Cha Siu Bao Steamed Pork Buns.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Cha Siu Bao are fluffy, steamed parcels stuffed with Cantonese style barbecue pork (char siu) in a savory-sweet oyster sauce. The dough is light & airy, while the filling is delightfully dense and full of flavor.

Once assembled, these Steamed Seasoned Pork Buns are fully cooked, then flash frozen and packaged so that you can easily heat them at home in the microwave, or in a steamer. Once they’re ready, serve these tasty morsels with TJ’s Hoisin Sauce, Crunchy Chili Onion, or Spicy Dynamite Sauce. And don’t forget to fill your yum cha table with more of our convenient and yummy dim sum options, such as Chicken Shu Mai, Vegetable Spring Rolls, and Pork Soup Dumplings.

Organic Peeled Ginger.item_story_marketing:
The zesty, aromatic, unmistakable flavor of Ginger makes dozens of dishes delicious, from Thai stir-fries to Indian curries. It’s also unmistakably difficult to prep, stemming from its knobby, irregular shape and tight-fitting skin. Having experienced Ginger’s kitchen challenges firsthand, our Produce team developed Trader Joe’s Organic Peeled Ginger as a boon to fresh-Ginger aficionados everywhere!

Our Organic Ginger is grown in Peru—a tropical climate, not unlike Ginger’s native Southeast Asia. It’s harvested and delivered to the U.S., where our supplier fastidiously peels each bulb, so you don’t have to. Four-ounce portions of whole, Peeled Ginger are then vacuum-sealed, ready for slicing or grating right out of the package. Put it in smoothies, steep it in tea, combine it with garlic to create a flavorful base for all kinds of savory recipes.

And if you’re looking for even more convenience, take note that an unopened and refrigerated package of Trader Joe’s Organic Peeled Ginger will stay fresh up to 45 days (and seven days once opened). Also of timely note: every day, you’ll find those four-ounce re-sealable packages in our refrigerators.

Organic Basmati Rice.item_story_marketing:
Luxuriously long-grained and alluringly aromatic (its name comes from the Hindi word for “fragrant,” in fact), basmati rice is one of those staples that we like to have handy at all times. What we don’t always have handy are the tools (or the time!) to cook it from scratch, especially when we want to enjoy it as part of a work lunch or a quick, weeknight dinner. That’s why we offer our quick and convenient Trader Joe’s Organic Basmati Rice in our freezers. Each box contains three pouches of frozen Organic Basmati Rice, which, after just a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer on the stovetop, if you’d prefer) are ready to be plated with all manner of proteins, accompany all kinds of curry, or soak up all sorts of sauces.

We find that this Rice is especially great for serving with our also-extremely-quick-and-convenient Indian Fare pouches, like Tikka Vegetables or Yellow Tadka Dal, as well as our Middle Eastern Style Kebabs. Since they’re so microwave-friendly, they also provide a shrewd shortcut for batch-prepping work lunches. And when winter rolls around, they also make an easy and time-saving addition to a pot of vegetable or chicken soup.

Fine, fragrant, and elegantly textured, long-grained rices make a stellar starch in many kinds of meals, and Trader Joe’s Organic Basmati Rice is a superstar among them. Grown for us by farmers in the foothills of the Himalayas in Northern India, where conditions are ideal for producing basmati, this Rice has a mild, nutty flavor and lightly floral aroma. That makes it a natural companion to curries and other saucy dishes – anything that can complement this Rice’s savory nature and allow the luxuriously long grains to soak up flavors with aplomb.

Uncured Salami Snacker.item_story_marketing:
If you’re feeling snacky, you’ve come to the right place! Trader Joe’s stocks snacks of all sorts to satisfy your cravings and help sustain you until your next meal. Trader Joe’s Uncured Salami Snacker is just one tasty and convenient example.

We call it a Snacker because the three-ounce package is ideal for one peckish person. Open it up to find bite-sized slices of tangy, savory, Uncured Genoa Salami and mild, creamy provolone cheese. With 21 grams of protein per package, our Snacker will satiate your hunger—for comparision, 21 grams is similar to the amount of protein in three large eggs or a quarter-pound beef patty. And if lunch or dinner is a longer way off, you can easily (and deliciously) pair Trader Joe’s Uncured Salami Snacker with your favorite TJ’s crackers, like buttery Golden Rounds, or our mildly sweet, Wheat Crisp Crackers. Of course, nothing’s stopping you from improvising a sandwich if you have a TJ’s Ciabatta Roll handy.

Grab an Uncured Salami Snacker mid-afternoon when you swing by your refrigerator. Drop one in your lunch box for whenever you’re feeling snacky. Or... drop by Trader Joe’s and pick up a Snacker any time to hack your hunger. You’ll find them every day in our refrigerators!

Mini Uncured Salami Sticks.item_story_marketing:
What do you reach for when you’re hungry and hurried, but your next meal is still hours away? It’s a tough call, to be sure, especially when you consider the sheer magnitude of snacking options available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. We have myriad munchies and mini-meal possibilities in every aisle! If you’re seeking snacks with staying power, don’t overlook our refrigerated case! Seriously, our refrigerators offer some excellent options. Take Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Salami Sticks, for example—they satisfy salty-snack cravings and provide 17 grams of protein in the process.

We’ve conveniently divided each package of Mini Uncured Salami Sticks into two, individually sealed, one-ounce servings. Peel back the film, and you have a Mini, meaty feast on (and in) your hands—a feast in the form of a snack-sized helping of slim, perfectly chewy Salami Sticks made from savory Uncured pork with smoke flavor added. (No nitrates or nitrites are added, except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured Swiss chard powder). Enjoy a package of Trader Joe’s Mini Uncured Salami Sticks on their own to mightly carry you between meals. Or, to lean into the “antipasto-on-the-go” theme even further, pair them with a pouch of TJ’s Marinated Artichokes and a TJ’s Sharp Cheddar Cheese Snack Pack or two.

Mini Uncured Pepperoni Sticks.item_story_marketing:
What do you reach for when you’re hungry and hurried, but your next meal is still hours away? It’s a tough call, to be sure, especially when you consider the sheer magnitude of snacking options available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Sauerkraut with Pickled Persian Cucumber.item_story_marketing:
You might not expect it at first glance, but Trader Joe’s Sauerkraut with Pickled Persian Cucumbers is a paragon of pickling innovation and tradition. The innovation? We’ve added pickles – Persian Cucumbers, to be exact. We’ve sliced them into thin rounds, lending extra texture to the kraut and providing just a little yummy pickle flavor. The tradition? This is Sauerkraut like your great grandma used to make. That means all-natural fermentation. No vinegar added. No lab cultures to kick-start the process. No cooking or pasteurization. It’s just raw cabbage and cucumbers with some sea salt and garlic. The salt draws water from the fruit and veggies (cucumbers = fruit; cabbage = veg) creating brine in which ‘good’ bacteria convert carbs into lactic acid, a natural preservative that inhibits ‘bad’ bacteria growth. 

That lactic acid is also behind the tart and tangy flavor (more subtle than vinegary versions) and the extra crispy crunch of our cabbage-cuke blend. Top your Organic Beef Hot Dogs. Build a better Reuben. Mix it with grated carrots and red onion for a swell slaw. Consider it a ready-made side salad. Like great grandma used to say, “If you’re in a pickle, stay cool as a cucumber and reach for the fermented cabbage.” She never said that? Are you sure?

Mini Beef Tacos.item_story_marketing:
Taco Tuesdays are terrific, but honestly, just one day each week seems a little limiting for true arbiters of taco taste. At Trader Joe’s, we think of a week like a taco shell: it needs to be filled! That’s why we provide so many ways to get your daily taco fix, including our Mini Beef Tacos —which also happen to be simple, quick, and delicious.

To make Trader Joe’s Mini Beef Tacos, our supplier in Mexico begins with petite tortillas made with yellow and white corn.They fold them in half and tuck in some flavorful ground beef that’s been seasoned using their own in-house seasoning blend, including garlic, onion, cumin, paprika, and oregano. Then the Tacos are pre- fried to an ideal crispness, and finally, frozen. No matter what time of day—or day of the week—they can be heated from frozen in just a matter of minutes. (That’s just 6-8 minutes in the air fryer at 350°F, or 7-9 minutes in a conventional oven at 425°F.)

Once cooked, our Mini Beef Tacos have a firm, crisp-chewy exterior enclosing a tender, beefy filling. This combination delivers savory satisfaction, whether you enjoy them as-is, or with any of our taco-ndiments. Think Taquera Salsa, Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole [sku 71498], or White Queso Dip—to name just a few. And here’s the best news: you’ll not only find Trader Joe’s Mini Beef Tacos in our freezers on Tuesdays, they’ll be waiting there for you to pick them up every single day of the week!

Beef & Queso Bowl.item_story_marketing:
Need a convenient, flavorful meal that’s ready in a flash? Craving meat & veggies with a Tex-Mex twist? Do two kinds of cheese sound better than one? If you answered Yes! to these questions, we recommend Trader Joe’s Beef & Queso Bowl!

It begins with Spanish-style jasmine rice that’s cooked with chicken broth and seasoned with tomato, onion, garlic, and cumin. Next comes ground Beef, sautéed with green chili peppers, jalapeños, and a host of piquant spices. The meat is paired with fajita-style vegetables—a mix of sautéed white onion with red and green bell peppers. This stacked bowl is finally crowned with not one, but two kinds of cheese: shredded white Cheddar and a rich Queso sauce.

You won’t want to wait long to enjoy this Bowl, and you won’t have to. It heats from frozen in the microwave in just 4-5 minutes. Give it a little stir and dig in to experience the delightful contrast of textures—firm rice, tender Beef, and creamy Queso—along with a satisfying mix of bold flavors. Add your favorite TJ’s salsa and some fresh avocado for even more flavor and texture complexity! You can pick up one of these Beef & Queso Bowls today and every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. You’ll find it in our freezers alongside a variety of ready-in-a-flash, bowl-based meals.

Organic Double Chocolate Batard.item_story_marketing:
Nothing says French bread like the iconic baguette seen in many a market tote bag. But what about this svelte bread’s more rotund presentation: batard? We’d wager this lesser-known shape is equally delicious, especially when in the form of Trader Joe’s Organic Double Chocolate Batard.

Made exclusively for us by a French bakery that specializes in Organic, artisanal bread, there are indeed two kinds of Chocolate—namely, dark Chocolate and cocoa powder—mixed into this Organic Batard’s traditional French bread dough, along with a bit of sugar. The dough is then shaped into an oblong loaf to achieve a balanced ratio of crust to crumb (that’s boulangerie-speak for the Batard’s soft interior) and baked until light golden brown. The finished Batard’s flavor hovers on the edge of sweet and savory, with a hot cocoa-hued dough that’s dotted with melt-in-your-mouth bits of rich dark Chocolate. C’est magnifique!

To unlock the Organic Double Chocolate Batard’s deep cocoa aroma and achieve a pleasantly crisp crust, we recommend warming in the oven before slicing and slathering with Cultured Salted Butter [sku 53720] (also from France, and also delicious). To unlock its value, just take a trip to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, where you’ll find Organic Double Chocolate Batards on our bakery tables, only during the winter months.

Country Style Ground Pork Sausage.item_story_marketing:
A breakfast with Trader Joe’s Ground Country Style Pork Sausage is truly a treat for all five senses. As it crisps up the skillet, there’s the sound of its sizzle, along with the aroma of its herby, meaty flavors coming into focus. It’s a sight for sore eyes once plated, especially when paired with some fluffy scrambled eggs and salted Hash Browns. Then, of course, on the palate, it has a hearty, delightfully coarse-Ground texture, as well as a terrifically toothsome taste. It’s the kind of protein that proves breakfast may just be the most important meal of the day, after all.

That said, we find breakfast to be just the beginning for our Country Style Pork Sausage: it’s also an awesome ingredient in lasagnas, casseroles, pasta sauces, and stuffing. It makes a magnificent topping for a homemade pizza, and when mixed with ground beef, adds all sorts of savory flavor and richness to meatballs, burgers, and more. And if we may return to the breakfast table for a bit, they’re also a key component for biscuits and gravy, a Scotch egg, or a fun and filling breakfast burrito.

Wild Alaskan Black Cod Sablefish with Mi.item_title: Wild Alaskan Black Cod Sablefish with Miso Marinade
Wild Alaskan Black Cod Sablefish with Mi.item_story_marketing:
Miso-marinated black cod was first popularized in the U.S. during the 1990s amid the New York haute cuisine scene, as a slightly modernized take on a traditional Japanese dish called gindara saikyo yaki. In the decades since, it’s become something of a signifier of high end eating—if a restaurant has a good miso cod on the menu, you can trust you’re in good hands, gastronomically speaking. As fans of fine foodstuffs ourselves, we couldn’t let restaurants have all the fun, so we’ve decided to join in by adding Trader Joe’s Wild Alaskan Black Cod Sablefish with a Miso Marinade to our freezers!

Made with wild caught Alsakan Black Cod (also known as Sablefish) that’s been marinated in a mix of Miso, rice wine, and sugar, our Miso Marinated Black Cod cooks quickly and effortlessly in the oven or air fryer, where the sweet Miso will have a chance to caramelize and crisp up beautifully. It makes a fantastic center of the plate protein option, especially when paired with a leafy green salad, or some steamed veggies and white rice. And considering how our retail compares to most restaurants, it’s also an especially economical option.

English Muffin Breakfast Sandwich.item_story_marketing:
There are plenty of reasons to count oneself as a morning person: the serenity of a sunrise, the awe-inspiring glitter of the morning dew, the convenience of getting an early start to the day… But for our money, one reason stands head and shoulders above all others: Breakfast sandwiches. Perfected over decades of practice by burger joints and coffee shops the world over, the breakfast sandwich is the ultimate incentive for morning person-hood, and Trader Joe’s English Muffin Breakfast Sandwich may just be the epitome of its expression.

Each package comes with two Sandwiches made with tender, crisp-exterior, fluffy-interior English Muffins, layered with a hearty pork sausage patty, scrambled eggs, and melty Cheddar cheese. Once quickly and conveniently prepped in the microwave or air fryer, every bite is savory and full-flavored, with each Sandwich containing 18 grams of protein to set up the rest of your day for success. And here’s the best part: you don’t actually have to be a morning person to eat them, nor need they be strictly served at Breakfast! For a savory Sandwich that can be enjoyed anytime (and happens to be especially delicious in the morning), check out the freezer at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Shredded Swiss Cheese & Gruyère Cheese.item_story_marketing: We’ve never said this about any other product, but this Blend is Yodelicious. Get it? Yodel? Delicious? Yo-del- icious? We know it’s a stretch, but we are talking Swiss cheese. And this blend is so good it makes us want to celebrate. What better way to celebrate a Shredded Swiss-Gruyère Cheese Blend than by yodeling. We rest our case. And now we’d like to tell you about the cheese. We’ve combined domestically produced Gruyère and Swiss, shredded them for convenience (and yo-del-icious-ness), and packed them into a resealable bag. The Swiss is creamy and mild; the Gruyere has a nuttier, more distinctive flavor – these two cheeses make a great pair. Melted atop a burger, as a main component of a grilled ham & cheese sandwich, as the pinnacle of French onion soup, made into mac & cheese, in fondue… versatile and, well, yo-del-icious.

Fontina.item_story_marketing: To produce the perfect wheel of Fontina cheese, artisans rely on their expertise and the quality of their milk to get the ideal texture and blend of flavors into the final product. Like many other cheeses, it all begins with milk, curdled in a vat with added cheese cultures and rennet (in this case our supplier uses animal rennet). Then the Fontina is strained through, you guessed it, cheesecloth and placed into wheel-shaped molds to all the paste to set up. After that relatively simple process, we’re left with a young Fontina Semi-Soft Cheese ready to be shipped over to our stores and scooped up by our shoppers! And what a tasty, semi-soft cheese it is to scoop up! Like many other cheeses of Italian origins, Fontina has the taste and texture to be enjoyed all on its own, unclouded by additional flavors. It makes for a wonderful slice to be served as a semi-soft cheese on a cheeseboard and with a woodsy, cherry-forward red wine. However, Fontina is particularly delicious when paired with savory foods such as meats, eggs, other cheeses, and pasta. The nutty, somewhat mushroom-like notes in the cheese go great with savory dishes while the cheese itself imparts a soft, creaminess to anything you use it in.

2 Affogatos Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Des.item_story_marketing:
Only a language as beautiful as Italian could make the word “drowned” so euphonious as “affogato.” Because “drowned” is what “affogato” literally translates to—an evocative reference to the act of pouring hot coffee over a scoop of cold ice cream. A gem of gelato shops the world over, we love the way an affogato mixes flavors, textures, and temperatures. So, when our buyers found this instant Affogato, we instantly knew we had to bring it to our freezers.

Made with a totally vegan recipe, each package of Trader Joe’s 2 Affogatos Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert contains two cups of Vanilla Non Dairy Frozen Dessert, each of which comes with its own packet of instant coffee. All you need to do to enjoy your very own Affogato is open up a cup, pour the contents of the instant coffee into the little well that’s already been made within the Non Dairy Dessert, then follow that up with an ounce of hot water. All at once, that iconic interplay of hot & cold and sweet & bold will unfold before your very eyes, and you’ll be ready to enjoy. We recommend it as an after-dinner treat, an afternoon indulgence, or as an anytime pick-me-up. Divertiti!

Silver Birch Farms Traditional Carnitas.item_story_marketing:
Coming to us from the folks at Silver Birch Farms, these Carnitas are similar to the incarnations you’d find in a Mexican restaurant, albeit with a couple of differences. First, rather than being deep-fried, these Carnitas are seared along their whole surface, then slow-roasted. We find this process keeps them loaded with flavor, without all the extra fat and calories that deep-frying would contribute. Second: you can keep these Carnitas in your fridge, where they’re ready to heat and serve in just minutes—much easier and considerably quicker than trying to make this traditional dish from scratch, and a whole lot less expensive than eating out.

Made with moist and tender citrus-marinated pork, Silver Birch Farms Traditional Carnitas are remarkably easy to prepare: Simply remove the meat from the package, place on a microwave-safe plate, and heat in the microwave for two to three minutes, or until heated through. Remove them, shred with two forks, then serve them with tortillas, your favorite salsa, and guacamole. Easy! Or, if you’re just in need of a practical protein to finish up an entrée, they’re also excellent served atop a salad or rice bowl.

Diced Uncured Pancetta.item_story_marketing:
Have you noticed that most of the products at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s in Trader Joe’s label? It’s not just that we like seeing our logo. (It is handsome though, right?) There are many good reasons, including the fact that when our name is on the package, we have more control over ingredients, production, price—and everything else. Sometimes, we’ll sell another brand just until we have the opportunity to create a private label version for our customers. Trader Joe’s Diced Uncured Pancetta is a great example of this!
