Our Trader Joe’s Pancetta is Uncured, meaning it’s produced with no added nitrates or nitrites—except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured celery powder. It’s minimally processed, made with pork belly that’s imported from Italy, and it’s Diced and ready to incorporate into a variety of dishes. After sautéing Pancetta in a pan to render the fat and crisp up the cubes, make a classic carbonara pasta. Or use that rich pork flavor as a base for a sauce or stew. The crisped, melt-in-your-mouth Pancetta can also be used as a savory garnish scattered on salads, risotto, or Mashed Potatoes. Or toss it with whatever cooked vegetable you’re serving, from green beans to Brussels Sprouts!

Deli Duo.item_story_marketing:
Some foods are fantastic in their own right, but are made that much better when enjoyed together. For example, a plate of savory salami is doubly delicious when partnered with a creamy, piquant cheese. Our buyer had this culinary coupling in mind when she created what is now Trader Joe’s Deli Duo, a collection of conveniently sliced, uncured Genoa salami and Provolone cheese. The mouthwatering salami is gently spiced with white pepper and garlic, and made without nitrates or nitrites (except for those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured Swiss chard powder). Its savory nature and satisfying chew are deftly complemented by the creamy, faintly sharp note of the Provolone. Talk about a dynamic Duo!

Want to make a quick Italian-style sub sandwich? Deli Duo is the answer. Assembling a last-minute charcuterie board for a cocktail party or to satiate the appetites of unannounced guests? Deli Duo to the rescue. In search of an instant afternoon snack? You guessed it—Deli Duo! And if you guessed that you’ll find packages of Deli Duo in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s for an excellent value, you guessed right!

Buffalo Style Chicken Meatballs.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken Meatballs are made with all natural, minimally processed chicken thigh and breast meat that was raised with no antibiotics ever. The Chicken is ground and mixed with mild Monterey Jack Cheese and a classic Buffalo Style seasoning, then fully cooked. To enjoy, just heat them in an air fryer at 400ºF for four minutes. (You can alternatively use a microwave or conventional oven.) 

Each bite of these tender Meatballs satisfies with mild, tangy heat and notes of savory peppers and garlic. Enjoy them on our Sandwich Rolls. Use them as a flavorful protein-boost for your Avocado Ranch Salad Kit. When you’re watching the game, enjoy them as an appetizer, alongside carrot & celery sticks and a side of Organic Ranch Dressing. Yum!

Freeze Dried Strawberry Pieces.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes, we like a sweet, fruit-based snack to focus on a single flavor. Sometimes, we like a sweet, fruit-based snack to feature a particularly delicious pairing of flavors. And in the case of this new candy creation, we’ve opted to...do both! That’s right, Strawberry co-stars with itself in Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Strawberry Pieces Covered in Strawberry Yogurt Candy Coating! Our supplier Freeze Dries bits of juicy Strawberry until they’re crispy, crunchy, and super concentrated in flavor. They then smother the berries in a smooth and creamy Strawberry Yogurt Candy Coating, so that every bite is teeming with the tart, sweet, and bright sensations of Strawberry in two distinct, yet equally delicious, styles.

Enjoy these Strawberry Yogurt Covered Freeze Dried Strawberry Pieces as you would any fun and fruity candy: we find that they’re especially suited for munching on as a movie snack, alongside a bowl of Movie Theater Popcorn, for instance. Their small stature and strong Strawberry flavor also make them a great candidate for sprinkling over a bowl of ice cream, or using as a decoration for baked treats. And of course, we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention how well they serve as a mini-dessert when packed into a school or work lunch.

Chicken & Cheddar Cheese Sandwich.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chicken & Cheddar Cheese Sandwich is filled with pieces of sliced, oven-roasted Chicken, layered with thin slices of sharp white Cheddar Cheese and a generous bunch of peppery arugula. These tasty, high-quality contents are stacked between two slices of our very special Cranberry Seeded Wheat Bread. The Bread is made with a combination of wheat, malted barley, and millet flours. Its hearty crumb also contains sweetened cranberries, plus sunflower & poppy Seeds, which provide a slightly nutty crunch. Finally, what really brings this Sandwich together is the creamy, lightly sweet aioli that’s made with mayo, Cranberry purée, and maple syrup. Deli-sh!

Every bite of our Chicken & Cheddar Cheese Sandwich conveys a cornucopia of flavors and textures— none of which require any assembly work on your part. If that’s setting off your Sandwich alarm, head to our refrigerators where you’ll find this one for limited time, November through February.

Sugar Cookie Dough.item_story_marketing:
As the calendar careens into the holiday season and you’re wondering where you’ll find the time to fit in all the things (Decorating! Cookie swap! Gift shopping! Gift wrapping! Holiday cards!), simply pause—take a cleansing breath—and then, take a trip to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Here you’ll find an array of returning seasonal favorites as well as holiday newcomers to help minimize the hustle and ensure maximum merriment, like Trader Joe’s Sugar Cookie Dough.

Each package of pre-mixed, pre-formed, and ready-to-bake Dough contains twelve tasty Sugar Cookies-to- be, boasting from-scratch flavor without the from-scratch prep work (or cleanup). After about 12-14 minutes in the oven, you’ll have a tray of sweet, pale golden Sugar Cookies that are ready to enjoy as-is, or to frost and decorate to your heart’s delight with Christmas Sprinkle. Bake them one at a time, as the mood strikes, or bake the entire package and check “Cookies for Santa” off your to-do list!

From there, you might pair them with a glass of milk (or your favorite non-dairy alternative), a cozy cuppa, or even with an Espresso Martini for a triumphant nightcap following a gift-wrapping time trial. You’ll find this convenient Sugar Cookie Dough in our refrigerators, from November through December.

Sliced Mortadella.item_story_marketing:
If someone says you can’t have authentic tasting deli meats that aren’t made in Italy, we say, “Baloney!” Then we say: “Trader Joe’s Sliced Mortadella.” We work with a lauded domestic producer of high-quality deli meats to make our Mortadella using a traditional blend of pork, pork fat, and spices. The finely ground pork is formed into large, circular sausages, then thinly sliced, gently folded in half, and finally stacked in our package for easy removal. Each piece displays that classic white lardelli and delivers rich pork flavor, accented with hints of black & white pepper and garlic. With Trader Joe’s Mortadella in hand and your neighborhood TJ’s down the street, there’s no need for travel to Bologna for an authentic tasting panino!

Try a generous spread of Pesto Genovese on lightly toasted TJ’s Ciabatta Demi-Baguette layered with Mortadella and Sliced Provolone. Or how about piling Sliced Mortadella and Wild Arugula between two large pieces of warmed TJ’s Roasted Tomato & Parmesan Focaccia Bread that’s been spread with Burrata and drizzled with Sicilian Selezione Olive Oil. Of course, there’s always the option of gently frying strips of our Mortadella before tossing it with al dente TJ’s pasta!

Now, if someone asks where they can find authentic tasting, high-quality Mortadella priced as a true value, we say: “You’ll find it every day in our refrigerators with our sliced deli meats!”

Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Perfect Mini.item_title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Perfect Mini Bars®
Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Perfect Mini.item_story_marketing:
According to his thirteen children, Dr. Bud Keith was a “health food guy” before “health food” was a thing, constantly tinkering with healthy recipes to feed his king-sized family. As the story goes, one day, he ground up a bunch of dried fruits and vegetables, mixed them with freshly ground nut butter and honey, took one bite and declared, “It’s Perfect!” –and with that simple exclamation, Perfect Bars® were born.

Available in our stores every day, these conveniently combined eight-count boxes of Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Perfect Mini Bars® are sweet, moist, and satisfyingly dense, with an irresistible, melt-in-your-mouth texture. They’re made primarily of organic peanut butter and cashew butter, and flavored with organic dark chocolate, sea salt, honey, and a mix of organic dried whole food powders to give every bite a classic sweet-salty Cookie Dough taste. The Mini Bars are cold-pressed (not baked) and don’t contain any added preservatives or emulsifiers—and because of this, they should be kept in the refrigerator so their flavor and consistency remain intact. They can last up to one week at room temperature, so you can toss one in your purse, backpack, or workout bag to fuel you for the day ahead!

Italian Tomato Pasta Sauce Trio.item_story_marketing:
Packaged in a beautifully bespoke box, Trader Joe’s Italian Tomato Pasta Sauce Trio will delight even the most discerning foodies on your list. This handpicked selection of Sauces comes to us from Puglia, Italy, from a supplier who not only specializes in sauces, but also grows the very tomatoes that form their tasty base! With varieties including Roasted Vegetable, Cherry Tomato, and Puttanesca, each jar offers a true taste of Italy, bursting with bold tomato flavor in every spoonful.
 
The first Tomato Sauce features chunks of Roasted Vegetables (namely, zucchini, eggplant, and bell peppers), a blend that imbues it with mild, well-rounded flavor. The second is made with Datterini Cherry Tomatoes (also known as “Baby Romas”), resulting in a Sauce with a sweeter and more intense Tomato flavor, its brightness further enhanced with fresh garlic and basil. Lastly, the Puttanesca follows a classic Tomato Sauce recipe that includes chopped Kalamata and Chalkidi olives, capers, and anchovies, resulting in an unctuous, supremely savory experience. 
 
Each jar provides a generous 2-3 servings, enough to coat about half a pound of pasta.

nutrition.panel_title: Italian Datterino Cherry Tomato & Roasted Garlic

Medjool Dates.item_story_marketing: Known for their large size, chewy texture, and superlatively sweet flavor, Medjool Dates are considered a premiere variety of the date family. While we appreciate Medjool Dates for all of those reasons, it’s their ability to shine across recipes both sweet & savory that makes them a holiday must-have. Need an appetizer? Stuff them with blue cheese or a bit of Brie Spread and drizzle with TJ’s Glaze. Looking to add sweetness to your smoothie to power through the shopping and gift-wrapping? Medjool Dates to the rescue. Could your savory rice pilaf use a touch of balance? You get the idea. And when you get your Medjool Dates at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, you’re sure to get a great value.

Gold Potatoes 5 lb.item_story_marketing: Lighter and creamier in consistency than their Russet cousins, Gold Potatoes make an excellent choice for mashing, roasting, and slicing thin for gratins all year round. And they’re especially well-suited to big holiday meals. In addition to the aesthetic quality of their pale, golden-hued flesh, their skin takes on a softer texture when cooked, making it easier to manage when making rustic, skin-on mashed potatoes. Gold Potatoes also crisp up wonderfully when quartered and roasted with a bit of olive oil and minced garlic, they air-fry fantastically well into crispy wedges, and they're great additions to soups, stews, or curries, too. Would it be redundant of us to say these Potatoes are good as Gold?

Spicy Cheddar Cheese & Jalapéno Biscuit.item_title: Spicy Cheddar Cheese & Jalapéno Biscuit Bites
Spicy Cheddar Cheese & Jalapéno Biscuit.item_story_marketing:
As the axiom goes, you can’t judge a book by its cover. The same is mostly true of Trader Joe’s products—while you can’t always know how delicious a given TJ’s snack might be just by its name, there are some notable exceptions, and Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheddar Cheese & Jalapeño Biscuit Bites are chief among them. Let’s just break it down, shall we? Spicy: a great start, no notes. Cheddar Cheese & Jalapeño: even better. Then, Biscuit Bites: now, we’re squarely in fainting couch territory.

Indeed, Trader Joe’s Spicy Cheddar Cheese & Jalapeño Biscuit Bites are just as savory, peppery, buttery, and full-flavored as they sound—and they’re a cinch to prep, too! After just a few minutes in the air fryer or conventional oven, they attain a crisp exterior, a fluffy, Biscuit-y interior, and a rich, Cheesy aroma, which, when paired with the pops of sweet & spicy candied Jalapeño on the palate, create a truly transcendent hors d’oeuvres experience. We like them for everything from holiday parties to family feast appetizers to anytime, “just-because” snacking. Through the end of the holidays, you’ll find these bold and flavorful Biscuit Bites in our freezers.

Cinnamon Sugar Waffles.item_story_marketing:
There’s no waffling about it—your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is the place to go when you need to stock your freezer. And wouldn’t you know it, our new Cinnamon Sugar Waffles are here just in time for your holiday haul!

Made with a fragrant, cinnamon-infused batter and dotted with cinnamon-sugar bits throughout, these Waffles are the epitome of cozy. Pop them in the toaster, oven, or air fryer, breathe in their Cinnamon-y goodness, and serve with a pat of Cultured Butter for a quick breakfast. Or gild the lily and top them with a scoop of Panettone & Chocolate Gelato Style Frozen Dessert for a dreamy dessert. You might even use them as the “bread” in an almond butter & apricot preserves sandwich. Each 10.7-ounce package contains eight Waffles, so you can try them at every meal and decide for yourself—the world is your Waffle, as they say! (Maybe they don’t, but they should.) Thanks to our unwavering commitment to value, we’re offering boxes of eight Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Sugar Waffles in our freezers for an incredible price, through the end of the holiday season.

Cranberry Orange Spinach Salad Kit.item_story_marketing:
It mind sound a little silly to say, but one of the great things about a salad is that it’s effectively just a bunch of ingredients thrown together. (Seriously, we’re going somewhere with this!) As such, it actually creates a tremendous amount of freedom to explore how different flavors and textures might interact with one another—and since each bite of a salad is a little different, you get to explore those interactions in different degrees, over and over. A great example of this is Trader Joe’s Cranberry Orange Spinach Salad Kit. Here, the tantalizingly tart flavor of sweetened Cranberries bounces off of the crunch of honey-roasted pecans, the funky flavor of crumbled blue cheese, and the tender texture of fresh Spinach leaves, all bound together by a beautifully balanced Orange-based dressing.

Bright and bold in flavor, this spectacularly citrus-y, terrifically tangy Salad Kit comes together quickly and easily (simply add all the contents of the Kit into a bowl, toss, and serve), making it an effortless addition to any weeknight meal. It pairs well with pastas, sandwiches, soups, and every other entrée in between, and is especially suited to serving alongside steak, chicken, or seafood. And if you’d like a little extra accessorizing, that’s another great thing about a salad: you’re free to add mandarin segments, avocado slices, or Fried Shallots as you see fit!

Salsa Taquera.item_story_marketing:
Have you ever noticed how good the salsa is when you visit a taqueria? That salsa roja is usually handmade from an authentic recipe, presenting a balance of tangy, sweet, roasty, savory, and spicy notes that all work together to make an ideal taco topper. We’ve made Trader Joe’s Salsa Taquera in that same tradition, with the ultimate goal of bringing the taco stand salsa experience right to your table at home!

Our Salsa Taquera (literally, “taco sauce”) begins with a base of diced red tomatoes and blended tomatillos. Of course, we also include essential aromatics, such as onion and garlic purée, plus cilantro, for a hint of bright earthiness. Crucially, some concentrated mango purée boosts the orange color and partners with the sweetness of the tomatoes to balance the tangy tartness of the tomatillos. Finally, there’s the all-important trio of chilis: jalapeños and habañeros for heat, with roasted green chiles to add even more depth of flavor.

Trader Joe’s Salsa Taquera is ideal for dipping your favorite TJ’s chips, like Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, or Organic Corn Chip Dippers. And you’ll want to add a hearty spoonful (or two!) on top of your street-style tacos made with Mini Sonora Style Tortillas, and our Carne Asada Autentica. You can even use Salsa Taquera to marinate your own meat before grilling, or as an ingredient in a homemade salad dressing.

Truffle Risotto.item_story_marketing:
You might think of Trader Joe’s Truffle Risotto as something of a supergroup of Italian ingredients. Bringing up the base is Carnaroli rice—a standard in high-quality Risotto—prized for its ability to retain an al dente texture through cooking. For body, this Risotto calls on nutty Asiago and tangy cultured butter, which, when combined with white wine and cream, create a thick, yet beautifully balanced presence on the palate. Finally, black Truffle brings its signature depth and elegance, rounding out this umami-rich ensemble.

Overall, TJ’s Truffle Risotto has a bold, savory flavor and velvety, toothsome texture befitting its classically Italian ingredient deck. It’s a simple but remarkably elegant side dish any night of the week, and a comforting winter dinner option when paired with roast chicken or seared sea scallops. What’s more, its speedy cook time means constant stove-side stirring is a thing of the past—it’s ready in minutes whether it’s prepped in the microwave or on the stovetop. You’ll find this consummately cozy Risotto in our freezers now through the year’s end.

Chicken Adobo.item_story_marketing:
While the Philippines may not technically have an official national dish, you’d be hard pressed to find a more iconically Filipino dish than adobo. More of a cooking process than a specific recipe, most modern adobo dishes involve braising proteins or veggies in a tangy, savory mix of soy sauce and vinegar, and further seasoning them with classic flavors like garlic, black pepper, and bay leaf. That’s the flavor profile you’ll find in Trader Joe’s Chicken Adobo, our convenient, heat-and-eat tribute to this homey, hearty, full-flavored dish, which also includes a hefty portion of fluffy jasmine rice flavored with bits of oven-roasted garlic —itself a tribute to traditional Filipino garlic rice.

While adobo gets its name from the Spanish “adobar” (“to season” or “to marinate”), the earliest forms of adobo well pre-date Spanish colonization of the Philippines, and call back to an ancient practice of using vinegar as a preserving agent, as much as a flavoring ingredient. In Trader Joe’s Chicken Adobo, that vinegar base provides both zest and a balancing bit of acidity, which beautifully brings out the tenderness of the dark meat chicken. And since it cooks from frozen to steamy and ready-to-eat in a matter of minutes in the microwave, our Chicken Adobo makes a great work lunch option, as well as an easy weeknight dinner-for-one—especially when paired with a crisp, cucumber-y salad on the side, and something citrus-y and sparkling to drink.

Rice Pudding.item_story_marketing:
Ah, for the days of the classic pudding cup. For many of us, the mere memory of digging into a pudding cup in the cafeteria or as part of a midday snack on the weekend is enough to send us into a sweet, nostalgic reverie. And here’s the good news: those days are back and better than ever with the introduction of Trader Joe’s Rice Pudding! Made for us by a supplier that specializes in rich and creamy desserts, this is a delightfully refined Rice Pudding, with pleasant notes of vanilla, and every bite punctuated by the soft, toothsome texture of the Rice. And just like the classic pudding cups of yore, it’s a super satisfying sweet treat, ready to revive sweet memories from the past, as well as create new ones for the kids of today.

Great for packing into school lunches, passing out at sports practices, or simply snacking upon when your sweet tooth strikes, Trader Joe’s Rice Pudding comes in a convenient four-pack for easy distribution. And if you really want to take things to the next level, each cup can be accessorized as you see fit with a light sprinkling of Cinnamon, a few plump Raisins, or both.

Chocolate Pudding.item_story_marketing:
Ah, for the days of the classic pudding cup. For many of us, the mere memory of digging into a pudding cup in the cafeteria or as part of a midday snack on the weekend is enough to send us into a sweet, nostalgic reverie. And here’s the good news: those days are back and better than ever with the introduction of Trader Joe’s Chocolate Pudding! Made for us by a supplier that specializes in rich and creamy desserts, this is a remarkably elegant Chocolate Pudding, with a superlatively smooth and silky texture to match. And just like the classic pudding cups of yore, it’s a super satisfying sweet treat, ready to revive sweet memories from the past, as well as create new ones for the kids of today.

Great for packing into school lunches, passing out at sports practices, or simply snacking upon when your sweet tooth strikes, Trader Joe’s Chocolate Pudding comes in a convenient four-pack for easy distribution. And if you really want to get nostalgic, we recommend mixing in a few of your favorite TJ’s gummy candies, then crushing up a Joe-Joe and sprinkling it on top for a quick and easy “worms in dirt” dessert.

Lasagna Soup.item_story_marketing:
Just as soon as autumn gets into full swing and we start to sense those cool winter breezes on the horizon, our thoughts turn to one thing and one thing only: comfort foods. (All right, fine, one category of things, we suppose). Creamy pastas, steamy casseroles, hearty soups—we simply can’t get enough of them when the weather starts to get a little chilly. And this year, we may have just concocted the comfort food of all comfort foods: Trader Joe’s Lasagna Soup with Turkey. Combining elements from some of our all-time favorite comfort food classics (Cheese! Pasta! Savory-seasoned Turkey!) all into one superlatively savory, rib-sticking Soup, this is a real game-changer for the Trader Joe’s refrigerated section. And it’s available from the late fall to the very end of winter—you know, comfort food season.

Each batch of our Lasagna Soup with Turkey starts with a creamy, savory-seasoned tomato broth, to which our supplier adds al dente mafalda pasta (which are a bit like miniature strips of Lasagna noodles), ground Turkey crumbles, and a bit of Asiago and Romano cheese. After a few minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop, this soup is steamy, aromatic, and totally ready to serve. It makes an easy entrée, especially when paired with some crusty bread or a light green salad (or both!), and really adds some comfy-cozy oomph when served as a side to any wintry, weeknight meal.

Cranberry Pecan Muffins.item_story_marketing:
Nothing quite says “Good morning!” like a muffin. We’re, of course, speaking figuratively here; if you come across a muffin that actually talks, that’s out of our wheelhouse. But the point stands: there’s just something about waking up to a satisfying muffin on your plate that makes a morning feel special, and makes you feel ready to take on the day. That’s precisely the feeling we intend to evoke with Trader Joe’s Cranberry Pecan Muffins. This four-pack of maple-y Muffins plays to every one of the genre’s strengths: a crumbly, cakey texture (thanks, sour cream!), zippy hints of orange zest, and, of course, plenty of bright fresh Cranberries and toothsome Pecans in each bite. The finishing touch of streusel topping makes them extra special, indeed.

While they’re perfectly delicious when enjoyed as a quick, on- the-go breakfast snack or brunch side, we contend that they truly excel when heated up a bit in the toaster oven or microwave — the maple syrup aromatics alone are well worth the price of admission. After that, we recommend a generous application of Cultured Salted Butter. Just as nothing says “good morning!” like a sweet, fruit-filled muffin at the start of your day, nothing quite says “Trader Joe’s” like a great value at the end of your shopping trip. You’ll find this great value on our bakery shelves, from November through December.

Sweet Onion Salad Kit.item_story_marketing:
The key to making a truly delicious leafy green salad is a balance of bold tastes and crisp, clean textures. And to that end, Trader Joe’s Sweet Onion Salad Kit is a triumph on both fronts. Each Kit contains a base of shredded Romaine lettuce, peppery radicchio, and crinkly kale, along with pouches of grated sharp white Cheddar, crunchy fried onion pieces, garlic croutons, and a rich Sweet Onion vinaigrette. When tossed together, these elements merge into a singularly satisfying eating experience that harmoniously combines the lightness of a Salad with the umami allure of a classic French Onion soup.

Great for holiday feasts and quick weekday dinners alike, this Sweet Onion Salad makes a superb side for a plate of turkey, ham, fish, or any other protein you can prep, and works wonders as an entrée in its own right when topped with a bit of said protein. And while its edible qualities are beautifully balanced, its price tips the scales heavily towards value.

Organic Spiced Vanilla Creamer.item_story_marketing:
Our customers love adding something sweet and creamy to their cup of joe, like our Organic Sweet Cream Creamer. With Trader Joe's Organic Spiced Vanilla Creamer, we've taken that classic profile and given it a holiday-spice twist. 

This seasonally seasoned Creamer is made with a combination of organic milk and organic cream to create a rich, exceptionally smooth partner for your freshly brewed coffee. And, we’ve added just the right amount of organic sugar to complement the bold coffee flavor of even the darkest roasts. The “twist” is the inclusion of organic Vanilla extract, organic cardamom extract, and the organic natural flavors of other warm, seasonal spices. 

Add a splash to a steaming mug of Trader Joe’s French Roast Coffee. If tea is your bag, you’ll find that this creamy Spiced Vanilla Creamer is definitely dreamy blended with our Organic Cold Brew Black Tea Concentrate. You may even consider adding a tablespoon or two to your morning bowl of TJ’s Rolled Oats! No matter how you pair it, this Creamer is guaranteed to add a splash of holiday style to whatever you’re enjoying. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Organic Spiced Vanilla Creamer for a limited time in our refrigerators, October through December.

Almond Ginger Sesame Granola.item_story_marketing:
There are some folks who choose to eat the same thing for breakfast every day, some who opt for a bit more variety, and others who skip it entirely. But the “same thing every day” doesn’t have to be the exact same thing—it might be a blueprint of sorts, a riff on the routine that keeps things interesting, but reduces the mental load of meal prep (and who wouldn’t appreciate that?!). All that to say, if granola is part of your morning routine, then you’ll be delighted to hear Trader Joe’s is adding another stellar selection to our lineup: Almond Ginger Sesame Granola!

The classic oat base of this Granola is accessorized with maple syrup, tahini, Sesame seeds, and Almond, along with plenty of crystallized Ginger pieces for zip and textural intrigue. Captivatingly crunchy, its recipe profile deftly walks the line between sweet and savory, making it equally ideal for out-of-hand snacking or topping a bowl of Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt with fresh blueberries.

Vegetable Ravioli.item_story_marketing:
We’ll rave about ravioli all day if you’ll let us! Take a simple scan of our refrigerated foods case, and you’ll see that we’re big fans of the stuff—or, should we say, of the stuffed. These pasta pockets are also quite popular with our customers, which is why we’re introducing a new, available-every-day ravioli to the roster: Trader Joe’s Vegetable Ravioli.

Made for us in Italy, our Vegetable Ravioli begins with tender, toothsome, wheat-based pasta made with egg and spinach, the latter of which enhances the Ravioli’s veggie flavor profile and imbues it with a vibrant green hue. Our supplier—the expert pasta-producers behind many of our other revered Ravioli—generously stuffs these with a flavorful filling of zucchini, mozzarella cheese, breadcrumbs, caramelized onions, roasted onions, and red & yellow peppers. The Ravioli cooks to al dente in 3-4 minutes, making it an absurdly easy option for weeknight dinners-in-a-pinch. Serve it tossed in a bit of olive oil and sprinkled with Parmesan cheese, or pair it with your favorite TJ’s pasta sauce.

Caramel Flan.item_story_marketing:
Your guests arrive in ten minutes.Your Mexican-style spread, featuring a host of Trader Joe’s products—Chicken Taquitos, Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos, Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips, and Guacasalsa—is ready to go. All that’s missing is dessert! You had intended on making churros, but somehow, time slipped away. Now, you need a Plan B; something quick, easy, and delicious that also sticks with the Trader Joe’s/Mexican theme... We’ve got you: Trader Joe’s Traditional Caramel Flan to the rescue!

Our Flan is Traditional, indeed, made with just six ingredients. The custard is cooked using a customary water-bath method to yield that classic firm, yet smooth & creamy texture—and that’s without thickeners or starches. Keep the package (two servings each) in your refrigerator until it’s time to enjoy. To serve, gently run a smooth knife blade around the edge of each foil cup, then invert the Flan onto your chosen serving plate. Dessert, done! If you like, you can garnish with a handful of berries or a dollop of Crème Fraîche.

The custard combines with its translucent, golden-colored, caramel topping to deliver an authentic Flan experience in every silky-sweet bite. Next time, make Trader Joe’s Caramel Flan your Flan A!

Surimi Imitation Crabmeat.item_story_marketing:
If imitation is truly the sincerest form of flattery, then Trader Joe’s Surimi might just be the biggest compliment to crab meat—ever. As one of our most consistent customer requests for years, when we set out to find a surimi to add to our refrigerators, we knew it really had to hit the mark. And after trying many different versions, styles, and variations, this Surimi stood far above the rest. It’s made with tender Alaska pollock that’s been mixed with a touch of sugar and pea starch to give it that characteristic crab flavor and texture, and a bit of tomato lycopene to deliver its signature red hue. It all results in a Surimi that’s lightly sweet, a little briny, and delightfully flaky­­—and ready to be used in all sorts of seafood-y recipes, right out of the package.

Originally invented as a cost-effective alternative to crab, surimi has since taken on a culinary identity all its own, and is especially adored in dishes where its firmer texture and milder flavor makes it preferable to crab, for some palates. Whatever your preference, we find that Trader Joe’s Surimi Imitation Crab Meat is an excellent, conveniently pre-cooked protein choice for anything that calls for seafood. Try it on top of a leafy green salad for an easy work lunch, roughly chop it and mix into chowders and gumbos, or, if you want an easy appetizer dip or seafood salad for sandwiches, simply shred it with a fork, mix it with some mayo, Rice Vinegar, chopped veggies and alliums, and a fun and fiery hot sauce, like our Sriracha.

Chunky Blue Cheese Dressing & Dip.item_story_marketing:
A good blue cheese dressing should be at least a little luxurious. It should elevate a simple salad into feeling like something you’d get at a steakhouse. It should give a buffalo wing an additional bit of cool complexity to complement its vinegary heat. But above all, we contend that a blue cheese dressing should be super blue cheese-y! And that’s precisely why we’re bringing in Trader Joe’s Chunky Blue Cheese Dressing & Dip to our refrigerators. Each batch starts with a base of mayonnaise and sour cream, to which our supplier adds savory and aromatic elements like minced onion, garlic powder, and dill weed, along with big Chunks of soft, satisfyingly funky Blue Cheese to ensure a rich, full flavor and plush, creamy consistency. And in true Trader Joe’s fashion, it’s both a little luxurious (at least!) and a tremendous value.

We recommend spoon-drizzling this Dressing over salads of all sorts, be it a bed of Baby Spinach, a bowlful of our Champs Elysées blend, or a hearty Iceberg Lettuce wedge with crumbled bacon. As a Dip, it adds a certain savory something to chicken wings and Spicy Chicken Nuggets, celery sticks and Carrots, as well as pizza slices and Sweet Potato Fries. And if you’re really looking to live luxuriously, try using it to top your next burger, sandwich, or freshly seared steak.

Basmati Rice from India.item_story_marketing: Basmati Rice has been grown for centuries in Northern India, near the foothills of the Himalayas. There, the soil conditions produce rice that is known for it’s nutty flavor, firm consistency, and distinctively floral aroma. It’s natural then that Trader Joe’s Basmati Rice (which we import from India), would deliver these same attractive qualities. And not only will it yield a tasty tahdig for your tahchin, but it’s also a fragrant foundation for coconut curry, shrimp jambalaya, rice pudding, pilaf, and more!

Organic Crimini Mushrooms.item_story_marketing:
POP QUIZ: What would a Crimini Mushroom become if it were allowed to continue growing?

If you guessed “Portobello,” you are obviously a mycophile! And if you guessed something completely different, we have confidence in your capacity to reach mycophile status! Best of all, no matter what you guessed, you’re welcome to stop by your neighborhood Trader Joe’s for a package of Organic Crimini Mushrooms to call your own.

The Crimini Mushroom is slightly more subtle than that of the Portobello, and, because it has a bit more moisture, it’s a more appropriate component of soups, risottos, casseroles, gravies, stuffings, dressings—in fact, the mild earthiness of Criminis makes them excellent in all kinds of Thanksgiving dinner dishes. We have green bean casserole on our minds as we write, but really, the world is your Crimini!

Teeny Tiny Maple Butter Tarts.item_story_marketing:
Call us sentimental, call us sappy if you must, but there’s just something about a gooey, buttery, maple-y sweet treat this time of year that truly sets our hearts aflutter. Maybe it’s the way the rich, caramel-y notes of maple give us a warm and fuzzy feeling amid the crisp autumn air. Maybe it’s the subliminal association with maple leaves and fall foliage. Maybe it’s just the fact that maple is always delicious, and delightful little reminders like Trader Joe’s Teeny Tiny Maple Butter Tarts simply give us a reason and a season to celebrate it. 

Brought to us by a supplier in Canada, these bite-sized Tarts are made with Canadian Maple syrup, which has been combined with Butter, sugar, and eggs to create a super rich and flavorful filling. That filling is then baked inside a crisp and flaky, Teeny Tiny Tart crust until just done, then frozen. At home, they only take a few minutes in the oven or air fryer before they start filling your kitchen with a rich Maple aroma, at which point they’ll be ready to serve as mini desserts or a quick and easy sweet snack. And since each package comes with twelve Tarts, we find they’re especially great for breaking out at big family get-togethers or dinner parties. Another hot tip? Serve them warm with some Salted Maple Ice Cream for a dessert that will certainly have nostalgia a’knocking.

Chicken Caesar Wrap.item_story_marketing:
Having recently marked its 100th anniversary as a mainstay of menus all the world over, we thought it only fitting to give the legendary Caesar salad a whole new world to conquer for its centennial celebration: that of the grab-and-go sandwich wrap. Conveniently hand-holdable and enjoyable straight from the fridge, Trader Joe’s Chicken Caesar Wrap showcases everything you love about a Caesar salad —the crisp bite of the lettuce, the creamy garlickyness of the rich dressing, the way you can positively pile it on with Parmesan—in a quick and easy meal, all without the need of a fork. 

Each wrap starts with strips of satisfyingly savory-seasoned Chicken breast, which are packed along with shredded lettuce and Parmesan cheese into a leafy green tortilla (which gets its verdant hues from spinach powder, we should add) and Wrapped tight. Each package also comes with a tub of creamy and full-flavored Caesar dressing to dunk, dip, drizzle or dab to your delight. All in all, it makes an exceptionally easy and flavorful lunch option for all sorts of situations. We particularly love to pack one on a picnic or a day trip, especially when we can pair it with a bag of Trader Joe’s Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips and a bright, bubbly beverage.

Sea Salt Fine Crystals.item_story_marketing: This high quality Mediterranean sea salt is produced by the evaporation of seawater. It is the perfect accompaniment to any kitchen and is great for cooking and blending into your signature recipes.

Organic Sweet Potatoes.item_story_marketing: Sweet Potatoes are most popularly associated with casseroles, a role in which they do, indeed, excel. But that’s just the tip of the iceberg when it comes to this tasty tuber’s versatility. We like them diced into breakfast hash, mashed into gnocchi, and of course, baked into pies. We also like them when they’re a tremendous value, which is why we work directly with our suppliers to secure a retail of $4.99 for each three-pound bag—a value that’s all the more impressive when you realize these are Organic Sweet Potatoes. How sweet is that? You’ll find them on our produce tables, every day.

Brie Cheese Flavored Spread.item_story_marketing:
Our cheese buyer relishes the challenge of developing new products that bring the proverbial party wherever they’re served. Case in point: Trader Joe’s Brie Cheese Flavored Spread. Our Wisconsin-based supplier (a third-generation, family owned creamery) combines velvety Brie with rich cream to create this Spread’s unbelievably creamy texture and marvelously mild flavor—essentially, it offers all the best qualities of Brie, minus the rind. What’s not to love?! 

From crackers to crudités, pretzel sticks to sandwiches, this Spread’s uses are only limited by your imagination. And whether you’re hosting a holiday shindig, or simply whipping up a celebration for one, you’re sure to appreciate its eminently spreadable (dare we say spoonable?) nature, as well as its convenient, lidded-tub packaging (no more forgotten wedges in the back of the cheese drawer!). Did we mention this Spread’s un- Brie-lievable value? You’ll find six-ounce tubs in our cheese case, every day.

Shaved Lamb Shoulder.item_story_marketing:
Australian lamb is considered to be among the very best in the world. But why, exactly, does Trader Joe’s Shaved Lamb Shoulder from Down Under get us so head-over-heels? It’s all about how it’s raised. Out on the green, rolling pastures of the Australian countryside, our supplier’s lambs graze on lush grasses, which allows them to attain an ideal fat-to-lean ratio for a light and mild flavor, and marvelous, melt-in-your-mouth texture.  And since our supplier Shaves the Shoulder meat so superlatively thin, it has even more tender texture. It’s the kind of difference that, once you take it home and cook it, you can taste immediately—a level of quality that raises the bar with every bite.

It’s also the kind of difference that’s ideal for plussing up all kinds of everyday entrées, from stir fries and tacos to sandwiches and wraps. It adds an elegant element to ramen, cold noodle salads, and hot pot, and makes a mean Mediterranean cheesesteak when pan-fried and smothered with grilled pepper, onions, and Crumbled Feta on a Sandwich Roll. And for a super easy meal prep, protein, we recommend seasoning it with a bit of cumin and coriander, sautéing until browned, and using it to top everything from rice bowls and salads to pastas and flatbreads.

Ground Lamb.item_story_marketing:
Australian lamb is considered to be among the very best in the world. But why, exactly, does Trader Joe’s Ground Lamb from Down Under get us so head-over-heels? It’s all about how it’s raised. Out on the green, rolling pastures of the Australian countryside, our supplier’s lambs graze on lush grasses, which allows them to attain an ideal fat-to-lean ratio for a light and mild flavor, and marvelous, melt-in-your-mouth texture. It’s the kind of difference that, once you take it home and cook it, you can taste immediately—a level of quality that raises the bar with every bite.

It’s also the kind of difference that makes it ideal for plussing up all kinds of everyday protein applications. Making some burgers from scratch? Mixing in a bit of Ground Lamb will add a satisfyingly succulent element with ease. Lasagna’s on the menu? Brown up some lamb into your ragu, for a remakably elevated entrée. And that’s before we get into its uses in Mediterranean cuisine: for a quick and easy kofta kebab, mix a package of Ground Lamb with breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, and a few pinches of cumin, cayenne, and cinnamon, then form into cylinder, thread onto some skewers, and grill.

Cookies 'N Cream Ice Cream Sandwiches.item_story_marketing:
Sublime’s got a sister! That’s right, our Sublime Ice Cream Sandwiches [sku 90987]—consistently ranked by customers among their absolute favorite Trader Joe’s products—will now be sharing their freezer space with a sibling—one that we believe is also destined for TJ’s product glory!

Similar to Sublimes, Trader Joe’s Cookies ‘N Cream Ice Cream Sandwiches consist of two Cookies sandwiching Ice Cream. But instead of chocolate chip cookies, we used two, double-Chocolate Cookies flavored with rich cocoa powder and loaded with decadent Chocolate Chunks. Between these two Cookies is a generous scoop of ice cream that’s blended with a subtantial amount of chocolate Cookie crumbs.

The Sandwiches have a soft bite straight out of the freezer (like their sibling), and the creamy filling is a wonderful contrast to the chewy, Chocolate-Chunk laden Cookies. In a word, we might call this frozen treat “sublime”—but that just might be confusing!

What’s not confusing is where you can find Trader Joe’s Cookies ‘N Cream Ice Cream Sandwiches: in our freezers, every day, along with all our other awesome TJ’s ice-cream offerings.

Old Wisconsin Beef Summer Sausage.item_story_marketing:
Despite what its name might lead you to believe, Summer Sausage is actually a savory treat suitable for any time of year. It simply gets its seasonal moniker from the fact that, unlike most other sausages, it can be stored at room temperature prior to opening, even during the hotter months of the year. Somewhat paradoxically, this aspect historically made Summer Sausage a traditional gift for the winter holidays within many cultures, as recipients would relish the opportunity to keep them preserved in their pantry until the summer months rolled around. Of course, we don’t carry this Beef Summer Sausage from the folks at Old Wisconsin® for its shelf stable status (although, that is a nice plus!)—we carry it because it’s delicious. 

Slow-smoked over hardwood and seasoned with traditional savory spices, Old Wisconsin® Beef Summer Sausage makes superb (and quick!) snack, either enjoyed solo or paired with your favorite TJ’s crackers and cheese. We truly mean it when we say it’s great any time of year, by the way. Try adding it to an appetizer spread when friends are over for a spring brunch. In the summer, use it to top a pasta salad at a barbecue. It’s an excellent ingredient for a hearty hot dish, and an able alternative to pepperoni on a pizza. It’s also quite at home on an hors d’oeuvres table at a holiday feast.

Norwegian Smoked Salmon.item_story_marketing:
One might think of the ice-cold waters of the Norwegian fjords as being inherently inhospitable, but they’re actually the ideal environment for certain species of fish, including herring, Greenland sharks, and Atlantic salmon. In fact, it’s within these waters that our supplier farms this meaty, mild-flavored salmon, and just a few miles away from said fjords’ shorelines, they gently smoke them and slice them super thin to accentuate their naturally tender texture. It all results in a delightfully savory, delicately smoky seafood treat, which we call Trader Joe’s Norwegian Smoked Salmon. 

While we’re particularly partial to enjoying Trader Joe’s Norwegian Smoked Salmon on a bagel with Whipped Cream Cheese and Capers, that’s just the beginning, as far as we’re concerned. It’s also excellent atop an English Muffin with a poached egg and Hollandaise for a satisfying salmon Benedict, or roughly chopped and mixed into scrambled eggs or placed into an omelet. And outside of its breakfast uses, we also find it’s great for including in seafood chowders, sandwiches, and pastas, and even simply serving over a leafy green salad or bowl of steamed rice.

Ketchup Flavored Lattice Potato Chips.item_story_marketing:
O, Canada! Among the many culinary treasures provided by our neighbors to the north, some of our favorites have come in the form of uniquely flavored potato chips, with the ketchup flavored chip chief among them. In fact, we so admire this strangely intuitive, yet still somehow-offbeat-feeling flavor, that we decided to try our own hand at it—incorporating our own textural twist, of course. To that end, Trader Joe’s Ketchup Flavored Lattice Potato Chips combine the flavor of classic tomato Ketchup with the criss-cross texture and satisfying crunch of a Lattice-cut Potato Chip.

A little salty, a little sweet, and with a delighftul, vinegar-y tang in every bite, Trader Joe’s Ketchup Flavored Lattice Potato Chips are a snack that proves why Ketchup and Potatoes have been such an iconic pairing for so long. They’re great for serving at parties, picnics, and barbecues of all kinds, where their Lattice structure will hold up particularly well to dunking into creamy or chunky dips. We’re also quite fond of munching on them alongside a hamburger, sandwich, or hot dog—or really any other dish that would also serve well with a side of ketchup and fries.

Simit Turkish Sesame Bread.item_story_marketing:
For a taste of Turkey at home, allow us to introduce you to Trader Joe’s Simit Turkish Sesame Bread. Simit can be found on street carts and bakeries throughout the country, and although these beauties may resemble bagels, they are distinctly different.

Simit is not boiled but baked and has a characteristic twist throughout. While its interior is chewy and nutty, its exterior is crispy and dense. Our Simits are made “Ankara style,” on the smaller size, conveniently-sized, with a crisp texture. Sticking to tradition, these circular breads are coated with a molasses-based solution that adds a bit of shine, helps with browning, and allows sesame seeds to encrust their surface.

To ensure freshness, each package contains two smaller, individually sealed bags, containing two Sesame Breads in each. They come frozen and can be eaten as soon as they thaw. To awaken all the unique flavors and textures, though, we recommend heating from frozen in a 350°F. oven for 4-5 minutes. Enjoy on their own, serve with your favorite TJ’s Hummus or bit of TJ’s Glaze. Slather with Cultured Butter, Feta Cheese, or Raspberry Preserves as a breakfast treat or daytime snack.

Sliced Calabrese Uncured Salami.item_story_marketing:
When you’re looking to improve your sandwich game, we find that one sure-fire way is to get right to the heart of the matter (or, should we say, right to the middle of the sandwich) and plus up your protein. And wouldn’t you know it, the deli section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is simply stocked full of amazing options! Take Trader Joe’s Sliced Calabrese, for instance. Made without the use of nitrates or nitrites (apart from those that occur naturally in sea salt and celery powder), this flavorful and fiery Uncured Salami is seasoned with red pepper and paprika, in addition to its suite of classic Salami spices like dried garlic and black pepper, so that every tender, toothsome bite builds a steady, satisfying heat. 

Named for the region of Southern Italy of Calabria, where this spicy style of Salami was first popularized, Calabrese is indeed a superb sandwich ingredient. That’s hardly where we’d stop, though: we also find it makes a terrific topping for pizza, an awesome addition to an antipasto platter, and a charming inclusion on a charcuterie board. And for an easy, full-flavored appetizer for when friends are over, try rolling up some Calabrese with Sliced Provolone or Ciliegine and Cherry Tomatoes and skewering them with toothpicks.

Protein Pancakes.item_story_marketing:
Packing extra protein into your day doesn’t have to be a chore. In fact, at Trader Joe’s, there are many ways to get your macros in that are as flavorful as they are functional, including Trader Joe’s Protein Pancakes. Made with a gluten free recipe that combines cottage cheese, eggwhite, eggs, and oat flour, and flavored with a bit of sugar and vanilla extract, these silver-dollar-style Pancakes come fully-cooked and ready-to-eat, and contain a whopping 20 grams of Protein per four-Pancake package. All it takes is a few seconds of microwaving and a quick application of your favorite toppings, and you’ve got a quick, easy, and totally tasty breakfast that also happens to get you ahead on your daily Protein goals. 

Slightly sweet, with a light note of vanilla and a fluffy, delightfully syrup-soaking texture, we’re particularly partial to accessorizing our Protein Pancakes with a pat of butter and a generous drizzle of Organic Vermont Maple Syrup. They’re great at brunch, before or after a big weekend workout, especially when paired with a plate of eggs and Maple Chicken Breakfast Sausage—talk about protein power! And they’re now available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s—you’ll find them in our refrigerators.

Goat Cheese & Caramelized Onion Ravioli.item_story_marketing:
When dinner’s on the horizon and time’s in short supply, we find it’s always a relief to have a few packs of our fresh ravioli waiting in the fridge. And with such a wide variety among the ravioli available at Trader Joe’s, there’s always a flavor profile to fit whatever the mood might be. For example, on nights when you’re into understated elegance, our aromatic Porcini Mushroom & Truffle Triangoli are just the ticket. When you’re feeling a bit more whimsical and cheesy, our punchy Cacio E Pepe Ravioli are ideal. And when you’re feeling a little sweet, a little tart, and chock full of umami, Trader Joe’s Goat Cheese & Caramelized Onion Ravioli are the way to go. And for less than five bucks per package, and less than five minutes of cooking time!

Crafted for us by an expert pasta-maker in Italy, this rich and tasty Ravioli is made with extra thin sheets of pasta, stuffed with a mixture of tart and tangy Goat Cheese and sweet, full-flavored Caramelized Onions. When cooked al dente, the thinness of the pasta creates a delightfully delicate texture on the tongue, which communicates the flavor of the filling in a truly wonderful way. While you’re certainly welcome to serve this Ravioli in your favorite pasta sauce, we find it does just fine on its own, lightly tossed with a little extra virgin olive oil.

Gluten Free Cranberry Raisin Toasts.item_story_marketing:
If you’ve tasted Trader Joe’s Crisps (Raisin Rosemary, Fig & Olive, et. al), you know our exacting cracker standards have contributed to some of the most reliably tasty cheese vehicles, dip delivery vessels, and out-of-hand snacks to grace our shelves over the past 15 years—and counting! Unless, of course, you adhere to a gluten free diet, in which case, you likely have yet to experience their fantastically flavorful crunch. Well, that changes today, with the introduction of Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Cranberry Raisin Toasts!

Made for us in the U.K. by gluten free cracker experts, these snappy, oblong Toasts are made with a blend of rice, tapioca, and potato flours, combined with a base of egg whites and tangy buttermilk. Positively brimming with sweet, chewy dried Cranberries and Raisins, they’re balanced with savory pumpkin seeds and aromatic rosemary. The thinly sliced construction of these two-bite Toasts makes them ideal for afternoon snacking, while their crisp crunch provides a welcome foil to a swipe of Goat’s Milk Creamy Cheese [sku 98825] or velvety slices of Triple Crème Brie. TL;DR: they’re a standout cracker selection that’s sure to appeal to both gluten free and gluten-ful crowds, for practically any occasion.

While similar crackers sell elsewhere for double the price, these terrific Toasts are available every day on the cracker shelves at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, for a price that won’t break the bank. We’ll toast to that!

Crispy Garlic.item_story_marketing:
Garlic just keeps on giving, doesn’t it? It seems no matter its state—raw and minced, roughly chopped and sautéed, or whole and slowly roasted into confit—it has something wonderful to offer one’s tastebuds. And as Trader Joe’s Crispy Garlic ably demonstrates, when sliced thin and fried to a glorious golden brown, garlic’s gifts easily extend into the textural realm, too. We tried plenty of options before finding this iteration of Crispy Garlic, which is brought to us by an expert supplier in Thailand. Only their Crispy Garlic was able to capture that flavorful-but-not-bitter, nicely-fried-but-not-tough, crunchy-but-still-melt-in-your-mouth quality that our tasting panel adored. We think you’ll adore it, too.

Trader Joe’s Crispy Garlic is excellent as a topping on stir-fries, salads, and scrambled eggs; pizzas, pastas, and pad Thai; or even burgers, baked potatoes, and bánh mi. It can be mixed into homemade cheesy dips and casseroles, sprinkled over noodle dishes or roasted veggies, or even just enjoyed over a bowl of freshly made rice. Frankly, there’s not really a savory dish we wouldn’t add Crispy Garlic to, and once you get your hands on a pouch, we’re sure you’ll feel the same way. They’re available in our grocery aisle, every day.

Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert.item_story_marketing:
If you haven’t had a chance to try one of our non-dairy frozen desserts yet—even, and especially, if you’re normally a fan of dairy—consider the introduction of Trader Joe’s Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert to be your formal invitation. Made with a base of creamy coconut milk and flavored with both vanilla bean paste and bits of ground vanilla beans, this veritably vegan Frozen Dessert is distinctly delicious, offering a superlatively smooth texture and remarkably rich and floral Vanilla flavors in every satisfying spoonful, without an overwhelming flavor of coconut.

It’s brought to us by the same Thai supplier who produces many of our other non-dairy sweet treats, and after just one taste, you’ll see why we’ve worked with them time and again: they’ve truly figured out a way to make coconut milk feel creamier and more luscious on the palate than most standard, dairy-based ice creams out there. As such, while this Vanilla Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert is great for simply enjoying in a bowl, cone, or sundae, we also find that it’s particularly suited for more complex dessert endeavors, too: we recommend using it in floats, no-bake ice cream cakes, homemade ice cream sandwiches, or milkshakes (either with our A2 Organic Whole Milk, or, if you prefer to keep it vegan, some chilled Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Coconut Beverage.)

Homestyle Cherry Pistachio Pecan Granola.item_story_marketing:
If you asked someone to name the top foods associated with fine dining, it would probably take them quite a while before they got to granola. But if you think about, all the elements are there for granola to go gourmet: a variety of textures, a curated selection of ingredients, and a chance to showcase how they all interact with one another. This was exactly what one of our product developers experienced when enjoying a post-dinner granola at a renowned restaurant, and that’s exactly what inspired us to try our own hand at haute cuisine oats with Trader Joe’s Homestyle Cherry Pistachio Pecan Granola.

Striking just the right balance of rustic and refined, this Granola is made with a mix of crisp rolled oats, sweetened and dried Montmorency cherries, crunchy Pistachios, Pecans, and pumpkin seeds, and coconut flakes. Our supplier flavors all these elements with brown sugar, maple syrup, and a touch of extra virgin olive oil, to provide a pleasant push-pull of savory and sweet on the palate. In the morning, it makes a beautiful breakfast when mixed with milk, and the evening, it’s a delightful dessert, especially when enjoyed in the context of a parfait, or when sprinkled over ice cream as part of a sundae.

Mini Chicken Tacos.item_story_marketing:
The supplier for Trader Joe's Mini Chicken Tacos makes their own tiny corn tortillas, fills them with a mix of shredded chicken breast meat (yup, all-white meat!) and a chipotle-tomato seasoning blend, then fries them up! The result? The tastiest, tiniest, most tantalizing Tacos you ever did eat!

Warm these Mini Tacos for an afternoon, after-school, or after-work snack. Bake or crisp them in the air-fryer and dunk ’em in Guacasalsa or Salsa Autentica. Whether it’s Taco Tuesday or “Just Because” Wednesday (or Thursday… or Friday…), these Tacos are tops!

Loaded Mashed Potatoes.item_story_marketing:
If the prevalence of dishes like loaded baked potatoes and loaded potato skins indicate one thing, it’s that spuds are some of the most structurally sound starches around. Okay, okay, it’s obvious that people love to load up a potato because potatoes are great at supporting other flavors, not just because of their architectural advantages. But there is something to the fact that a potato’s physical composition is hefty enough to hold onto all sorts of other ingredients without being overtaken by them. And it’s something that’s wonderfully evident in every bite of Trader Joe’s Loaded Mashed Potatoes. 

Neatly packaged and ready-to-serve, this 16-ounce tray contains a hearty portion of creamy, marvelously Mashed Potatoes, which our supplier has lovingly Loaded with shreds of sharp Cheddar cheese, tangy sour cream, sliced scallions, and smoky bits of uncured bacon. All together, it creates a phenomenal flavor profile that mixes the maximalist joy of a fully-loaded baked potato with the smooth consistency of Mashed Potatoes. After only a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer in the conventional oven), it makes a fantastic side dish for practically any entrée, though we find that it’s especially appropriate for serving alongside traditional holiday fare like roast turkey and prime rib—which is convenient, since it’s only available now through the end of the holiday season. That said, until then, it also makes an easy-yet-elevated addition to a weeknight dinner.

Sliced Peppered Uncured Salami.item_story_marketing:
When you’re looking to improve your sandwich game, we find that one sure-fire way is to get right to the heart of the matter (or, should we say, right to the middle of the sandwich) and plus up your protein. And wouldn’t you know it, the deli section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is simply stocked full of amazing options! Take Trader Joe’s Sliced Peppered Uncured Salami, for instance. Made without the use of nitrates or nitrites (apart from those that occur naturally in sea salt and celery poweder), this charming bit of charcuterie starts with wonderfully well-marbled, savory-seasoned Uncured pork Salami, which our supplier has encrusted with a layer of bold and lightly spicy cracked black Pepper, then Sliced to an optimal thickness for a totally tender, toothsome bite. 

On the palate, you get notes of aromatic garlic and rich pork, along with a pleasantly Pepper-y heat—in other words, just the thing to turn a same-old-same-old sandwich into something extraordinary. Speaking of extraordinary, this Salami also serves extraordinarily well as part of a cheese plate or charcuterie spread, is a fantastically full-flavored topper to an antipasto salad, and makes a great ingredient for homemade hors d’oeuvres like olive skewers and caprese crostini.

Organic Sweet Cream Creamer.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Organic Sweet Cream Creamer is made from a blend of organic milk & organic cream to create a rich, exceptionally smooth partner for your freshly brewed coffee. And, we’ve added just the right amount of organic sugar to complement the bold coffee flavor of even the darkest roasts. Add a splash of Trader Joe’s Organic Sweet Cream Creamer to a steaming mug of Trader Joe’s French Roast Coffee. Mix it with Trader Joe’s Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate and serve over ice. 

If tea is your bag, you’ll find that this Sweet creamy Creamer is definitely dreamy blended with our Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate. Really, we could go on and on, considering all of the coffee & tea options at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. And now, you’ll have one more Creamer option to power all your homebrewed coffee & tea concoctions!

Organic Milk A2/A2.item_story_marketing:
The Whole Milk profile means richer, creamier flavor that pairs so well with cake, cookies, cereal, coffee, and more. And these traits can even re-invigorate that nostalgic idea of enjoying a tall, cold glass of milk! To support all the Whole Milk lovers, we offer a variety of options for different tastes and preferences, and now we’re adding one more variety to our dairy deck: Trader Joe’s Organic A2 Whole Milk.

What is A2? Glad you asked. Regular milk contains two variations of beta-casein protein: A1 and A2. Several years back, super-smart scientists in New Zealand discovered that some cows were producing milk with only A2 beta-casein. This “A2” milk didn’t have a different flavor. It didn’t even have a different nutrient profile. What it did have going for it, different than regular milk, was the prospect of being easier to digest for some people. These scientists realized that you could easily discover which cows were producing A2-only milk using a simple genetic test. The rest is history—including the advent of A2 Whole Milk in the dairy case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Creamy Mac & Cheese.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Creamy Mac & Cheese is made with generous amounts of our beloved sharp and mature Unexpected Cheddar, Parmesan, and mild cheddar cheese which fuse with heavy cream and butter for an exceptionally creamy, cheesy sauce! What really helps showcase this sauce is the noodle shape — Pipette Rigate— Italian for “little pipe.” The pasta’s exterior ridges enable this ooey-gooey sauce to smother and cling to all the curves and grooves of the charming pipe-shaped macaroni.

For all the complexity of this Mac’s flavor, preparation is stress-free! This dish warms fast in the microwave or on the stovetop in mere minutes. This Mac & Cheese can be a meal all by itself and also makes a great companion to a crisp salad like BBQ Chicken Salad, or fulling dinner alongside Trader Joe’s Breaded Chicken Tenderloin Breasts. Mosey on over to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, where you’ll find this cheesy container, every day.

Thai Style Red Curry Soup.item_story_marketing: As a category of dish, curry has a remarkably wide range of expression, from thick and umami-rich Japanese curries, to bold and aromatic Indian curries, to creamy, coconut-based Thai curries. Taking its cues from the Thai curry tradition, Trader Joe’s Thai Style Red Curry Soup hits some of the most popular notes in the Red Curry canon. A spoonful of this full-flavored, just-heat-and-eat Soup carries hints of ginger, garlic, lemongrass, and even a touch of chili heat. The herbs and spices flavor a sauce that carries chunks of white-meat chicken, hearty pieces of fresh pumpkin, bell peppers, and green beans. All these components come to life with a quick heat-up in the microwave or in a saucepan on the stove. And when paired with a mound of freshly steamed TJ’s Jasmine Rice from Thailand, our Thai Style Chicken Curry makes for a truly satisfying meal!

Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites.item_title: Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites
Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites.item_story_marketing:
All too often, grabbing a quick breakfast on the go can be a haphazard affair. But just because you’re pressed for time, that doesn’t mean your mornings have to be defined solely by barely-buttered toasts or hastily-mixed shakes. There’s a better way—namely, Trader Joe’s Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites. This autumnal addition to our every lineup of Egg Bites starts with a base of egg whites, cottage cheese, and asiago, to which our supplier adds a host of cubed, hearty harvest vegetables like sweet potato, onion, celery, and butternut squash, along with savory herbs and seasonings, including rosemary, sage, and white pepper.

After only a minute in the microwave (and another minute to let them cool), our Harvest Vegetable Hash Egg White Bites can easily be eaten while on the move, or savored while sitting with a cup of coffee or tea. They accessorize easily, too, with a spoonful of your favorite hot sauce, salsa, or our very own Crunchy Chili Onion. They also make an excellent breakfast sandwich when placed between two toasty English muffins.

Furikake Snack Mix.item_story_marketing:
A favorite among many Hawaiian households since at least the 1980s, the first recipes for furikake mix were traditionally made with breakfast cereal as a base. Home chefs would slather that cereal in a savory mix of dried seaweed, fish flakes, and sesame seeds (better known together as furikake), mixed together in melted butter, then bake it to a golden brown. For our take on this Hawaiian hit, we’ve omitted the fish flakes in our furikake formulation, though we’ve expanded on the crunchy base quite dramatically, as modern furikake mixes are wont to do. As such, Trader Joe’s Furikake Snack Mix contains a whole host of savory, spicy, and even sweet snack-y bits, including mochi crisps, sesame sticks, corn chips, waffle crisps, and wasabi style peas, which our supplier seasons with butter, salt, sesame seeds, seaweed, and an umami-forward mix of mushroom, garlic, and onion powder. 

This vivid variety of flavors and textures means that every handful, and even every bite within a handful, is delightfully different: sometimes you get the yielding crunch of the mochi, sometimes you get the satisfying pop and invigorating heat of a wasabi style pea, and you always get a whole lot of umami going on. We recommend bringing out a pouch of this Mix in any situation that calls for snacking: family movie nights, pool parties, or even mini-picnics at the park. We’re also big fans of serving them alongside suitably savory fare: they’re an especially excellent accompaniment to a burger, hot dog, or poke bowl.

Lemony Chicken Orzo Soup.item_story_marketing:
Like traditional chicken soup, Trader Joe’s Lemony Chicken Orzo Soup starts with a base of savory chicken broth and hearty chunks of white chicken meat. Following this flavorful foundation, a classic mirepoix of celery, carrot, and onion adds sweetness and depth. Gluten free orzo pasta made from a blend of quinoa and rice flours provides heft and body. And for extra oomph, bright lemon juice and a blend of herbs round out this light, zesty broth.

Serve with rustic breads like our chewy Ciabatta Rolls or our Olive Fougasse—its Kalamata and black olives enhance the zesty and savory flavors of the Lemony Soup. For a satisfying, Mediterranean-inspired meal, pair it with a Classic Greek Salad.

Chocolate Whipped Light Cream.item_story_marketing:
This smooth, richly-flavored treat is made with real cream and Dutch-processed cocoa powder. With 23.5% butterfat, Trader Joe's Chocolate Whipped Light Cream is richer than many similar products, which typically contain about 20% butterfat. And it couldn’t be easier to use­—simply shake well, turn upside-down, and press the nozzle to dispense.

Where do you use Chocolate Whipped Cream? Wherever you darn well please, that’s where! Pies, waffles, berries, beverages, late-night fridge visits, and pairs deliciously with chocolate-forward desserts like Gone Berry Crazy Dark Chocolate Strawberry Pieces. You’ll find Chocolate Whipped Light Cream in our dairy case, next to our other delicious whips.

Fresh Fennel.item_story_marketing: Also known in some corners of the world as sweet anise, Fennel has an aromatic, distinctly licorice-like flavor that mellows into subtle sweetness when cooked. It has layers like an onion, a crisp texture that’s often compared to celery, and fine frilly leaves that resemble dill. So, what does one do with all of that? Oh, so many wondrous things. The citrusy-flavored leaves can be used to flavor dressing or marinades. Sliced thinly and paired with red onion, orange segments and avocado, Fennel makes a great salad. It is also delicious roasted at high temperatures, and its assertive flavors also fit well in rich soups and pastas. We are fond of cutting the bulb into whole leaves and topping them simply—shaved Parmesan and a drizzle of lemon juice and olive oil, with cracked black pepper, for fresh, flavorful appetizers.

Wild Alaskan Sockeye Salmon Fillets.item_story_marketing:
Even among folks who aren’t normally fans of fish, salmon seems to be a common exception—it’s simply that tasty. Sockeye Salmon, and Wild Alaskan Sockeye in particular, is remarkably rich and meaty in texture, with a slightly mild flavor profile, and deep, coral red hue. And since Trader Joe’s Sockeye Salmon Fillets come from strictly Wild-caught, premium Salmon found in the frigid, pristine waters off the coast of Alaska, they taste deliciously clean and lightly oily (fish need fat to keep warm, after all), making them ideal for grilling, pan-searing, baking, or poaching.

For an effortless entrée, we recommend brushing a Fillet or two with olive oil or melted butter, sprinkling on a bit of salt and pepper, then cooking as desired in the broiler, air fryer, stovetop, or barbecue. It’s that easy!

Trimmed Leeks.item_story_marketing:
While leeks might not be the most widely discussed veggies around, they’re highly valued by cooks who know. In the same family of alliums that includes onions, garlic, and chives, they have a mild flavor, like a bigger, gentler, oblate scallion. At this time of year, leeks lend loveliness to fall soups and stews. You can substitute them for regular onions in casseroles, or pair them with sautéed mushrooms and roasted Potatoes. 

If you’re seeking a novel side, why not feature Trader Joe’s Trimmed Leeks at the center of their own dish? Simply brown them in a pan with a little olive oil, then braise them in a shallow pan with some chicken stock and white wine (and a pat of salted butter for good measure). You’ll be quite pleased, and so will your dinner guests!

3 Cheese Pasta with Eggplant.item_story_marketing:
For our new signature pasta, we’re borrowing a page from Nonna’s cookbook with the Sicilian dish “Pasta alla Norma.” The classic recipe usually features noodles tossed with eggplant, tomato sauce, basil, and regional cheese—simple yet elegant.
 
Our latest addition to the frozen case is a modified version of the original that adds more body and savory flavor without sacrificing taste. Trader Joe’s 3 Cheese Pasta with Eggplant’s penne pasta stays almost al dente, offering a rich and mouthwatering experience with enough vegetables to make it toothsome and hearty while still vegetarian! The layered flavor of the tomato sauce is enhanced by the creamy bechamel, complemented by mozzarella, provolone, and hard grating cheeses. Close your eyes and you just might get transported back to Nonna’s kitchen!

3 Cheese Pasta with Eggplant  comes in two single-serving paper trays that heat up beautifully in the microwave or oven, without the pasta drying out or overcooking. It makes a quick, portioned lunch or a dinner for two, ready in minutes! For a beverage pairing, consider a recommendation from Pavarotti, the Italian opera legend, who was said to have loved the original alla Norma with the chilled, sparkling red wine Medici Lambrusco Reggiano, from Northern Italy.

Antipasto Stick Prosciutto Wrapped Mozza.item_title: Antipasto Stick Prosciutto Wrapped Mozzarella Cheese
Antipasto Stick Prosciutto Wrapped Mozza.item_story_marketing:
Antipasto, which simply means “before the meal” in Italian, is traditionally an appetizer served as the first course of a formal meal. The original antipasto aims to stimulate the appetite and set the stage for the dining experience, but Trader Joe’s Antipasto Prosciutto & Mozzarella Cheese Stick can completely stave off hunger!  

These Prosciutto and Mozzarella Sticks are made with all-natural ingredients and contain no added nitrates or nitrites (except those from sea salt). They’re also packed with protein—an impressive 10 grams per serving. Now, let’s talk flavor: the mild, full-fat mozzarella cheese and the salty, delicate prosciutto ham naturally complement each other, creating a creamy, tender texture that is balanced and delicious.

If you want to go all-in on the protein, pair an Antipasto Stick with a bag of our Just A Handful of Raw Almonds. You can also pair these Sticks with TJ’s Green Olive Flats Italian Lingue Crackers for a briny bite that mimics the classic antipasto flavors of olives, meat, and cheese. Find these Sticks alongside our other ready-to-eat delights in the refrigerators.

Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam.item_title: Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches
Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam.item_story_marketing:
While some folks love nothing more than biting into a hearty crust on a sandwich, others proclaim a teary “Et tu, Mama?” when presented with a sandwich whose filling is obscured by the bread’s seemingly offensive edges. And while a ready-to-eat sandwich sans crust is not a new culinary invention by any stretch of the imagination, the ones you can find elsewhere often contain less than desirable ingredients and artificial preservatives— which is why we’re thrilled to present Trader Joe’s Crustless Peanut Butter & Strawberry Jam Sandwiches as a truly tasty alternative!

Their construction is straightforward: salted peanut butter and bright strawberry jam are encased in a chewy white bread whose crusts have been crimped and removed, sealing the sweet & salty filling inside. Simply thaw at room temperature for an hour (or in the refrigerator for two), and you’ll have a handy vegan PB&J in your hands. And because they’re kept frozen until needed, you’ll always have a PB&J handy wherever the day’s adventures take you, or when your hands and/or to-do list are otherwise full. You’ll find them in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

Antipasto Stick Salami & Pepper Jack Che.item_story_marketing:
Antipasto means “before the meal” in Italian, and traditionally it’s an appetizer served as the first course of a formal meal. The original antipasto is meant to stimulate the appetite and set the stage for the dining experience, but Trader Joe’s Antipasto Salami & Pepper Jack Sticks could stave off hunger entirely! This summer, we’re adding them to our refrigerators!

These Salami and Pepper Jack Sticks are made with all-natural ingredients, and without added nitrates or nitrites (except those from sea salt). They’re also packed with protein—an impressive 10 grams per serving. When it comes to flavor, the slightly spiced pepper Jack cheese and the salty, mild salami are natural partners; their combintion creates a creamy, tender bite. Besides being a convenient, on-the-go snack for a quick protein boost, you can also pair these Sticks with Green Olive Flats Italian Lingue Crackers for a briny bite that mimics the classic antipasto flavors of olives, meat, and cheese. Find these Sticks alongside our other ready-to-eat sliced meat and cheese snacks in our refrigerators.

Hazelnut & Cocoa Filled Crepes.item_story_marketing:
You batter believe it’s time for crepes! Crepes have long been a popular street food in France, and with that cultural catalyst, our snackable treats at Trader Joe’s are getting a majuer upgrade.

Allow us to introduce Trader Joe’s Cocoa Hazelnut Crepes, made for us by a French family bakery here in the States. Their expert bakers follow an authentic recipe using simple, wholesome ingredients. If you were to call this confection a simple “roll-up pancake,” it would be doing it a disservice. These Crepes are made with high- quality wheat flour and crafted to deliver precise thinness and texture, then filled with a smooth cocoa hazelnut creme. They’re individually wrapped for maximum freshness and snacking ability.

Enjoy at room temperature or heat for 6-8 seconds in the microwave for a more fresh-bakery vibe! These Crepes are a great out-the-door breakfast treat, handy in a snack pinch, or as a decadent dessert with a sprinkle of powdered sugar, or a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Cocoa Hazelnut Crepes on the shelves in our bakery section, every day.

Chicken Broth Concentrate.item_story_marketing:
Chicken broth is one of the handiest tools in a cook’s toolkit. It adds an ineffable depth of flavor to soups, casseroles, and rice dishes; it deglazes a pan most deliciously; it’s an indispensable ingredient in all manner of sauces and gravies—and it even makes a pretty satisfying drink in and of itself, especially when you feel a cold coming on. But like any tool, it’s only as useful as it is easily accessible. That’s what makes Trader Joe’s Chicken Broth Concentrate such an excellent addition to any culinary toolkit. Each package contains 12 shelf-stable packets of Concentrate that, when dissolved in a cup of hot water, creates a rich and aromatic Chicken Broth that’s ready to be used, right then and there, for whatever application you may need.

Convenient, easy-to-prep, and delightfully full-flavored, our Chicken Broth Concentrate is great for keeping in your pantry for whenever culinary inspiration strikes. Since it has such a savory, umami-forward profile, it’s also great for using as a seasoning, especially when crafting homemade curries, mashed potatoes, chili, or pot roast. And because it requires no refrigeration (though it should be stored somewhere cool and dry), it’s also quite portable, meaning you can take a packet on the go whenever necessary—like if you happen to need something restorative to sip on while traveling under the weather.

Tropical Smoothie Blend.item_story_marketing:
