When you’re looking to mix in a little more fruit into your daily routine, smoothies are a surefire way to do so with style. And in our estimation, adding a bit of tropical flair to the proceedings is nothing short of superlatively stylish (which should come as no surprise, if you’ve seen our preferred fashion choices.) That’s one of the reasons we’re so excited to offer Trader Joe’s Tropical Smoothie Blend in our freezers. It’s made with a mix of frozen mango, pineapple, and banana, along with cubes of frozen coconut cream, agave syrup, and purées of mango and passionfruit to add some extra body and sweetness. Once blended together, all these elements combine into a vivaciously velvety, delighftully easy-drinking Smoothie that’s tastier than the sum of it’s already-quite-notably-tasty parts.

Here’s another reason we’re excited to carry this Tropical Smoothie Blend: it’s super easy to prep! Simply measure out a cup of the Smoothie Blend, add a 1/2 cup of water or milk—or your favorite non-dairy beverage—and blend to your desired smoothness. If you want to give it a little extra textural oomph (not to mention a bit of protein), you can always add a 1/4 cup of your favorite TJ’s yogurt in, too. Now that’s a stylish Smoothie!

Spaghetti with Meat & Sauce.item_story_marketing:
What’s more comforting than a bowl of pasta and meat sauce? How about a bowl of pasta and meat sauce you didn’t have to cook yourself, that microwaves in mere minutes? This is just what you’ll get with Trader Joe’s Spaghetti with Meat & Sauce, the latest and greatest everyday find in our freezers.

Simple yet satisfying, this rib-sticking dish is comfort food at its finest. Our Canadian supplier makes their own Spaghetti in house using a bronze die (which helps the Sauce cling to the al dente noodles). And that Sauce? Hearty and tangy, it’s brimming with tomatoes and the classic combination of beef and pork to create a rich, savory bite. The Sauce’s meaty, pleasantly garlicky notes are further complemented with a bit of sharp Romano cheese to recreate the quintessential pasta parlor experience.

Each tray of Spaghetti with Meat & Sauce easily serves one (with 27 grams of protein to boot!), for about a third of the cost of takeout. Ideal for lunch or dinner al desko, it doesn’t hurt to keep a couple of trays in the freezer—you can serve them alongside a freshly tossed Complete Caesar Salad and Garlic & Cheese Breadsticks when you need a weeknight dinner on the double for a small group.

Baladi Egyptian Sourdough Pocket Bread.item_story_marketing:
Flatbreads are among the most enduring recipes within the entire global culinary canon, and for very good reason. They’re simple to make, satisfying to eat, and play a rather practical part at the dinner table, acting as a scoop for dips, a pocket for veggies and proteins, or a base for an impromptu pizza. It’s no wonder then, that flatbreads like Egyptian baladi have been a staple starch for an estimated 4,000 years. In tribute to this staggeringly lengthy tradition, we now offer Trader Joe’s Baladi Egyptian Sourdough Pocket Bread in our freezers.

Made for us by a supplier in Egypt, these versatile (and vegan) Baladi Pocket Breads take only a matter of minutes in the conventional oven, or mere seconds in the micowave, before they’re puffed up, toasty, and ready to eat. Once heated, they have a tasty, slightly tangy Sourdough tinge to their flavor profile, and are ideal for stuffing with your favorite fillings. We’re partial to going with a classic combo of Falafel, chopped cucumbers, and our Garlic Spread-Dip (especially if you want to keep things vegan), though they’re equally excellent when stuffed with our Gyros or Shawarma Chicken Thighs, too. And, of course, you can just serve them for dipping in hummus or tahini, as they do in Egypt.

3 Cheese Spinach & Artichoke Pasta.item_story_marketing:
For anyone who’s ever enjoyed our Creamy Spinach & Artichoke Dip as an appetizer, and mused to themselves “I could make a meal out of this,” we have fantastic news: we did make a meal out of it! In fact, we made a super satisfying, easy-to-prep entrée that combines the comfort-food creaminess of a classic spinach-artichoke dip with the textural excellence of al dente orecchiette pasta. And now, Trader Joe’s 3 Cheese Spinach & Artichoke Pasta is available every day in our freezers, to meet all your weeknight dinner or work lunch needs.

Deeply savory and delightfully hearty, this quick-cooking Pasta dish is smothered with a sauce made with Swiss, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheeses, as well as tender Artichoke chunks and Spinach leaves. After just a few minutes in the microwave or conventional oven, it makes a superb single-serving entrée that pairs particularly well with a leafy green salad or a hunk of crusty bread. Of course, if you want to be especially true to its appetizer-y origins, you could always break out a few tortilla chips for scooping, too.

Cinnamon Buns.item_story_marketing: You might say we’ve been on a roll when it comes to highlighting high-quality Danish pastry on our bakery shelves. And rolling into your neighborhood Trader Joe’s this summer are none other than our ready-to-eat Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Buns! Made by the trusted Danish bakers who craft our beloved Cinammon Twist these decadent Buns are part of a long baking tradition of sweet buns from Northern Europe. Our expert bakers start with a soft, yeasted dough that undergoes an intense, hours-long mixing and rising process. Then, these bouncy Buns are given their signature swirl of cinnamon-molasses gooeyness, baked to a golden brown and then generously topped with cream cheese frosting. If you’re in a hurry, just eat from the package! If you have more time, enjoy them as part of a luxurious breakfast spread—pair with a savory egg and sausage scramble with our Maple Chicken Breakfast Sausage, a fresh Greek parfait with seasonal berries, and a cup of Trader Joe’s Joe Light Roast Ground Coffee.

Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth.item_story_marketing: Ideal for warm winter meals and early spring soups, Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth is fully cooked, ready to heat and serve. The recipe begins with organically grown veggies like carrots, celery, onion, leeks, and tomatoes. These veggies, along with a carefully selected assortment of spices, are slow simmered in small batches to create broth that’s simultaneously light and incredibly rich in flavor. Use our Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth to make soups or stews, in place of milk & butter in mashed potatoes, or as a substitute for meat-based broths in gravies and sauces. For a quick winter warm-up, heat a cup of Broth and serve with crusty bread or your favorite croutons. It’s gluten free and fat free, and only 40mg of sodium per serving. You’ll find each resealable 32 fluid-ounce container of Trader Joe’s Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth in our grocery aisle, every day next to our other soups and broths.

Organic Black Pepper Barilotti Pasta.item_story_marketing:
We found a pasta supplier in Italy that has mastered the art of flavored pasta! How do we know? Well, they already make Trader Joe’s Organic Lemon Torchiette, and if you’ve tried it, you know the lemon really shines. Now, they’re making our Organic Black Pepper Barilotti Pasta, and we’re excited for customers to get a taste!

Barilotti means “barrel” in Italian, which makes sense when you see these pasta curls that resemble little ribbed casks. Organic Black Pepper, Organic durum wheat semolina, and water are formed into dough and cut with a bronze die. Together, the traditional recipe and bronze die-cut method yield a high-texture, rustic noodle shape. After boiling in water for 10-11 minutes, this thick, al dente Pasta becomes pleasantly chewy, with a spicy, almost citrusy Black Pepper flavor that pairs well with nearly any sauce you can imagine.

Try it with our Alfredo, or Caro Sugo Italian Tomato Basil Sauce. Black Pepper Barilotti is also delicious in a cold pasta salad, tossed with halved Mini Heirloom Tomatoes, Fresh Mozzarella Pearls, Fresh Organic Basil, and some Organic Italian Dressing with Romano Cheese.

Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Seeds Pepitas S.item_title: Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Seeds Pepitas Salsa Macha
Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Seeds Pepitas S.item_story_marketing:
Salsa macha is a condiment of Mexican origin that’s less like a tomato salsa, and more like a chili oil, similar in some respects to Trader Joe’s Crunchy Chili Onion [sku 62480]. On a recent trip to Oaxaca, one of our buyers discovered a delicious version of salsa macha in a local market that exchanged the typical peanut base for a trio of seeds. This became the inspiration for Trader Joe’s Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha!

Crunchy Salsa Macha has almost all of its ingredients listed on the front of the label. All that’s left to mention on the back is olive oil, garlic powder, Pequin chile peppers, and salt. Just by its makeup, you can surmise that it has a lively texture, with its nutty trio of Sesame seeds, Sunflower Seeds and Pepitas (aka pumpkin seeds). The seeds are suspended in olive oil that’s further enlivened by some spicy, Pequin chiles, which have their origin in Mexico where this salsa is made for us.

This versatile condiment has so many yummy uses, including (but not limited to): dipping bread and tortilla chips; drizzling over tacos, roasted veggies, and pizza; adding to salad dressings and soups; marinating poultry or beef; using as a cooking oil for frying eggs; replacing garlic butter on your toasted bread... We would even go so far as to say that Trader Joe’s Salsa Macha creates a tantalizing dessert atop a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream! Every day, you’ll find six-ounce jars of Trader Joe’s multi-purpose Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha in our condiment aisle.

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Let’s focus on cinnamon! As an essential fall flavor, cinnamon sometimes gets buried in a list of pumpkin spices, but in the case of our new Mini Cinnamon Sugar Cookies, Cinnamon is the superstar of the cookie show!

These Mini Cinnamon Sugar Cookies are bite-sized, golden-brown rounds, similar in size to our Mini Chocolate Chip Cookies. They are delightfully crisp and crunchy, and their simple recipe imparts classic Sugar-Cookie flavor, which is enhanced by a generous dusting of cinnamon and coarse sugar on top. They come in a single-serving package, so they’re ideal for packing in a school lunch, toting in your purse or backpack, or stowing in your desk drawer for whenever a sweet Cinnamon craving hits. And not only can you enjoy them in autumn, but you can also enjoy them all year long.

Dark Chocolate Covered Cashews.item_story_marketing:
Perhaps you’ve found yourself strolling in the aisles of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and wondered, “are they ever going to run out of things to cover in chocolate?” Rest assured, dear reader, we’ve hardly scratched the surface of our chocolate-covering capabilities. And it’s a good thing, too, because that means that we have many more gems like Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Cashews to look forward to. Sweet, crunchy, and fantastically full-flavored, they’re made for us by an expert supplier, who starts with raw Cashews, roasts them ‘til they’re lightly browned, then covers them in a thin layer of sweet, caramel-y, confectionary coating. After that’s cooled, they coat them all in a more substantial layer of rich Dark Chocolate, creating a captivating candy treat that can be enjoyed in any and all sweet-snacking contexts.

An ideal movie snack, a fun mini-dessert for a school or work lunch, and a great inclusion for homemade trail or bridge mixes, we especially like pairing our Dark Chocolate Covered Cashews with a cup of hot coffee or a glass of red wine. And if you’re looking to zhuzh up something already sweet, look no further: some roughly chopped Dark Chocolate Covered Cashews will add depths of flavor to a homemade fruit salad, sundae, or tray of brownies.

Steamed & Peeled Baby Beets.item_story_marketing: We invite you to march to the Beet of your own drum at Trader Joe’s—and what better way to do that than with Trader Joe’s Steamed & Peeled Baby Beets? True to their name, these terrific time-savers are Peeled and cooked—Steamed in a sealed pouch, specifically, to retain their starry nutritional profile—ready to enjoy right out of the package. You might say they’ll help you Beet the clock when dinner’s on the horizon. There’s only one ingredient inside every package; baby Beets from the Normandy region of France—now, doesn’t that just Beet all? They’re terrific in salads, and if you want to enjoy them warm, simply heat them in the microwave (heating instructions are on the package) and add to a mélange of other veggies, soups or stews. You’ll never miss a Beet with these Babies!

Organic Ranch Dressing.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Organic Ranch Dressing first arrived in our stores in 2016, after months of thoughtful development. Our goal was to create an entirely Organic Ranch Dressing that included none of the artificial ingredients used in other national brands. But we didn’t sacrifice taste; on the contrary, we insisted upon it! This Dressing has a classic Ranch flavor profile, with the likes of garlic and onion purées, ground mustard seed, black pepper, and parsley (all Organic) complementing its velvety, tangy buttermilk base. Herby and rich, it can be enjoyed across an impressively wide range of eating occasions.

Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Cru.item_title: Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers
Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Cru.item_story_marketing:
Applesauce has been delighting snacky children and adults for centuries, and since people started packaging it for sale, it’s been delivered in jars, tins, and even tiny little tubs. We love the jars and tubs of applesauce in our stores, and we have a special place in our heart for the innovative design behind Trader Joe’s Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers. Enjoyed by kids and the young at heart alike, these conveniently Crush-able containers hold a mix of Organic Strawberry purée blended with Organic Apple purée, for a smooth, easy-squeezy, phenomenally fruity eating experience.

Great for school lunches, quick snacks, and all sorts of general on-the-go enjoyment, our Organic Apple Strawberry Fruit Sauce Crushers are a must-have for back-to-school season.

Uncured Pepperoni Pizza.item_story_marketing: Our crust-conscious supplier starts with wheat-flour dough that is allowed to rise for a full 24 hours before it’s hand-stretched and topped. Then the Pizza is spread with a simple, savory tomato sauce, and topped with a blend of mozzarella, provolone, and Parmigiano Reggiano—and finally crowned with slices of savory, Uncured Pepperoni. Oak and beech from the mountains between Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany are used to fuel wood burning ovens in which the pies are pre-baked at about 750°F. They’re finally frozen and sent to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, so you can heat & eat an authentic Uncured Pepperoni Pizza whenever you like!

Vanilla Flavored Cold Foam Creamer.item_story_marketing:
With an already impressive roster of coffee creamers in our dairy case (Oat Brown Sugar Creamer, Coconut & Almond Vanilla Creamer, et. al), you might think we would just sit back, rest on our laurels, and phone it in. No way. Instead, our intrepid product developers have decided to foam it in, with the exciting introduction of Trader Joe’s Cold Foam Vanilla Flavored Creamer!

This whipped cream-style can dispenses Grade A, kosher Cold Foam made with a combination of pasteurized skim milk and pasteurized cream that’s sweetened with cane sugar and imbued with natural Vanilla flavor. Lighter and airier than whipped cream, it’s not unlike a celebratory crown for your favorite TJ’s Cold Brew or Tropical Dragonfruit Cooler. Chill the can in your fridge, and when you’re ready, shake it well, turn it upside down, and press the nozzle to dispense to your heart’s content.

Chocolate Vanilla Creme Joe-Joe's 4 pk.item_story_marketing:
Velvety whipped crème filling. Crunchy chocolate cookies. Delectably dunkable. You’d be hard-pressed to find a negative description of Joe-Joe’s Chocolate Vanilla Creme Sandwich Cookies. It is, however, admittedly difficult to tote a package of these Cookies in your lunch bag or backpack—which is why we’ve created a smaller, more portable package that can put Joe-Joe’s Chocolate Vanilla Creme Sandwich Cookies conveniently within arm’s reach, no matter where you are! 

Filled with four of the same delicious, customer-favorite Cookies as their counterparts in the full-size package, this new offering makes it easy to keep a fresh package of Joe-Joe’s in your lunch box, backpack, desk drawer, pants pocket, glove compartment… you get the idea. The compact nature of this new package also makes it ideal for handing out as a birthday party favor or classroom reward. Or, grab a bunch of them for Halloween handouts and Christmas stocking stuffers! Can you tell we’re excited about these?!

Vanilla Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Co.item_title: Vanilla Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Cones
Vanilla Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Co.item_story_marketing:
First introduced in our freezers in 2011, Trader Joe's Vanilla Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Cones have become one of our most popular products of all time, and for good reason: they're delicious! Each mini sugar cone is lined with a rich, chocolatey coating to help ensure maximum “cone life” (yes, that’s a real term), then filled with teeny-tiny scoop of rich, high-quality vanilla ice cream. Finally, the Mini Ice Cream Cones are dipped—upside down, no less—in that same chocolatey coating that lines the cones, and the result is an all-occasion ice cream treat to remember! 
 
Snatch one of these Mini Ice Cream Cones (or three) out of the freezer whenever your sweet tooth calls. At under 100 calories each, they are easily worth the indulgence. Or, if you’re in the mood to share, they’re perfect for parties. Break open a box at your next baby shower, birthday party, graduation banquet, et. al, then sit back, relax, and watch your guests all clamor to Hold the Cone(s)!

Hot Honey Popcorn.item_story_marketing:
If the rise in popularity of hot honey has taught us anything, it’s that sweet and heat are truly meant to be together. Why? Because like any good complementary combo, sugar and spice simply bring out the best in one another. Take their co-starring turn in Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Popcorn, for instance. Set against the backdrop of a light, airy, and wonderfully buttery kernel of Popcorn, the sweetness of Honey powder brings the heat of Hot cayenne pepper into focus, while at the same, the spicy notes round out the sweetness, so that neither element overpowers the other. Talk about teamwork!

Savory, salty, sweet, and spicy, all at once, Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Popcorn eats a bit like kettle corn with a capsaicin-loaded twist. We find that it’s ideal for all sorts of snacking situations, and especially excels when employed as a movie snack. We recommend pouring some into a bowl and mixing it with even more sweet and spicy treats, like our Bite-Sized Candy Coated Milk Chocolate Candies or Thai Lime & Chili Cashews. And if you really want to double down on the heat-sweet synthesis, you can always mix in some of our Sweet & Spicy Pecans.

Strawberry Ice Cream.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, we don’t take ourselves too seriously, but we take the work we do very seriously. When it came time to create what is now Trader Joe’s Strawberry Ice Cream, our product developer spent months tinkering with the recipe to ensure it delivered the ideal balance of creamy, velvety goodness and bright, fruit-forward personality of Strawberry season. The Ice Cream’s cheerful pink color comes courtesy of fruit & vegetable juices (unlike others found elsewhere colored with artificial ingredients), and is made with milk from cows not treated with rBST. What more could one want in a cone (or bowl, or cup)? 

The Super Premium designation on this Ice Cream is a particular point of pride—to achieve it, an ice cream must have less than 50% overrun. Overrun refers to the amount of air whipped into the ice cream during the churning process – lower overrun equals richer, denser ice cream. We can’t reveal the exact percentage of overrun in this pint, but we can guarantee it’s significantly less than 50%! Since the proof is truly in the eating, pick up a pint of Strawberry Ice Cream at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and taste for yourself!

Crunchy Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins.item_title: Crunchy Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins
Crunchy Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins.item_story_marketing:
You never know when a craving for chocolate may strike. If you’re anything like us, for example, a craving for Colombian milk chocolate might strike you quite frequently. And when it comes to lightly salted Colombian milk chocolate, embedded with crunchy bits of caramelized candy, you may just find yourself in a state of being perpetually craving-struck. That’s why we always like to have a bag of Trader Joe’s Crunchy Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins on hand. Crafted for us by an expert Colombian supplier, these individually wrapped Thins are perfectly proportioned for providing a quick, satisfying mix of salty and sweet, as well as a marvelous melt-in- the-mouth texture, in every balanced bite.

Within the world of chocolate, Colombian cocoa is celebrated for its fruity notes and relatively subtle sweetness. Here, those elements are especially allowed to shine in contrast with the Sea Salt and the crispy, toffee-like texture of the caramelized candy bits throughout. In addition to making a delicious (and highly shareable, we might add) anytime sweet treat, we find that it makes a particularly great pairing for a creamy, full-flavored cheese (like our sweet White Stilton with Apricots). And for an elevated afternoon pick-me-up, these Milk Chocolate & Sea Salt Thins are ideal for cutting through the acidity of a cup of Colombia Supremo Coffee.

Frosted Flakes Cereal.item_story_marketing:
Remember those Saturday mornings of yore, hunkering down to watch some cartoons with a big bowl of cereal at the ready? Well, we’ll let you in on a little secret: there’s nothing stopping you from recreating those moments for your kids, or yourself. In fact, we’ve got just the cereal to facilitate doing so: Trader Joe’s Frosted Flakes. Made with crispy, crunchy corn flakes that have been fortified with a suite of vitamins like niacin and folate, and sweetened with a light layer of sugar—not high fructose corn syrup, we should add.
 
Simply pour yourself a bowl with chilled milk or your favorite non-dairy beverage, accessorize as desired with sliced strawberries, bananas, or peaches, and get ready to create (or recreate) some truly magical morning memories. With their captivatingly crunchy texture and delightfully sweet (but certainly not too sweet) taste, they’re great for quick weekday breakfasts and more relaxed weekend cartoon watch-alongs alike. And for a non-breakfast application, we also find that our Frosted Flakes are great for baking, mixing into ice cream sundaes, or even using as a breading for chicken breasts or pork schnitzel.

Organic Corn Flakes Cereal.item_story_marketing:
Call us corny, but breakfast really is the most important meal of the day. It’s a great opportunity to build a solid foundation for your day, and, like most important things, sometimes the simpler, the better. Take Trader Joe’s Organic Corn Flakes Cereal, for example. (It’s back!) Made with five simple ingredients—organic corn grits, organic cane sugar, organic malted barley extract, sea salt, and organic sunflower lecithin—it’s got everything you need to get your morning started off right. (Except coffee—you’re on your own there.)

You can enjoy your Organic Corn Flakes traditionally, in a bowl with a bit of milk or non-dairy beverage poured over them. Or, you can mix things up a bit with the addition of sliced bananas & fresh blueberries. Or, you could really up your Corn Flake cred. by smashing them into a crispy coating for French toast!  Just please, whatever you do, don’t flake on breakfast. Breakfast needs you. You need breakfast. You need Trader Joe’s Organic Corn Flakes.

Fresh Mozzarella Cheese Log.item_story_marketing:
This is a product that really makes us want to have a Caprese salad for lunch. Or dinner. And because Trader Joe’s Fresh Mozzarella Log is so fresh and so easy to use, making that salad will be easier than ever. Inside the package are slices of fresh mozzarella, perfectly sized to perch atop a substantial slice of tomato, and longing to be topped with a basil leaf. Instant Insalata Caprese, no cheese slicing required. Each package contains 16 ounces of Fresh Mozzarella, crafted with milk from cows – primarily from Idaho’s fertile Treasure Valley – not treated with rBST. The cheese is mild and milky and fresh-tasting, as a good Fresh Mozzarella should always be.

When it comes time to craft that Caprese, be sure to pick up a Basil Plant and some Organic Tomatoes on the Vine, and some good olive oil & balsamic vinegar to round out the recipe (you could also choose from the myriad dressing options you’ll find on our grocery shelves or in our refrigerator case). Of course, you can also use this pre-sliced Fresh Mozzarella Log for panini, pizza, or cut into smaller pieces to toss into a salad.

Mandarin Orange Chicken.item_story_marketing: The secret to Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken’s success is in its simplicity, really. Tender chunks of juicy chicken in a crispy breading with a sweet and spicy orange sauce… what’s not to love? And here’s our favorite way to prepare it: bake the chicken in a 400º oven; when the chicken is cooked through, add the sauce to a skillet or wok; once the sauce is hot, add the chicken and toss together until the sauce adheres to the chicken and caramelizes a bit. You can also microwave the sauce and toss it with the chicken, but we think the little bit of extra effort pays off handsomely. Serve with rice and veggies for a complete meal that doesn’t take much time to prepare, and delivers big flavors at a small price.

Carnival Fun Cake Fries.item_story_marketing:
Step right up, step right up—behold, the sweet spectacle that is Trader Joe’s Carnival Fun Cake Fries! To create this tasty take on everyone’s favorite fairground fare, we start by whipping up a classic funnel cake batter (think pancake batter, only richer... and possibly wearing a party hat). Then, portion by portion, we pipe the batter through an extruder and into a vat of hot oil, where it sizzles and transforms into golden and delightfully dippable fry-shaped treats. They’re crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, and ready to steal the show—a Carnival classic reimagined! 

Perhaps best of all, there’s no waiting in line for these Fun Cake Fries. Simply heat them in your oven or air fryer according to the package instructions, then dress them up as you please! Sprinkle them with Organic Powdered Sugar. Drizzle them with Organic Midnight Moo Chocolate Syrup. Top them with sliced strawberries and whipped cream. Take them for a dip in a dunk tank filled with Cocoa Almond Spread or Cookie ButteR. Or go full tilt and top them with hefty scoops of ice cream! Whether you’re looking to evoke evenings on the boardwalk or throw a three-ring snack circus right in the middle of your kitchen, our Fun Cake Fries are just the ticket. But keep in mind, the Carnival won’t be in town forever—you’ll find Trader Joe’s Carnival Fun Cake Fries in our freezers now through August.

All the Things Cookies.item_story_marketing:
If Trader Joe’s All the Things Cookies literally contained ALL the things, they would be very large. Instead, we’ve gone for more figurative interpretation, meaning, these Cookies are loaded with good stuff—All the Things required for an amazing cookie encounter. 

The base is a butter Cookie. (We do mean this literally!) Butter is the second ingredient (after flour), and makes up 24%—almost a quarter of the recipe. A variety of fun, multi-textured Things are mixed into the Cookie dough before baking, including corn flakes, pretzels, marshmallows, semisweet chocolate chips, and crispy rice. Once baked, these circular, golden-brown confections entice with a sweet, buttery aroma. Each crunchy bite may lead to a piece of salted pretzel, or a cluster of rich chocolate chips. The marshmallows have taken on an almost toffee-like candy character. And the corn flakes and crispy rice bring a lighter, crisp crunch to the whole experience. 

All the Things Cookies are available all the time—and we mean this literally, too! Every day, you’ll find nine- ounce tubs of about 14 cookies alongside all the rest of our delicious and varied Trader Joe’s cookies.

Ode to the Classic Potato Chip.item_title: Ode to the Classic Potato Chip
Ode to the Classic Potato Chip.item_story_marketing: There’s nothing better than a classic…like your parent’s old station wagon (you know the one)- with the wood paneling; or those great chips you used to eat when you were growing up. Well, because you asked for it, you got it. The perfect chip! Trader Joe’s Ode to the Classic Potato Chip. These chips are lightly fried, seasoned with salt, and full of that great potato taste. Just like you remember them.

Fried Shallots.item_story_marketing:
Shall we list everything we love about Trader Joe’s Fried Shallots? Let’s! First, we love that they’re made for us by an esteemed supplier in Thailand, who specializes in crispy-fried veggies like these. Second, we love that these crispy, crunchy, super savory and richly aromatic bits of Fried Shallot provide an awesome pop of texture and flavor to practically any dish. Third, we love that they’re vegan, meaning even more folks can get in on the Fried Shallot fun. And fourth, we love that they’re available on an everyday basis at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Of course, that’s just the start of all the things we love about this versatile, tasty topper. We also love that sprinkling of Trader Joe’s Fried Shallots will spruce up a salad, soup, or chili-laden baked potato. We adore how they wake up the flavors of a weeknight casserole or slice of leftover pizza. We’re utterly taken with the texture they add when used as a topping for a taco, burger, or sandwich. And we’d be remiss if we didn’t mention how head over heels we are over their uses in savory baking, homemade appetizer dips, or, when given a spin in the food processor, as super flavorful breading for a chicken cutlet.

Mini Pretzel Twists.item_story_marketing:
If you think of the modern snacking scene as a sports team, miniature pretzels would be the ultimate team player. Unflashy and endlessly dependable, the miniature pretzel is always there to offer support in all kinds of snacking situations, from movie watching, to school lunch supplementing, to idly munching while enjoying a cocktail or ice cold beer. And among the modern miniature pretzel scene, Trader Joe’s Mini Pretzel Twists are true MVPs. Made with a carefully calibrated ratio of wheat flour, malted barley flour, oil, yeast, and salt, these superlatively crisp and crunchy Twists consistently deliver a simple, yet satisfyingly savory eating experience.

Great for eating solo or serving alongside a refreshing beverage, Trader Joe’s Mini Pretzel Twists have a resoundingly airy crunch to complement their classically malty and salty flavor profile. We particularly like pairing them with a nice sandwich or burger, they’re great when crumbled over an ice cream sundae or blitzed in a blender to create a cheesecake crust, and also scoop up dips with aplomb. Try using one to scoop up a bit of Unexpected Cheddar Spread, and you’ll see what we mean.

Korean Japchae Fried Rice.item_story_marketing:
Originally invented in the Joseon Dynasty as a royal dish, reserved for official banquets and state dinners, japchae is still associated with celebrations in modern-day Korea, and is often served at birthdays, weddings, and other formal festivities. Way back in the 17th century, it was primarily a veggie-based stir fry (“japchae” itself simply translates to “mixed vegetables”). It wasn’t until the 1900s that sweet potato-based glass noodles, a product of culinary cross-pollination from China, made their way into the dish, to make Japchae what we know today. All of which is to say, though japchae may have changed over the years, it’s still a celebration- worthy dish that’s emphatically fit for royalty.

Coming to us straight from a supplier in Korea, Trader Joe’s Japchae Fried Rice recontextualizes this iconic entrée into something even heartier and homier. It’s made with a base of white rice and glass noodles, along with a mix of thinly sliced shiitake mushrooms, cabbage, peppers, onions, and carrots, all of which are seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil. After just a few minutes in the microwave or on the stovetop, it serves up beautifully, offering rich aromas, savory and umami flavors, and a wide spectrum of tender textures. And for an extra special treat, we especially like it topped with a freshly fried egg.

Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies.item_story_marketing:
Candy is associated with all kinds of fun activities: going to the movies, taking a road trip, trick-or-treating... We think that a candy’s character should match the fun it promotes, and Trader Joe’s Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies have a fun factor that is off the charts!

What makes these Candies so fun? For starters—just look at them... The bite-sized puffs look like they’re attending a hippie jam-band concert! Of note is the fact that all those bright and beautiful pastel-toned colors are the result of natural ingredients, including: spirulina, paprika, vegetable juice, turmeric, and fruit juice. (In case you’re wondering, you can’t taste the paprika, turmeric, and other hue-inducing ingredients.)

But these Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies don’t just look fun, they are fun! Pop a couple of these airy, Freeze Dried puffs in your mouth and you’ll experience a delicate crunch that quickly retreats as they melt, revealing big, bold, sweet, tangy, and slightly sour flavors. And the fun doesn’t end there! As they melt, these Candies gently fizz on your tongue. Another fun fact? You’ll find Trader Joe’s Watermelon Freeze Dried Candies on our shelves, every day.

Fruitful Medley.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Fresh Cut Fruitful Medley is the fresh cut fruit embodiment of “the whole is greater than the sum of its parts”—but it’s worth mentioning that its individual parts are pretty great, too! Juicy chunks of sweet cantaloupe, fragrant honeydew, and tropical pineapple commingle with plump, red grapes to create an array of fruit flavors that’s ready to enjoy right out of its recloseable tub. This makes it unbelievably easy to incorporate more fruit into your daily diet, whether that means meticulous meal planning, or simply eating it right out of the aforementioned tub while standing in front of the refrigerator.

Organic Baby Red Butter Lettuce & Baby A.item_title: Organic Baby Red Butter Lettuce & Baby Arugula
Organic Baby Red Butter Lettuce & Baby A.item_story_marketing: When making a salad from scratch, it’s important to begin with a good bed of leafy greens. And when you’re looking for just the right leaves to save you some green, we say: leave it to the produce pros at Trader Joe’s! We’ve got a wide selection of superior salad greens in our refrigerators for remarkably reasonable retails, and Trader Joe’s Organic Baby Red Butter Lettuce & Baby Arugula are among the best of them. Each bag contains a roughly equal ratio of fresh, Organic leaves of tender Baby Red Butter Lettuce and Baby Arugula, which are pre-washed and ready-to-use, right away. Amazing! Now, making a salad at home has never been faster, easier, or had more delicious results. Simply toss this Baby Butter Lettuce and Arugula with your favorite toppings and dressing (and maybe a protein, if you’d like to make it more of an entrée salad), and you’re ready to go! We find that the mildly earthy sweetness of the Butter Lettuce makes an excellent complement to the pepperiness of the Arugula, and that together, their combination makes an excellent complement to a tangy vinaigrette or creamy ranch, in turn.

Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar.item_title: Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar
Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar.item_story_marketing:
Inside the resealable zipper pouch you’ll find only one ingredient – Fair Trade Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar. Grown on sugar plantations by our suppliers, the sugar cane is cut by hand, then delivered to the mill where the juice is simply crushed from the cane. The evaporation process produces perfect sugar crystals, retaining some of the original molasses, giving its subtle caramel flavor and light, golden-brown color. Turbinado sugar is also known as Raw Sugar because it’s minimally processed (this is the raw-est form of cane sugar you’ll get – completely raw cane sugar is not suitable for consumption).

This Cane Sugar can be easily substitutable for brown sugar. Make a cinnamon streusel with 2 tablespoon of TJ’s Turbinado Sugar and 2 teaspoons of TJ’s Ground Cinnamon for cakes or cupcakes. For frosting, start with a cup of TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar and your choice of milk, then keep adding 1 tablespoon Turbinado Sugar until your desired thickness of frosting. Or sprinkle with chopped pecans if you desire a bit of a sweet n’ salty crunch. You’ll even love it as a body, foot, or face exfoliant that you can scrub, rinse and repeat! It smells delightful and works wonders. Still need further convincing? It’s vegan, kosher certified, Fair Trade, and it’s a tremendous value for a two-pound resealable bag. You’ll find it in our grocery aisle.

Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo Salsa.item_title: Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo Salsa
Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo Salsa.item_story_marketing:
Pico de gallo might just be the ideal condiment. Something about that classic combination of diced tomatoes, onions, and jalapeños, along with refreshing lime juice and cilantro srikes such a balance of savory flavors, alluring aromatics, and delicate heat that it verges on the sublime. So, how does one improve on such perfection? One way we’ve found is by introducing another element of flavor that complements and builds on pico de gallo’s considerable strengths—like, say, fresh tropical fruit. It’s a theory we’ve put into practice with Trader Joe’s Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo Salsa, a delighfully multidimensional addition to our fresh salsa selections. 

With all the same familiar flavors and tender textures present in a standard salsa fresca, plus the sweet, tropical, and juicy notes of chopped Mango and Pineapple, this piquant Pico increasingly expands upon the palate with each bite. While that quality makes it a great choice for serving with your favorite TJ’s tortilla chips, it also makes it spectacularly suited for serving over seafood. In fact, we heartily recommend our Mango Pineapple Pico de Gallo as a topping for everything from fish tacos and air-fried salmon to baked cod, Panko Breaded Tilapia, and grilled shrimp skewers.

Chocolate Croissants.item_story_marketing:
In order to understand what makes Trader Joe's Chocolate Croissants so special, it's important to examine 
the way that they're made. Our supplier, a highly regarded bakery in South San Francisco, makes the dough  
in a completely refrigerated environment, which helps prevent proofing before bake time. As part of the 
fermentation process, the dough is allowed to mature for 8 to 10 hours to develop full flavor. Then, each 
Croissant is hand rolled and layered using a traditional French laminating technique. Twenty-four thin layers 
of dough are layered with butter, and in the center of each pastry goes a special semi-sweet chocolate baton.

During baking, the butter melts, resulting in a flaky, buttery pastry-golden brown, crisp, and slightly bubbly 
on the outside with a soft, airy crumb (interior). Of course, the middle presents a melty bite of chocolate. Our 
Chocolate Croissants are fantastic right out of the package, or warmed up just a little. Enjoy with an espresso 
and a banana for breakfast. Or, warm one up in the afternoon for a sweet treat.

Italian Pistachio & Fior di Latte Gelato.item_title: Italian Pistachio & Fior di Latte Gelato Style Frozen Dessert
Italian Pistachio & Fior di Latte Gelato.item_story_marketing:
One of our favorite things about gelato, aside from its superlatively soft and creamy texture, is how well its various flavors tend to play off one another. Is there anything better than going to a gelato shop and picking out two complementary flavors to enjoy in the same cup? Well, how about a whole tub containing two complementary flavors? Because that’s exactly what you’ll find in Trader Joe’s Italian Pistachio & Fior di Latte Gelato Style Frozen Dessert, available in our freezers from June through August. It’s brought to us by an esteemed Italian supplier, who fills each tub with a 50/50 split of rich & nutty Pistachio and pure & simple Fior di Latte, so you can mix, match, and enjoy in any combination you’d like.

Italian for “flower of milk,” you might consider Fior di Latte to be gelato in its most unadulterated state, emphasizing just the subtly sweet and lush flavor of milk, itself. A staple of Italian gelaterias, we find that it makes a phenomenal foil to the bolder, toasty, semi-savory notes of Pistachio. Wonderful when enjoyed together or seperately, this delectable duo serves spectularly well right out of the tub, stuns when sandwiched between two cookies, and makes an unforgettable affogato when topped with a shot of espresso.

Hot Honey Fudge.item_story_marketing:
At its core, English fudge has a remarkably simple formulation: it’s basically just milk, sugar, and butter cooked together until it turns solid, crumbly, and delicious. And yet, you can absolutely tell the difference when someone who really knows what they’re doing makes fudge. That simplicity turns into an absolute asset, allowing fudge to become a vehicle for all sorts of disparate flavors and sensations. In the case of Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Fudge, for instance, we turned to a supplier from the U.K. whose fudge expertise is second to none. They flavor this rich and buttery Fudge with sweet and ever-so-slightly floral Honey that’s been spiced with Hot chili pepper extract, making every bite a superlatively satisfying exercise in toothsome textures, sugar-y sweet notes, and gently escalating peppery heat.

Great for enjoying as a quick, summer-y sweet treat, or as part of a more elaborate dessert spread, our Hot Honey Fudge is available in our stores June through August. It’s a great gift option for any friends or family who enjoy a little heat with their sweet. And we particularly enjoy pairing with a hot coffee, an iced milk tea, or even a glass of whiskey.

Seasoned Lamb Shoulder Rack.item_story_marketing:
Whether you’re in need of a striking center-of-the-plate option for a big family feast, or just something dependably delicious for weeknight dinners and meal prep, Trader Joe’s always has a plethora of proteins at the ready. Take, for instance, Trader Joe’s Seasoned Lamb Shoulder Rack. Made with Lamb sourced from Australia, each of these hearty, hefty Shoulder Racks comes pre-Seasoned with a mix of sesame seeds and aromatic herbs, which means that that they’re ready to cook just as soon as you bring them at home. And it also means that it’s never been easier to have a texturally tender, superbly savory-spiced protein prepped for whatever kind of meal you’re working with.

Speaking of being ready-to-cook, we find that this Lamb Shoulder Rack is particularly great when grilled on the barbecue or roasted in the oven. In fact, we heartily recommend slow-roasting this Rack for an especially tender bite: about two and a half hours at 300°F should give you the best results. From there, you’re free to accessorize with your favorite sides, like some buttery mashed potatoes, sweet potato au gratin, air-fried asparagus, or dreamy creamed spinach.

Unexpected Broccoli Cheddar Soup.item_story_marketing:
Here’s an unexpected twist: we’ve improved the recipe on our Unexpected Broccoli Cheddar Soup, and now it’s back and better than ever! Made with a mix of sharp white Cheddar cheese, big, soft chunks of broccoli and chopped carrot, and our very own uniquely piquant, Parmesan-y Unexpected Cheddar, this superlatively smooth, creamy, and savory Soup is now even smoother, even creamier, and even more savory than before. And just like its previous iteration, it couldn’t be easier to prep at home: simply heat (in the microwave or on the stovetop) and eat!

Excellent as an entrée and spectacular as a side, our upgraded Unexpected Broccoli Cheddar Soup makes a particularly great pairing option for a hearty sandwich or crisp, leafy green salad. Creamy, comforting, and rich, we also like simply serving it with a hunk of crusty bread for dipping, or hollowing out a Sourdough Boule and enjoying it inside a bread bowl.

Risotto Semplice.item_story_marketing:
First, a bit of translation... Riso means “rice” in Italian. The suffix -otto can mean “small,” or “cute.” Put them together and you get risotto, a creamy rice-based dish that is possibly cute and definitely delicious. Informally, risotto has been affectionately known in culinary circles as a “labor of love” because of the high attention and large amount of time required to cook the rice—one ladle of broth at a time with constant stirring. 

Recognizing the deliciousness of risotto and desiring to make it as accessible as possible for our customers, we’re introducing Trader Joe’s Risotto Semplice—literally, “Simple Risotto.” It’s reminiscent of the famous risotto of Milan. Our supplier in Italy starts with carnaroli rice (a starchy, medium grain rice that is considered the best rice for risotto) and proceeds with a labor of love that includes sunflower & olive oils, onion, vegetable broth, saffron (characteristic of risotto alla Milanese), cultured butter, and cheese. The culmination is a truly comforting concoction of toothsome rice in a thick, pale yellow sauce that is buttery & cheesy, with a hint of saffron aroma & flavor. 

One of the best things about this labor of love is that we (and our supplier) did the labor, so you can do the loving—including how much you’ll love the fact that Risotto Semplice heats from frozen in the microwave in 4-6 minutes. And of course, you’ll love the fact that you can enjoy it as-is—or add meat, seafood, or vegetables to suit any eating occasion.

Greek YogurtHoney Made with Whole Milk.item_title: Greek YogurtHoney Made with Whole Milk
Greek YogurtHoney Made with Whole Milk.item_story_marketing:
By now you know the story of Greek yogurt - most of the liquid has been strained out, making its texture more 
like that of sour cream. But did you know that's only part of the story? There's a dark secret behind much of 
what's marketed today as "Greek" yogurt. You see, to save both time and money, many yogurt manufacturers 
skip that all-important straining process, instead choosing to add thickeners to regular yogurt to achieve a 
similar, creamy texture. We find that more than a little disingenuous for a couple of reasons. One, real Greek 
plain yogurt has no thickeners. And two, real Greek yogurt is significantly higher in protein than its yogurt 
relatives, specifically because of that straining process. You can be sure the Greek Yogurt in every tub of Trader 
Joe's Greek Yogurt with Honey is the real dea.

This Greek Yogurt with Honey is smooth and creamy, super rich, and delivers an ideal balance of yogurt-y 
tart and honey sweet.

Greek Lowfat Yogurt Plain.item_story_marketing: Ever wonder how Greek yogurt is crafted? Do we culture the milk by reading each batch of yogurt epic Hellenic poetry? It couldn’t hurt, however Trader Joe’s Lowfat Plain Greek Yogurt uses a traditional Greek yogurt process to yield a deliciously creamy lowfat Greek yogurt. Each batch of Trader Joe’s Lowfat Plain Greek Yogurt has its beginnings with grade A pasteurized 2% milk sourced from cows not treated with rBSt. From there, the milk is heated, cooled to a desirable fermentation temperature (approximately 110° F), and topped off with the addition of bacterial cultures. While this bacteria grows and produces lactic acid, we prepare for the final step that takes this regular yogurt mixture to the Parthenon of pleasant texture and taste. This final, multi-straining step is what separates this Greek God of a yogurt from the mere mortals of regular yogurt. The thorough straining of the liquid whey is what gives this Greek yogurt a concentrated, powerful flavor and dense, velvety texture. So much of the liquid is strained that it can typically take around four cups of raw milk to yield one cup of Greek yogurt. This leaves a concentrated, protein-rich yogurt low in sodium, sugar, and fat making for a nutritious snack any time of day!

Korean Style Bibim-Guksu.item_story_marketing:
What do “the concept of vengeance” and “thin, well-dressed noodles with crisp veggies” have in common? Well, to quote an old Klingon proverb, “revenge is a dish best served cold.” Indeed, much like righteous retribution, Trader Joe’s Korean Style Bibim-Guksu takes on a positively refreshing quality when it’s had time to chill. And in the case of our Bibim-Guksu, enjoying it at a lower temp also lets your palate fully engage with the texture of the slender wheat noodles, the crunch of the cabbage, carrots, and tart kimchi, and the spicy-savory notes of the included gochujang dressing.

Inspired by a long-treasured staple of Korean cuisine, this cold noodle salad can be enjoyed totally on its own or topped with a soft-boiled egg. It’s a light, refreshing, and superlatively easy lunch—simply mix all the noodles and veggies with the dressing and enjoy, right out of the container. And it also makes a superb side for all sorts of savory fare: we particularly enjoy it as an accompaniment to a plate of grilled Bool Kogi,  pan-fried Pork Belly, or air-fried Salmon.

Ranch Cottage Cheese Dip.item_story_marketing:
We’re just going to come right out and say it: cottage cheese rarely gets the credit it deserves. It’s a truly versatile bit of dairy, capable of providing protein, texture, and a certain cool creaminess to everything from pancakes to frittatas to pasta dishes. And on top of all of that, it also makes a fantastically flavorful dip, too! Just try Trader Joe’s Ranch Cottage Cheese Dip, and you’ll see exactly what we mean. It’s made with a base of Cottage Cheese, to which our supplier adds a bit of Greek style yogurt and buttermilk for a little extra tang, plus a blend of Ranch dressing-evoking herbs and seasonings for a savory, aromatic edge. Then, they whip it all up to an elegantly light and creamy consistency that’s ideal for scooping with your favorite cracker, chip, or crudité.

Enjoy our Ranch Cottage Cheese Dip in any context that calls for dipping, dunking, or spreading: parties, picnics, cookouts, and even just spur-of-the-moment snack attacks. In addition to being excellent with a Pita Chip [sku 91053] or carrot stick, it also serves spectacularly well as a sandwich spread in place of mayo or classic ranch. And for an easy-yet-elegant breakfast treat, sub it in for ricotta on a slice of toasted European Grains & Seeds Bread, topped with a fried egg, a bit of Smoked Salmon, or sliced Persian Cucumbers.

Sandwich Starters.item_story_marketing:
When most people go to make a sandwich, they don't start with the meat and cheese, or mustard and lettuce. 
They start with the bread, of course! It's a logical place to start. And Trader Joe's Sandwich Starters are not 
only a logical place to start, they're also a delicious way to begin!

Our Sandwich Starters are moist and pleasantly chewy, with olive oil and sea salt included in the recipe for a 
subtly savory flavor. What makes Sandwich Starters even more unique is that they come connected, so you can 
easily select the size of your sandwich. Are you super hungry? Use three connected Buns. Just need a snack? 
One Bun oughta do! 

Additionally, Sandwich Starters are Pre-sliced, so once you've selected your size, all that's left to do is load 
up the insides. Pile on TJ's Oven Roasted Turkey Breast, Organic Uncured Black Forest Ham, or Delicatessen Sliced Roast Beef. Have a Euro-style lunch when you stack up our Spanish Inspired Charcutería. When it comes to cheese, why not stick with the Pre-sliced theme and add TJ's Sliced Colby Jack or Sliced Provolone. Of course, we also have all the spreads, lettuce, tomatoes, pickles... Maybe it's fair to call your entire neighborhood store your Trader Joe's Sandwich Starter! And when it comes to the bread, you'll find these Pre-sliced Sandwich Buns on our bakery shelves, every day.

Dark Chocolate Thins On the Go! No Sugar.item_title: Dark Chocolate Thins On the Go! No Sugar Added
Dark Chocolate Thins On the Go! No Sugar.item_story_marketing:
Colombian chocolate is truly among the finest in the world. Rich and complex with subtly citric and fruity notes throughout, it’s the kind of chocolate with a breadth of flavor that stands up on its own, even without added sugar. Which is precisely why there’s No Sugar Added to Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Thins On the Go. They’re made for us by an expert supplier in Colombia using Colombian cocoa, cocoa butter, and allulose, rather than sugar. They’re also studded with roasted cocoa nibs for a crunchy pop of texture, then seasoned with just a touch of sea salt for a slightly savory edge in each and every satisfying bite. 

Each pouch contains 12 individually wrapped, easy-to-transport Thins, making these a capital confection for carrying On the Go. Whether or not you’re watching the amount of sugar in your diet, they make a fantastic inclusion in work and school lunches, they’re great for grabbing on your way out of the door to enjoy while running errands, and are superb for simply snacking on as an anytime indulgence.

French Galettes Butter Cookies.item_story_marketing:
The galette is a treasured tradition among French bakers, dating back over a thousand years to the time of the Norman Dynasty. While we in the States might most immediately think of fruit pies with partially folded edges when we hear the word “galette,” the French consider the galette a whole category of baked good, ranging in shapes, sizes, and forms that include sweet cakes, savory flatbreads, ridged waffles and even buttery cookies. Inspired by a beloved regional variation of galette known as Broyés du Poitou, Trader Joe’s French Galettes Butter Cookies are made especially for us by an esteemed French bakery near the historic city of Nantes. They use a traditional recipe that includes French cultured butter to produce a satisfyingly crisp exterior, and crumbly, wonderfully melt-in-your-mouth interior. 

A delicious dessert or sweet snack in practically any context, we particularly enjoy our French Galettes Butter Cookies when paired with a hot cup of coffee or tea. Simple, sweet (but not too sweet), and texturally toothsome, they make a great companion to a bowl of ice cream or platter of fresh cut fruit. And since each box contains twelve Cookies, they’re great for sharing when you’ve got folks over for dinner—if you haven’t already eaten them all yourself, of course.

Organic Silken Tofu.item_story_marketing:
One of the most remarkable things about tofu (and believe us, we could fill a book with all the remarkable things about tofu) is how widely its uses can range based on just a small change in texture. Standard Tofu is a staple of stir fries and marinates marveously well. Super Firm Tofu can be a stand-in for all sorts of meats, and even holds up to deep frying. And then, of course, our superlatively soft Trader Joe’s Organic Silken Tofu can act as everything from a cheese, cream, and egg substitute, to a hearty inclusion in spicy soups, to a creamy dessert in its own right. 

Delightfully delicate and mild-flavored, our Organic Silken Tofu makes a mean mapo tofu, a superb sundubu- jigae soup, and a masterful chocolate mousse. It can be enjoyed hot or cold, mixed into sauces, and even blended into smoothies. From the simple (lightly boiled, topped with Crunchy Chili Onion, and enjoyed by the spoonful) to the slightly more involved (mixed with Turmeric and Nutritional Yeast and fried like scrambled eggs), Trader Joe’s Organic Silken Tofu is a versatile, velvety-textured addition to your culinary toolbox.

Spicy Dynamite Sauce.item_story_marketing:
It feels like we’ve all had that experience where we’re at a restaurant, enjoying a burger, or a rice bowl, or some manner of crispy appetizer, when we suddenly realize that the dish itself is rather ho-hum, and it’s the sauce it’s served with that we really like. Well, Trader Joe’s Spicy Dynamite Sauce is that sauce. Not literally, of course, but it is our version of those savory, sweet, and spicy catch-all condiments you encounter out in the world that make you think “why don’t they just bottle and sell this?” We did, dear reader. We did.

Made with a base of vegan mayo, the ingredients to our Spicy Dynamite Sauce read like a list of greatest gastronomic hits: Pickled chili peppers! Sesame oil! Garlic! Horseradish-mustard paste! It all adds up to one superlatively full-flavored profile, with notes of heat, sweet, and umami, and a captivatingly creamy texture. We like it on and with everything , and we mean everything: French fries, chicken nuggets, poke bowls, grilled salmon, roasted broccoli, baked potatoes, burgers, sandwiches, fish tacos, scrambled eggs—seriously, you name it, and this Sauce will work like Dynamite.

Coffee Lover's Espresso Beans.item_story_marketing: While some may only prefer to experience coffee as a drinkable brew, there are many others who love the flavor of roasted coffee beans so much they’ll take it any way it comes. For these less discriminating (though no less avid) coffee lovers, we’re offering Trader Joe’s Coffee Lover’s Espresso Beans. Our confectionery experts in California start with 100% Arabica beans from Brazil. These beans are given a dark roast, as one would find to be typical of coffee used for brewing espresso. Next, the roasted beans are enrobed in an assortment of high-quality chocolates (dark, milk, white) with additional flavors meant to suggest a variety of sweet coffee combinations. The black ones are dark chocolate espresso beans. The brown ones, made with milk chocolate, capture the essence of cappuccino. The tan-colored ones evoke a caramel latte flavor—while the white speckled ones stir up taste-memories of coffee & cream. In addition to providing these crave-able coffee flavors, our assortment of chocolate-covered Espresso Beans can also provide that much-needed mid-morning or afternoon boost… caffeine, y’know! And the little bag can be stowed just about anywhere, like a pocket or a purse—for whenever you want a taste of coffee. (Try doing that with a hot brewed cup!)

Cilantro Salad Dressing.item_story_marketing:
We often find Trader Joe’s Cilantro Salad Dressing in many of our customers’ carts. Like us, they can’t resist the tangy and savory flavors that emanate from the hints of lemon and dashes of onion, garlic, and cotija cheese. The cheese combined with cream, mayonnaise, and milk build oh-so creamy and inviting flavors and textures to the table. We don’t ever want to limit the use of our Cilantro Salad Dressing to just salads, so let us give you some ideas–drizzle on top of fish tacos or tostadas. Or use as a marinade: add a bottle or two to uncooked chicken, fish, or beef in a sealable bag or storage container, and let the marinade sit for a couple hours in the refrigerator for a juicy, tender, and flavorsome experience.

There are plenty of other ways to dress your food with Trader Joe’s Cilantro Salad Dressing, that’s probably one of the reasons why we keep restocking our shelves, other than the fact that it’s absolutely scrumptious.

Meatball Calzone.item_story_marketing:
Lots of people say “cal-ZOwn.” Italian speakers say, “cal-tzO-nay.” So, which is correct? We suppose it’s a matter of perspective. Though we may not be keen on judging pronunciation, we are fully committed to judging the quality of a calzone—say it however you like! To that end, let us just say that Trader Joe’s Meatball Calzone is unequivocally delicious. 

Calzones are oven-baked turnovers made with bread dough and typically filled with savory ingredients. Like folded pizzas, they commonly contain tomato sauce, cheese, and meat or veggies. This one is loaded with Meatballs made from a combination of ground pork and ground beef bound together with some egg and seasoned with Parmesan cheese, onions, garlic, parsley, and black pepper. Along with the Meatballs, you’ll also find a rich tomato sauce and plenty of melty mozzarella cheese tucked inside the tender wheat flour dough. 

Of course, the mozzarella’s not melty until you heat it. We recommend a twenty-minute bake in a 350°F conventional oven—or 15 minutes in your air fryer. You can also microwave it for four minutes, if your Calzone craving just can’t wait! Serve this Calzone with a sprinkle of torn fresh Basil or a shake of Aglio Olio Seasoning Blend and Shredded Parmesan on top. Don’t forget a side of Trader Joe’s Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce for dipping. However you present it, Trader Joe’s Meatball Calzone is definitely a legit way to say “Delicious!”

Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Leat.item_title: Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Leather Wrap
Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Leat.item_story_marketing:
Botanically, apples and watermelons don't have much in common. Apples are typically small, grow on trees, 
and are members of the rose family of flowering plants, while watermelons can get truly gargantuan, grow on 
vines, and are much closer to cucumbers, genetically speaking. What they do have in common, however, is 
that they take to sour flavors spectacularly well. And together, they do so in a conveniently snackable form in 
Trader Joe's Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Leather Wrap.

They're made for us by the same supplier as our other iconic Organic Fruit Wraps; you may be familiar with our Apple Raspberry, Apple Wild Berry, Apple Blueberry, and Apple Strawberry Wraps. These Wraps, however, are the first to go in a splendidly sweet-sour direction, combining  the joyous juiciness of Watermelon with the tantalizingly tart tones of Sour Apple. Perfect for packing along on car rides, enjoying on a hike, or simply snacking on during your morning commute, Trader Joe's Organic Sour Apple Watermelon Fruit Wraps are a great way to add some fun, fruity flavor to your day.

Spicy Mango Habanero Guacamole.item_story_marketing:
The combination of sweet & spicy flavors in a single dish is a global cultural phenomenon. It’s also a phenomenon in that microcosm of the globe we call your neighborhood Trader Joe’s! We sell Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, Sweet & Spicy Rice Cracker Mix, and Mildly Sweet & Spicy Beef & Broccoli—to name just a few such products. Now, we’re bringing this sweet & spicy profile to our guacamole selection with a fresh Mango Habanero Guacamole. 

Chunks of golden Mango provide the sweet. The spicy comes from a combination of jalapeño peppers and Habanero pepper purée. These sweet & spicy components are complemented by just a handful of other fresh (never frozen) ingredients, including onion, red bell pepper, and cilantro. Of course, we can’t forget the avocados! Our Mexican supplier acquires Hass variety avocados from nearby farms and scoops them by hand to create the creamy and delicious Guacamole base. 

If you normally enjoy guacamole, then you’ll know exactly what to do with Trader Joe’s Mango Habanero Guacamole: scoop it with Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips; dip your Southwest Style Chicken Quesadillas; add some inside your Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito; pop some on top of your Green Chile Chicken Bowl... You’ll find it in our refrigerators, every day!

Roasted Tomato Labneh Dip.item_story_marketing:
A savory staple across countless cuisines in the Middle East, North Africa, and Mediterranean, labneh is a style 
of strained yogurt that's very similar to what we might more commonly call "Greek-style" yogurt, here in the 
States. Creamy, tangy, and often remarkably cheesy, labneh is enjoyed in all sorts of contexts within the many 
cultures that lay claim to it, including as a breakfast dish with poached eggs and herbs, drizzled with olive oil 
as part of a mezze platter, or spread on carbs of all kinds. Drawing inspiration from all of these uses, Trader 
Joe's Roasted Tomato Labneh Dip combines labneh's signature tanginess and smooth texture with irresistably 
aromatic herbs and rich, sweet, and robust Roasted Tomatoes into one seriously versatible Dip.

Try dunking Trader Joe's Roasted Tomato Labneh Dip with pita chips, fresh Lavash, or really 
anything tasty and dunkable-carrot sticks, pitted olives, French fries, you name it. Try spreading it on a 
sandwhich, a Falafel wrap, or even just a slice of sourdough toast. Try dropping it by the spoonful 
over salads, hearty grain bowls, or tomato-based soups. Whatever you do, just be sure you try it! It's a tart, 
cheesy, herby, phenomenally full-flavored eating experience, and it's now available at your neighborhood 
Trader Joe's.

Cinnamon Swirl Bread Sliced.item_story_marketing:
For close to a century, people have searched high and low for the fabled “greatest thing since sliced bread.” We’re here today to tell you that we’ve found it—and as with many searches throughout history, the answer was right under our noses all along. For what could possibly be greater than sliced bread? How about sliced cinnamon swirl bread! Indeed, Trader Joe’s Sliced Cinnamon Swirl Bread represents a seriously sweet and Cinnamon-y upgrade to your everyday slice of bread, available now on an everyday basis at the bakery section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. 

Brought to us by a bakery supplier, whose expertise with Cinnamon-based baked goods is second to none, each loaf contains a Swirl of Cinnamon sugar throughout, creating a delightfully flavorful (but not overly Cinnamon-spicy) eating experience in every bite. It’s great when enjoyed by the slice straight out of the bag, and when toasted, takes on an even more rich and aromatic quality. And for an unbeatable sweet breakfast treat, our Sliced Cinnamon Swirl Bread serves spectacularly well as the foundation for French toast.

Organic Guava Fruit Spread.item_story_marketing:
To create the vacation-in-a-jar that is Trader Joe’s Organic Guava Spread, our supplier starts with organically grown Guavas from Brazil picked at the peak of ripeness. The luscious pink fruit is simmered with organic cane sugar, fruit pectin, and a bit of water (plus ascorbic and citric acids) to create a thick, brick red, tart & tangy spread, teeming with tropical flavor. Simple? Somewhat. Tasty? You bet.

In contrast to the fruit’s limited seasonality, the uses for this superb Spread are actually quite wide-ranging. In addition to the more obvious stand-in for jelly on toast, bagels, or a PB&J, Organic Guava Spread is excellent slathered on pancakes and waffles. Its sweet-tart notes are a welcome complement to a savory, roasted pork tenderloin or grilled chicken & brie sandwich. And who wouldn’t want to level up their summer cheese board with a swoosh of this Spread on a cracker, topped with a cube of TJ’s Unexpected Cheddar Cheese? (Fun fact: this is exactly how the Spread was served and ultimately approved at the TJ’s tasting panel—the combo is absolutely worth tasting for yourself!). If your palate is piqued and you’re interested in taking your taste buds on a trip to the tropics, head to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, post-haste.

Seedless Lemons.item_story_marketing:
You know what they say—when life hands you lemons, make lemonade… and when life hands you a two-pound bag of Seedless Lemons, you can make all kinds of things—tangy lemon salad dressing, lemon-y grilled chicken, lemon ricotta pancakes, lemon simple syrup for cocktails...you can even add lemon juice or zest to a sugar scrub for a hit of energizing citrus aroma!

Our Seedless Lemons are grown for us in the U.S.A. and Mexico—the location varies depending on the season. The varieties in the bag vary throughout the year, too;  they’ll always be juicy, tangy and full of flavor, with vibrant yellow peels and fresh, citrusy aroma.

Organic Ground Turmeric.item_story_marketing:
Variety may be the spice of life, but spices… are the spice of food! And, at Trader Joe’s we’ve become known for having the best value for unique spice blends, as well as conventional, single-ingredient spices. Of course, we’ve never been ones to rest on our laurels, thus we’ve undertaken the challenge to take our best selling, single- ingredient spices and source organic alternatives for each of them. 

Trader Joe’s Organic Ground Turmeric is one of the products adding even more variety (and spice) to our TJ’s “spice rack.” It’s happily what you would expect: brilliantly bright-orange/gold colored powder with that earthy, spicy aroma and mildly peppery, pungent flavor characteristic of this cornerstone kitchen seasoning. It can be combined with ingredients like almond milk, cinnamon, honey, and ginger to make a warm, comforting tea.

Lemon Basil Pasta Salad.item_story_marketing:
Now here’s a Pasta Salad that’s especially great, and especially unique to Trader Joe’s. In fact, the recipe used for Trader Joe’s Lemon Basil Pasta Salad is the same recipe made frequently by one of our very own Buyers! Farfalle—affectionately known as bow tie pasta—fulfills the “pasta” part of this Pasta Salad and is, in our opinion, the best shape for a pasta salad. It’s just the right size to pair with the accompanying ingredients of peas, shredded zucchini, shredded spinach, and asiago cheese. When tossed in a light basil lemonette (A.K.A. lemon vinaigrette), the pasta holds the perfect amount of dressing. Squeeze the included lemon wedge on top, and you’ll have a wonderfully refreshing dish at the ready.

Lemon Basil Pasta Salad is ideal for bringing along to a barbecue or potluck, packs up perfectly with sandwiches and lemonade for a lovely little picnic in the park, and makes an excellent and effortless lunch option for school or work.

Solid LIght Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil.item_title: Solid LIght Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil
Solid LIght Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil.item_story_marketing:
Although comparatively tiny by bluefin standards, you might be surprised to learn that yellowfin tuna regularly grow to over 400 pounds in size. Which makes it all the more impressive that our supplier sources Trader Joe’s Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil via dolphin-safe, pole-and-line fishing. While it’s certainly a more labor-intensive approach, the reduced by-catch is always worth it, in our opinion. And because we work directly with said supplier, we’re still able to offer the significant value of $2.49 for each four-ounce (drained) can, making our Yellowfin Tuna a particularly prudent protein choice for keeping your budget in the black.

And of course, aside from being a smart protein choice, it’s also a dependably delicious and versatile one: we recommend our Yellowfin Tuna for everything from tuna melts to tuna salad to quick and easy, pantry pasta dishes. You’ll find them in our grocery aisle, among our other tinned fish offerings.

Sweet & Spicy Rice Cracker Mix.item_story_marketing:
A box of chocolates is all well and good, but if you ask us, life is much more like a bag of Trader Joe’s Sweet & Spicy Cracker Mix. As in life, this Mix is full of character, complexity, and both sweetness and spice in equal measure. It’s made for us by a supplier in Thailand, who fills each pouch with crispy, crunchy Rice Crackers in a variety of shapes and textures, half of which have been dusted in sugar, while the other half are covered in a spicy paprika-and-chile-powder coating. That means that every handful has a unique ratio of sweet and heat, and every time you snack, it’s going to be a bit unpredictable, delightfully adventurous, and in the end, satisfying, all the same —much like life, we’d say. 

And indeed, Trader Joe’s Sweet & Spicy Rice Cracker Mix is well suited for any snacking situation that life may throw at you, be it a weekend binge watch of your favorite new show, a game night with friends and family, or even just a random craving for something savory and sweet. We also find that the wide range of textures represented across the traditional Rice Cracker shapes (some are smooth, some are twisty, some are ridged) are especially great at piquing the palate when complemented by a smooth, refreshing beverage. We recommend one of our delicately fruity sparkling water options, or crisp and easy-drinking beer.

Organic Tofu.item_story_marketing: A household name to some, but a peculiar protein replacement to many, tofu is a traditional piece of the culinary puzzle to many East Asian and Southeast Asian dishes. Tofu production was first recorded in China over two millennia ago and while we’ve only had our doors open since 1958, we like to think the Trader Joe’s Organic Tofu we produce has the quality of a tofu that’s been being perfected over the last 2,000 years. Made from allowing soy milk to curdle, tofu can be packaged in a variety of softness: silken, soft, firm, and extra firm. Organic Tofu is similar to the texture of all the raw meat and seafood we stock on our shelves, making it a popular meat alternative. Entirely plant-based, high in protein while low in fat makes for a great addition to many dishes as the main protein component. Trader Joe’s Organic Tofu soaks up the flavor of any dish or sauce it gets tossed into, making for a flavorful and versatile plant-based star of many meals.

Organic Mini Flour Tortillas.item_story_marketing:
Tortillas aren’t just a staple of Central American cuisine, they’re one of the foundational foods of human cuisine in general. Archaeological evidence suggests that the indigenous peoples of Mesoamerica were making tortillas from corn as far back as 12,000 years ago, which means that tortillas are older than wine, leavened bread, and the domestication of the chicken. And now, doing our small part to further the epic legacy of the tortilla, we present Trader Joe’s Organic Mini Flour Tortillas. 

Made with organic wheat flour, these Mini Tortillas are practically tailor-made for making tacos. At just under five inches in diameter, they offer just the right amount of real estate to hold an expertly craftable combination of beans, cheese, veggies, and protein. Of course, size isn’t their sole virtue, they’re also charmingly soft and pliable in texture, and have a great, toasty flavor that nicely complements spicier fare.

Hass Avocado.item_story_marketing:
The smooth, buttery texture of a ripe avocado is pretty irresistible to us. We think the avocado is one of nature’s most perfect foods. Native to Mexico and Central America, and referred to as “alligator pears” by some earlier in their history, they’re technically berries containing a single seed, and classified as flowering plants. Botanical distinctions aside, we find that they’re among the more versatile fruits in our produce section.

Avocados are excellent when sliced and served over an omelet, inside a burrito, or layered over a salad; scoop out the seed to create an edible bowl for chicken or seafood salad; mash and season for a quick guacamole or avocado toast.

Buffalo Ranch Popcorn.item_story_marketing:
“Beau fleuve!” the 17th century French explorer exclaimed as he witnessed the picturesque river emptying into Lake Erie. But to the English settlers who came after, the French words for “Beautiful river” sounded a lot like “Buffalo!” Thus, this area where western New York state meets the shores of Lake Erie received it modern name—or so the legend goes. A couple hundred years later, the city of Buffalo, New York gave its name to the spicy wing sauce invented in a nearby local bar.

Today, we’ve borrowed the name for our Buffalo Ranch Popcorn! (We considered Beau Fleuve Popcorn, but that name suggested a soggy snack.) In fact, the five-ounce bag of Trader Joe’s Buffalo Ranch Popcorn contains fluffy butterfly Popcorn kernels—the variety with unpredictably shaped ‘wings’ sticking out—that have been popped in coconut & sunflower oils and generously seasoned with a bold, Buffalo Ranch seasoning. The spicy-herby-tangy blend sticks in all those lovely corny crevasses so that every bite is loaded with Buffalo- style heat and creamy-Ranch coolness.

Take a bag to the movies. Take it to the beach. Take it on a hike... to the river! Wherever you decide to roam with Trader Joe’s Buffalo Ranch Popcorn, you’re going to enjoy it. But don’t miss your chance—bison… er, buy some now before this limited snack runs out!

Margherita Pizza.item_story_marketing:
Have you ever traveled all the way to Italy just for a pizza? Well, we have—so you don’t have to! In fact, we’ve done so several times over, most recently in the name of improving upon our already tasty Trader Joe’s Margherita Pizza... and improve, we did. 

ade for us in the Modena province by one of our very favorite Italian pizza partners, this classic Margherita Pizza starts with a hand-stretched, Amalfi style crust, the dough for which is fermented for a full 24 hours prior to kicking off the pizza-making process. This new-and-much-improved crust is thin, soft, and bubbly, with a slightly thicker, chewy edge. In this Pizza’s previous iteration, they topped said crust with a standard tomato sauce; in this version, however, they top it with a passata—a.k.a. a traditional Italian tomato sauce made by sieving ripe tomatoes into a silky-smooth purée, allowing the pure, tomato flavor to really shine. The pies are finished with fresh mozzarella rounds, shredded Grana Padano and carefully placed basil leaves, then baked in wood-burning stone ovens, flash-frozen, and sent to sail the culinary seas... all the way to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s. Mangia!

Roasted Green Vegetables.item_story_marketing:
This truly is a golden age of getting one’s greens in. We’d reckon that there’s never been a time in human history when so many easy and delicious vegetable options have been so available and for so reasonable a price—and Trader Joe’s Roasted Green Vegetables is a prime example. It’s made from a simple, yet profoundly effective mix of pre-chopped, cruciferous Vegetables like kale, broccoli, and Brussels sprouts, along with tender, proteinaceous, pre-shelled edamame, that are all flavored with olive oil, garlic, onion, salt, and pepper, and Roasted to perfection. Now, creating a hearty and flavorful veggie side dish for your next meal is as easy as heating up a tray in the microwave or conventional oven, serving, and enjoying! 

In fact, our favorite thing about these handy, vegan Roasted Green Vegetables is their potential for freeing up the rest of your meal planning—with the veggies out of the way, you have all the more time to consider what protein and starch to serve with them. We recommend trying them out with a seared steak and potatoes, grilled chicken breasts over pasta, marinated tofu and brown rice, or pan-fried salmon with noodles.
