And if you feel like personalizing your Greens, the sky’s the limit: we like them topped with a bit of grated Parmesan, a drizzle of Organic Balsamic Vinegar, or any number of our savory sauces and seasoning blends.

Fiesta Salad with Shrimp.item_story_marketing:
While salad may be an easy lunch option, that doesn’t mean it can’t be a celebration, too. In fact, we find that certain salads call for a full-on fiesta—especially when they happen to combine the bold flavors of a Mexican cuisine-inspired salad with the plump texture of prefectly cooked shrimp. Need proof? Look no further than Trader Joe’s Fiesta Salad with Shrimp! Each ready-to-eat Salad contains a base of crisp romaine lettuce, seasoned black beans, roasted corn kernels, crunchy tortilla strips, and zesty pico de gallo, along with a hearty portion of shrimp, and a rich and creamy poblano dressing and lime wedge to tie it all together. 

Now, the everyday occasion of getting a grab-and-go meal from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s is practically a party in and of itself! While this Fiesta Salad is especially suited for work or school lunches, we find it’s also ideal for packing along on a picnic, carrying along in a cooler for a long car ride, or simply enjoying at home as an effortless entrée. Just as any good party is tailored to its guests, we highly encouraging adding a little customization into the mix by topping with some sliced avocado, a bit of shredded cheese, or your favorite of our many fine hot sauce and salsa options.

Sour Strawberry Candy Belts.item_story_marketing:
We have so many yummy gummy candies under our belt, it would be easy to rest on our laurels and coast for a while on this gummy momentum. But that’s not the TJ’s way! Whether we are talking about gummies, curries, or berries, our developers won’t stop until we’ve created all the best products we think our customers want and deserve. 

For example, we’ve been wanting to add Strawberry flavored Sour Belts to our candy assortment for years now. Though we’ve searched the world (literally) for a worthy supplier, we’ve found that most candy makers use artificial flavors and artificial colors. That’s not what we want to offer our customers. So, we kept searching... and our persistence has finally paid off! Meet Trader Joe’s Sour Strawberry Candy Belts. 

These long, flat, rose-colored strips are made for us by an expert gummy candy supplier in Turkey who only uses natural flavors, and colors derived from fruit & vegetable juices. Open the tub and you’ll be hit by a fragrant Strawberry aroma, like a strawberry plant that’s been basking in the summer sun. This Strawberry scent sets you up for the real payoff, found in the pleasantly chewy, sugar-covered Belts that boast a balanced, sweet & sour Strawberry flavor. And... they’re vegan!

This Sour Strawberry Candy is another notch in our belt, but even more importantly, it’s another win for our customers: delicious, naturally flavored, vegan Candy, sourced with love and available every day at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Chili P.item_title: Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Chili Pepper
Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Chili P.item_story_marketing:
When considering the fundamentals of flavor, spiciness and saltiness are about as foundational as you can get. In this spirit, while recently reviewing our seasoning selections, the though occured: why not combine these ever-so-crucial components into a single spice blend? After working directly with a trusted salt supplier in Pakistan, and finding just the right Chile flakes to mix with their expertly sourced Pink Salt, we arrived at Trader Joe’s Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Pepper, a consummate, catch-all seasoning for all sorts of sweet and savory applications. 

As a pure and simple expression of two essential flavor elements, there’s really no end to the uses for our Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Pepper—truly, anything that could do with an additional kick of savory heat will benefit from from a light sprinkling. That said, we’re particularly partial to adding it to roasted veggies, into soups, sauces, and stir fries, rubbing directly onto proteins prior to cooking, or atop freshly cooked pasta of all kinds. And for an excellent accessory to sweet and fruity cocktails, trying applying some Spicy Pink Salt with Crushed Red Pepper onto the rim, just before serving.

Fine Grain Pink Salt.item_story_marketing:
It would be nigh impossible to overstate the importance of salt to humanity. It’s an essential nutrient (our muscles and nervous system simply can’t function without it), a vital tool for food preservation, and overall, a crucial building block for human civilization itself. Of course, if you ask us, just the fact that it makes food taste better is argument enough for its indispensable nature. That’s why we offer a range of salt options on our shelves, including Trader Joe’s Fine Grain Pink Salt, brought in directly from our supplier in Pakistan, who sources their salt near the Himalaya mountains. 

Ever wondered why some salts are pink, like this one? It’s all a matter of minerals—tiny traces of elements like iron, potassium, and zinc all play a role in its coloration, though the majority of the pink hue is largely a result of iron oxide reacting to being exposed to oxygen. While some may notice a more complex flavor profile in Pink Salt compared to white table salt, we mostly like the fact that adds a little visual variety to its everyday applications. And to that end, we recommend our Fine Grain Pink Salt for all kinds of uses in the kitchen— particularly those that take advantage of its small-ground consistency, like applying directly to proteins, using in baking, and even just adding by the pinch-ful to soups, stir fries, or pasta water.

Okonomiyaki Japanese Vegetable Pancake.item_story_marketing:
Directly translated, okonomiyaki is derived from two words, yaki (meaning “grilled”) and okonomi (meaning “as you like it”), a testament to its customizable nature. In Japan and in Japanese-inspired street food scenes across the globe, these savory pancakes can be made with a wide variety of ingredients, including different veggies, proteins, and cheeses, and topped with everything from mayo to seaweed to dried, shaved fish flakes. For Trader Joe’s Okonomiyaki, our supplier in Japan has opted for a relatively simple, yet sublimely satisfying combination of cabbage, yam, and green onion held together in an eggy batter. When prepped at home, it takes on a crisp texture on the outside and a light and creamy texture on the inside. And if that wasn’t enough, they’ve also included a packet of sweet and savory okonomi sauce and delicate tuna flakes so that you can enjoy your Okonomiyaki, appropriately enough, exactly as you like it. 

Simply heat your Okonomkiyaki in the microwave or crisp it up on the stovetop, add your desired toppings, and enjoy. It makes an excellent appetizer for all sorts of meals, serves as a particularly hearty snack, and acts as an excellent entrée in its own right—especially when paired with an ice-cold beer.

Japanese Mini Taiyaki.item_story_marketing:
A treasured tradition of Japanese pastry-making since the turn of the 20th century, taiyaki were originally modeled after red sea bream, long considered a symbol of fortune in Japan. And for those fortunate to have already tried taiyaki, it’s easy to see why: they’re typically made with a rice-and-flour-based dough that produces a mochi-like texture when baked, and are usually available in a variety of flavors and fillings, including rich and sweet red bean, savory-seasoned sausage, or, in the case of Trader Joe’s Japanese Mini Taiyaki, elegantly creamy custard. 

Brought to us by an esteemed manufacturer in Japan, these bite-sized, perfectly pisciform Taiyaki are as much a feast for the eyes as they are a pleasure on the palate. Every bite starts with the crisp edge of the wonderfully waffle-y exterior, which quickly gives way to the luxurious consistency of the cool custard cream within. While it’s common to find taiyaki in a larger, multi-bite-size, ours are decidedly Mini, making them the ideal size for a quick dessert or sweet snack. They cook quickly in the oven, air fryer, or microwave, pair particularly well with a hot cup of your favorite tea or coffee, and since each package comes with eight Mini Taiyaki, they’re an especially easy choice to serve at the end of a dinner party.

Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Meatballs.item_story_marketing:
There’s just something about the combination of chicken, pineapple, and teriyaki that just *clicks*. Whether it’s in the form of a grilled chicken sandwich topped with pineapple slices and teriyaki sauce, or teriyaki-tinged chicken fried rice with little chunks of pineapple, this unlikely trio of sweet, savory, and succulent elements always keeps us coming back for more. In fact, we recently went back to the supplier of our ever-popular Chicken Meatballs with one request: give us your best version of chicken, pineapple, and teriyaki in a delectable, dippable, pop-in-your-mouth-able form. And when they came back with these Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Meatballs, our tasting panel immediately knew that we had something special.

Now available in our refrigerated cases on an everyday basis, Trader Joe’s Pineapple Teriyaki Chicken Meatballs are made with all-natural ground chicken, are certified gluten free, and arrive fully cooked, so that all you have to do is heat them up in the oven, microwave, or air fryer, then serve. On their own, they make a great savory snack or appetizer (especially when paired with something tangy to dip them in). They’re also awesome when tossed with your favorite noodles (we’re particularly partial to our Squiggly Noodles), and make a mean meatball sub with our Sandwich Rolls, too.

Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips.item_story_marketing:
Champ. Boxty. Colcannon. The list of Irish, potato-based delicacies is a like an all-star, comfort food showcase. We set out to create a snack that recontextualizes these dishes’ iconically Irish mix of hearty potatoes, rich, creamy butter, and aromatic alliums into a chip, and our search took us directly to the source. Now, coming to us from an Irish supplier, Trader Joe’s Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips are made with crinkle-cut, authentically Irish potatoes and flavored with authentically Irish butter and garlic, so that every bite is crisp, exceptionally savory, and oh-so satisfying.

Salty, buttery, and delightfully garlicky, with a charmingly toothsome texture, our Garlic Butter Irish Potato Chips are excellent as a standalone snack or as an accompaniment to a sandwich, soup, or salad. (We’re particularly keen on layering a few Chips into a sandwich, for an extra bit of crunch and flavor.) In a feat of epicurean engineering, they’re also sturdy and substantial enough to carry all kinds of creamy dips and condiments. We recommend pairing them with our Caramelized Onion Dip for a full-flavored, gameday appetizer, or our Spinach & Kale Greek Yogurt Dip for a deconstructed take on colcannon.

BBQ Chicken Pizza.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s BBQ Chicken Pizza might just be the ideal marriage of Italian and American culinary customs. Each one starts with a hand-stretched, wood-fired-oven-baked pizza crust sourced straight from Italy, which our American supplier tops with a tangy, smoky BBQ sauce, shredded whole milk Mozzarella and smoked Gouda cheeses, fire-roasted onions, cilantro, and, of course, char-grilled Chicken breast. Together, the undeniably Italian influence on the chewy, savory crust, comingling with the eminently American flavors of the hearty Chicken and rich BBQ sauce, constitute a classic feat of fusion cuisine. Each 13-ounce BBQ Chicken Pizza takes only 10 minutes in a 450°F oven to go from frozen to ready-to-eat. You’ll find them in our freezerias, all year round.

Golden Rounds Crackers.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Golden Rounds are crispy, buttery crackers with a familiar look and delicious crunch. They’re perhaps the perfect snack food, right from the box, but really, they scream to be crowned with any number of toppers. We’ve limited ourselves to only the natural ingredients in these little round marvels. You’re limited only by your imagination when it comes to ways to enjoy them!

Cambozola® Triple Cream Cheese.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Triple Cream Soft Ripened Cambozola Blue Cheese may be an obnoxious mouthful to say, but we can promise you that you’ll never have enough mouthfuls of this classic German blue cheese varietal. A relatively new-to-the-world example of blue cheese, Cambozola Blue Cheese, or “blue brie” has a smooth, creamy texture with a considerably mild blue cheese flavor profile.

Cambozola is a cross between Camembert and Gorgonzola (and generously named after them with Cambozola being a portmanteau of the two). It marries the creaminess of its Penicillium Camemberti focused mother cheese and the blue speckled veins and sharpness of its Penicillium Roqueforti using father, Gorgonzola. This gives it a blend of savory, nutty flavors with hints of sweetness that enhances this marriage of cheeses found in our Cambozola Blue Cheese. It’s a wonderful start to get into the world of blue cheese if you’re intimidated by the intense aromas and tangy tastes. Enjoy with fruit, honey, or a bottle of chardonnay, but whatever you choose to do, just make sure to get yourself a slice of Trader Joe’s Cambozola Blue Cheese today.

Sharp Cheddar Cheese Cracker Cuts.item_story_marketing: Can you find a savory, delicious hunk of Sharp Cheddar in the cheese case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, then take it home and slice it for yourself, for use in all sorts of applications? Absolutely. But when you know that cheese and crackers are on the menu, Trader Joe’s Sharp Cheddar Cheese Cracker Cuts are the way to go. Made with milk from cows not treated with rBST and microbial (non-animal) enzymes, this Sharp Cheddar comes conveniently sliced into quintessentially cracker-sized quadrilaterals and packaged in a convenient, resealable container. When company comes calling (or when the kids get home from school, or when your favorite TV show beckons, etc.), all you need to do is pop off the lid, grab a sleeve of your favorite TJ’s crackers, and—presto!—snacks are served!

Raisin Rosemary Crisps.item_story_marketing: Raisin Rosemary Crisps A unique cracker experience starts with unique ingredints. We’ve paired raisins and rosemary with flax and sunflower seeds to create a crispy, savory and sweet cracker. Our tasting panel loved these crisps and we think you will, too. Try them with Brie or goat cheese topped with chopped pecans. Prosciutto, gorgonzola and fit atop a Raisin Rosemary Crisp makes a wonderful appetizer. Of course, you can always eat them straight out of the box. They’re that good.

Tom Yum Seasoned Snack Mix.item_story_marketing:
We could truly spend all day discussing what we love about Thai cuisine: the big, bold flavors, the enchanting aromas, the adept application of spice—there are a lot of very good reasons why Thai food is held in such high esteem across the globe. And to us, nothing exemplifies all these reasons quite as perfectly as tom yum soup. Spicy, sour, salty, and even a bit sweet, tom yum typifies everything we love about Thai dishes, which is exactly why we’ve decided to pay tribute to this soup (and Thai cooking more broadly) with Trader Joe’s Tom Yum Seasoned Snack Mix.

Made for us by a skilled supplier in Thailand, this Mix starts with a base of roasted cashews, crispy-fried fava beans and green peas, and delightfully crunchy clusters of sticky rice, which they generously season with a Tom Yum-tinged spice blend that includes galangal, lemongrass, Thai lime leaves, and chili peppers. Just like the soup that inspired it, every bite creates a complex combo of savory, tart, and tangy notes on the palate. Unlike the soup, however, it pairs those flavors with a spectrum of satisfyingly crispy textures that make this Mix especially suited for serving as a party snack, savory side, or a crunchy companion to a cold glass of beer.

Gold Aceto Balsamico Di Modena.item_story_marketing:
Legend has it that the first bottle of Balsamic Vinegar di Modena was valued at 100 horses. That’s what the soon-to-be Holy Roman Emperor Enrico III of Franconia purportedly imparted to the individual who gifted to him a small bottle of “black vinegar” in 1046. The value of Balsamic Vinegar was established. Trader Giotto’s Gold Aged Balsamic Vinegar of Modena is a fine example of what’s been handed down over the last one thousand years. our Gold includes Indicazione Geografica Protetta (IGP), which designates a vinegar that’s produced in the Emilia Romana region of Italy (specifically Modena, in this case), and that’s made exclusively from Trebbiano and Lambrusco grapes from this same region. The IGP also means you can count on a vinegar that’s been aged for at least three years in oak barrels. All of these qualities are strictly monitored and controlled. These factors culminate in an Aged Balsamic that is naturally viscous like honey (no added thickeners), with a sweet flavor that includes a hint of pomegranate.

Enjoy some on fresh strawberries or watermelon. Mix with olive oil and toss with greens for a best-dressed salad. Add a mysterious complexity to your soups and stews by stirring in a tablespoon or two near the end of the cooking time. You’ll have tasters wondering what you did to develop such rich and interesting flavor. (Please note: We do not accept horses.)

Balsamic Vinegar of Modena.item_story_marketing:
Dating back to 1046 A.D., balsamic vinegar has been blessing the palettes of humanity. It was given as a gift to Emperor Enrico III of Franconia who was astonished by the flavor. And not much about the well-known vinegar has changed since! Its enormous success throughout the world can be attributed to the fact that it can be used as a condiment in practically any style of cooking.

At its roots, Trader Joe’s Balsamic Vinegar of Modena is a reduction of sweet grapes, boiled to a syrup. The resulting “grape must” is mixed in exact proportions with the wine vinegar to make the final product. And what a product it is - sweet-and-sour in taste with a rich fragrance that will only add to, not dominate the other flavors in a dish. And of course, with that Protected Geographical Indication, Trader Joe’s Aceto Balsamico di Modena PGI is produced in the Modena region of Italy, for an authentically tasting Balsamic Vinegar similar to that introduced to modern history back in 1046 A.D. These factors sing in harmony in every bottle of our Balsamic Vinegar of Modena. It’s naturally viscous without added thickening agents, naturally sweet, and goes wonderfully on a well-dressed salad, fresh strawberries or watermelon, or tossed into a sauce or cooked meat near the end of the cook time for added complexity.

Strawberry Mochi.item_story_marketing:
With delightfully chewy rice-dough exteriors and high butterfat ice-cream interiors, Trader Joe’s Strawberry Mochi is the cream of the crop, literally and figuratively.

Trader Joe’s Strawberry Mochi is free from the undesirable ingredients you’d find in most mass-produced mochi—like high fructose corn syrup, artificial flavors, & synthetic colors. Spanish Inspired Charcuteria.item_story_marketing:
The tradition of savory, flavorful charcuterie in Spain dates all the way back to antiquity, when invading Romans brought salting and curing techniques of meat preservation to the Iberian peninsula. In the centuries since, charcuterie (especially pork-based charcuterie) has become an utterly integral part of the Spanish culinary landscape, which now hosts countless specialized styles of jamón and sausage. Trader Joe’s Spanish Inspired Charcutería contains a selection of three such variations, each thinly-sliced and ready to serve: serrano ham (a salt-cured, prosciutto-like ham), uncured salchichon (a rich, savory-seasoned, salami-like summer sausage), and uncured chorizo (a peppery, garlicky, and smoky pork sausage). 

All three can be enjoyed as part of a tapas spread or hors d’oeuvres platter, and all three pair wonderfully well with a bold, fruit-forward red wine—we’re particularly partial to a glass of Satis Dei Syrah Garnacha, ourselves. Any or all members of the trio make a superb addition to a sandwich (try mixing and matching to your preference of smoky/salty/spicy). And we’d be remiss if we failed to mention that they also taste great simply snacked upon on their own, right out of the package.

Seville Orange Marmalade Fruit Spread.item_story_marketing:
A great marmalade is a bit of a balancing act. First, you’ve got to balance the sweetness of the fruit juice and sugar involved with the tartness of the citrus and bitterness of the orange rind. Then, you’ve got to find just the right balance of fruit and rind within the physical makeup of the marmalade—too much fruit, and it’s more like a jelly, too much rind, and it’s an overly-chewy mess. Luckily, when we decided to bring in a seasonal Seville Orange Marmalade Fruit Spread to our shelves, we had some real experts in our corner. Made by the same supplier in Belgium who previously demonstrated their mastery of balance with our Apricot Cardamom and Green Tea Yuzu spreads, this sweet, citric, and properly proportioned Marmalade is a triumph of harmonious flavors and textures on the palate.

Speaking of proportion, each batch is approximately 44% Seville Orange (both fruit and rind) by weight. In some parts of the word, the Seville Orange is known as “bitter orange”, and is almost never eaten raw. In a Marmalade, however, that bitterness is an asset, as it tempers the sweetness of the sugar. And in the case of Trader Joe’s Seville Orange Marmalade, it makes it an ideal topping for toast, an excellent inclusion in a parfait, and a capital companion to a bowl of cottage cheese.

Macaron Ice Cream Sandwiches.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Chocolate Macaron Ice Cream Sandwiches bring together two time-honored TJ’s freezer faves: sweet, delicate macarons and rich chocolate ice cream. The shells are then sent to our stateside supplier, where, instead of being filled with a traditional ganache or buttercream, they’re filled with a thick layer of premium Chocolate Ice Cream—c’est magnifique!

Unlike a traditional ice cream sandwich, where the cookie layers can sometimes upstage the ice cream (or vice versa), these Chocolate Macaron Ice Cream Sandwiches allow both components to shine, striking the perfect balance between sophisticated pastries and indulgent frozen treats. Individually wrapped for convenience, they’re ready to satisfy your sweet tooth in a jiffy, whether you’re savoring one solo or sharing the joy (perhaps begrudgingly) with a friend. Easter Joe-Joe's.item_story_marketing:

Aussie-Style Chocolate Crème Sandwich Co.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Aussie-style Chocolate Crème Sandwich Cookies are made for us in the Netherlands, and inspired by a classic Australian treat. Chocolate Truffle Eggs.item_story_marketing:

Break Apart Bunny.item_story_marketing:
Spring is a time of renewal, celebration, and, of course, chocolate. Trader Joe’s Break Apart Bunny takes sweet, seasonal joy to the next level. Made for us in the United Kingdom by the same clever confectioner behind our Hot Chocolate Stirring Spoons, Trader Joe’s Break Apart Bunny is formed from some of the finest milk chocolate around, which, with all due respect to chocolate bunnies everywhere, is not always the case with such seasonal sweets. Shrimp Noodle Rolls.item_story_marketing:
Originating in the Guangdong province of southern China, where they’re known as cheung fun, rice noodle rolls are treasured in Chinese and other Southeast Asian cuisines for their simplicity and heartiness. They’re typically made by steaming a silky, rice-based batter until it’s just set into a large, flat noodle, then filling it up with various savory-seasoned veggies and proteins, rolling it up, and serving. For our first foray into cheung fun-inspired fare in our freezers, we’ve brought in Trader Joe’s Shrimp Noodle Rolls, an easy way to enjoy all the textures and flavors of this dim sum star from the comfort of your kitchen.

Much like our frozen Gyoza offerings, all it takes to prep our Shrimp Noodle Rolls is to heat a little oil in pan, place the Rolls in, cover them with a lid so they’re allowed to both steam and get nice and crispy on the bottom, then enjoy. They’re great as a side dish when served with a nice stir-fry, make an excellent entry to a larger dim sum-inspired spread with our Pork & Ginger Soup Dumplings and Chicken Shu Mai, and are an effortless entrée in their own right when paired with some leafy greens. Whatever the context you enjoy them in, we recommend pairing them with some savory, tangy, and/or spicy dipping sauces—we recommend a simple mix of Soy Sauce, Rice Vinegar, and Sesame Oil.

Blood Orange Mochi.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Blood Orange Mochi offers the zest of both worlds when it comes to the spectrum of citrus flavor; made with actual Blood Orange juice concentrate, the ice cream is at once sweet and tart, delicate and bold, and, of course, delightfully creamy. The Mochi exterior adds the perfect amount of chew, giving way to a smooth, melt-in-your-mouth center that makes each bite as satisfying as the last. Single Origin Organic Dark Chocolate wit.item_story_marketing:

It’s a combination that creates quite an elevated eating experience for a candy bar, and one that’s further enhanced by pairing it with a nice cup of coffee, a mug of hot tea, or a glass of your favorite fruit-forward red wine.

Chicken Chile Verde Burritos.item_story_marketing:
There once was a young boy who enjoyed a bowl of Chicken Chile Verde every day. The boy loved the mixture of tender dark & white meat Chicken. He also loved the savory Chile Verde that was made with a combination of crushed tomatillos, green chiles, jalapeños, and Anaheim peppers. One day as the boy sat down for his daily bowl, he noticed his spoon was not in its normal place. After searching high and low, the boy considered using his hands. “Too messy,” he thought. Then he considered tipping the bowl so he could spill the Chile Verde directly into his mouth. It was not soup, so this did not work.

Just when the boy was about to give up, a heavenly aroma, like that of freshly baked bread, came wafting into the room. He followed his nose to find his mother rolling, pressing, and cooking flour tortillas. She saw him and the hungry look in his eyes. Without exchanging a word, she handed him one of the tortillas and he immediately rushed back to his table where he neatly wrapped up the contents of his bowl. The hungry boy didn’t hesitate to take a bite and soon found that the tactile sensation of holding the warm Chicken Chile Verde in his hands, along with the pleasantly chewy texture of the tortilla, made this the most enjoyable Chicken Chile Verde he had ever eaten!

Though we can’t verify the historical authenticity of this story, we can absolutely confirm that this serendipitous recipe is uncannily similar to our recipe for Trader Joe’s Chicken Chile Verde Burritos, which are now conveniently available in our freezers. Each 14-ounce package (containing two Burritos) is ready to go from freezer to hand in about two-and-a-half microwave minutes. No bowl or spoon required.

Crispy Oatmeal Cookies with Sea Salt.item_title: Crispy Oatmeal Cookies with Sea Salt
Crispy Oatmeal Cookies with Sea Salt.item_story_marketing:

Avocado Mash.item_story_marketing:
Truly, the avocado is one of nature’s gifts. When perfectly ripe, it takes on a smooth and spreadable consistency, needing little more than a quick mashing to turn it into an instant textural boost to burrito bowls, breakfast toasts, salads, and sandwiches. Of course, there are days where it’s challenging to find an avocado that’s already perfectly ripe, and days when you don’t necessarily want to break out a bowl for mashing. And it’s for days like these, or any time when you simply want quick avocado access, that we’re excited to announce the return of Trader Joe’s Avocado Mash—a gastronomic gift in its own right.

Unsalted Dry Toasted Sliced Almonds.item_story_marketing: First brought from Spain to California in the 1700s, almonds are now California’s top agricultural export, covering more than half a million acres in the lush San Joaquin, Fresno and Sacramento valleys. And it’s no wonder they’re the top nut—they’re packed with protein and perfect for adding a mild nuttiness to any dish. Some culinary creations, might be overwhelmed by the heartiness of whole almonds, so for these more delicate dishes, we highly recommend Trader Joe’s Unsalted Dry Toasted Sliced Almonds.

Parmigiano Reggiano Stravecchio.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s Parmigiano Reggiano Stravecchio is the real deal. While you may find similar cheeses produced outside of Italy (and the EU) labeled “Parmesan”, these are not the same as authentic Parmigiano Reggiano, which by law may only be made under strict regulations in the regions surrounding Parma and Reggio-Emilia in northern-central Italy. Italian’s call true Parmigiano Reggiano the “King of Cheeses” which, for a country known for their cuisine, and specifically cheeses, is not a label they’re likely to slap on anything edible. And that’s exactly why we source Parmigiano Reggiano Stravecchio that is produced by a century-old cheese company in the province of Parma.

Raw (unpasteurized) cow’s milk is curdled, drained, and packed into round molds reading for aging. And the aging, itself, is what makes this cheese a cut above. Notice that term you’ve never heard before: “stravecchio”. It means “very old” in Italian (or “very mature” when describing cheese) and is used to let the buyer know that this cheese has been aged a full 36 months before hitting the market. We know what you’re thinking, “unaged Parm is already so good, why do I have to wait three more years?” And to that we say just try a bite and you’ll understand why.

Parmigiano Reggiano Stravecchio is more mellow than a younger Parmesan and lacks the acidity and pale color of a young cheese. The extra aging brings to the cheese a fuller, more complex taste, grainy texture, and plenty of desirable crunchy amino acid crystals found in hard Parmesan.

Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito.item_story_marketing:
Some days, there’s just nothing better than a burger. On others, a big, well-laden salad is just the thing. On many days, though—most days, we’d argue—a burrito is pretty hard to beat. For those days, we carry Trader Joe’s Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito, made for us with a classic, hearty, homestyle recipe of spiced ground beef, chopped onions, shredded white Cheddar, and savory-seasoned pinto beans, all tightly wrapped in a soft flour tortilla. After just a few minutes in the microwave (or a little longer in a conventional oven), these Burritos make a seriously satisfying option for an easy work lunch, or even a quick, on-the-go snack. 

Full-flavored and filling, every bite of this Beef, Bean & Cheese Burrito offers a nice mix of meaty and melted- cheese textures, a whole host of savory seasoning sensations, and a provocative level of pleasantly peppery heat. While it can be enjoyed totally on its own, or even straight from the fridge (if cold burritos are your thing), we’re particularly partial to pairing it up with a few savory sides and sauces. We recommend a handful of Truly Tortilla Chips and your favorite TJ’s salsa or guacamole, and a few dabs of our Habanero Hot Sauce (if fiery-hot burritos are your thing.)

Premium Extra Virgin Olive Oil Cold Pres.item_title: Premium Extra Virgin Olive Oil Cold Pressed
Premium Extra Virgin Olive Oil Cold Pres.item_story_marketing:
It would be difficult to overstate the importance of having a good extra virgin olive oil on hand. Even aside from its capabilities as a cooking oil, EVOO has so much to offer in the kitchen: it’s a crucial component of all sorts of sauces, a boon to baking, and a terrific topping when drizzled over roasted veggies, freshly grilled meat and seafood, or al dente pasta. And that’s before you even consider tasting the full flavor of the olive oil on its own, dipped with a bit of crusty bread. For all these reasons and more, we’re always working to ensure that our olive oil selection represents both the highest quality and the greatest value—two distinctions which are expertly expressed in Trader Joe’s Premium Cold Pressed Extra Virgin Olive Oil. 

Made with a blend of olives selected from orchards across the globe, then carefully Cold-Pressed and packed for us in Italy, this full-flavored and delightfully robust Olive Oil is delightfully grassy on the nose, with a smooth profile that’s punctuated by notes of pepper. Crispy Dried Watermelon.item_story_marketing:
Watermelon-lovers and single-ingredient snack stans, prepare to have your rind blown! Trader Joe’s Crispy Dried Watermelon packs all the flavor and fun of fresh, juicy watermelon into one simple snack that you can enjoy sans sticky fingers. This marvel of melon engineering starts with juicy, peak-season watermelon, which we slice, remove from the rind, and vacuum-dry at a low temperature. The result? A crispy, feather-light feat of fruitiness that allows you enjoy some sun-soaked, summery sweetness anytime, anywhere. (Fun fact: it takes 1.5 lbs. of fresh Watermelon to fill each 1.41-oz bag!) 

While Trader Joe’s Crispy Dried Watermelon is, of course, a snack you can eat straight from the bag, we urge you to consider other applications, as well. Toss it into your trail mix. Crumble it over yogurt or ice cream. Or grind it to a fine powder, then fold it into frosting, stir it into cupcake batter, or combine it with TJ’s Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar to rim a cocktail glass! We can hear you whispering now...Wow, what-a-melon!

Shredded Potato Hash Browns.item_story_marketing: Trader Joe’s Shredded Hash browns cook up light and crispy and are the perfect accompaniment to a breakfast that starts your day off right!

Yellow Mini Sheet Cake.item_story_marketing:
Since their launch in 2018, the specialty bakery-quality and unmatched value of Trader Joe’s Mini Sheet Cakes have earned them cult favorite status among our customers. Well, almost all of them. No matter how you enjoy this Yellow Mini Sheet Cake (on a plate with a scoop of ice cream while donning a cone-shaped party hat, or fork-to-mouth out of the container on a random Tuesday), one bite will have gluten- free and gluten-ful fans alike proclaiming, “It’s out-of-this-world delicious and it’s a great value?? Trader Joe’s does it again!”

Lentils.item_story_marketing:
Lentils are loved all over the world for their nutritiousness, tasty texture, and ease of prep. Trader Joe’s is known for lentils because... we sell a wide variety of products featuring lentils! And perhaps the most convenient and versatile of them all is Trader Joe’s Lentils. 

Each 15-ounce can is packed with Lentils that have been cultivated in Australia and processed in Egypt for Trader Joe’s. We intentionally keep it simple—just Lentils, water, and sea salt—so you have the broadest number of options when it’s time to incorporate these legumes into your meal plans. Add some to your next batch of vegetable soup or stew. Combine with chopped fresh veggies (cucumbers, red onions, and bell peppers) for a salad that’s a textural symphony—a fiber fantasia, if you will! Truly, three grams of fiber per 2/3 cup serving (10.5 grams per can) is no fantasy, it’s the real deal. And because Trader Joe’s Lentils come in a can, you can store this hearty, healthy option in your pantry so it’s always available to enhance whatever you’re cooking up.

Yangnyeom Sauce.item_story_marketing:
Korean Style Yangnyeom Sauce According to food historians, Yangnyeom Sauce was invented by a restaurant owner in Korea as a response to complaints that the skin on his establishment’s fried chicken was far too crunchy. Rather than change his batter recipe, the restauranteur whipped together a sticky-sweet and spicy sauce of gochujang, sugar, and various savory spices to serve over the chicken, thus softening it. Beyond the textural benefit, customers fell in love with the sauce, and yangnyeom (Korean for “seasoned,” pronounced “YANG-nyum”) chicken soon became a certified bar food craze. 

Inspired by this bit of on-the-fly ingenuity, Trader Joe’s Yangnyeom Sauce offers all the same satisfying gochujang spice and sugary sweetness that made yangnyeom chicken famous. And while it is indeed incredibly delicious on some crispy-fried chicken, that’s just the beginning, as far as we’re concerned. We recommend trying it on everything from roasted veggies to grilled short ribs, air-fried salmon, shrimp tacos, and omelettes. Frankly, we’ll even use it as a dip for French fries... or as sauce on a homemade Pizza topped with Pepper Jack Cheese, Spicy Chicken Nuggets, and cilantro or green onions (trust us on this one—it’s delicious.)

Shishito Peppers.item_story_marketing:
Grown for us in the U.S. and Mexico, our Shishito Peppers are small-ish, slender, and brilliantly green. They’re grassy and peppery with faint notes of citrus; their delicate skins and slightly pleated exteriors provide a satisfying crunch when enjoyed raw, and a tender bite when cooked. Because some (approximately one in ten) Shishitos are actually quite hot, the act of popping these Peppers is a bit of an adventure... and the suspense is all part of the fun!

You can eat Shishitos raw, though we suggest cooking them for maximum enjoyment. Toss your Peppers in olive oil, then add them to a hot skillet and cook over high heat for 5-7 minutes, until they char and blister. Or arrange them on a foil-lined baking sheet and roast them in the oven as part of an easy-peasy, one-pan dinner. Pro-tip: poke a little hole in each Pepper beforehand—it allows steam to escape so your Shishitos don’t burst.

Teeny Tiny Tomatoes.item_story_marketing:
It’s like we always say: it isn’t the size of the produce that counts—it’s the size of the value! This adage is particularly true when the produce in question is of the purposely Teeny Tiny variety, like Teeny Tiny Tomatoes. Value is, after all, the intersection of quality and price, and by that estimation Trader Joe’s Teeny Tiny Tomatoes deliver a truly outstanding value, indeed! Each adorable, tomato-shaped package contains about two large handfuls’ worth of gorgeous red, orange, and yellow tomatoes. They’re greenhouse-grown for us Mexico and bursting with earthy, tangy, and ever-so-slightly-sweet tomato flavor, as greenhouse-grown tomatoes tend to be.

Take a pack to school or work with you and pop ‘em in your mouth (preferably one at a time—safety first) as a midday snack. Better yet, be a super-sweetie and present a package to your Valentine in lieu of candy. Or slice them up and add them to a Pizza Ranch Salad, a bowl of Spaghetti Triangoletti, or a slice of avocado toast made with Seedy Multigrain Bread. The Tomatoes might be Tiny, but the possibilities are enormous!

Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs.item_story_marketing:
Meatballs are one of those dishes that, while fundamentally hearty and delicious, even in their most basic, unembellished form, really benefit from a litte plussing up. In the case of Trader Joe’s Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs, for example, our supplier has applied some truly appetizing upgrades. Their recipe starts with a base of tender, ground, 100% Angus Beef, to which they add a bit of panko breadcrumbs, to create an even more toothsome texture, along with onion and garlic purée, a blend of aromatic herbs like basil and oregano, as well as grated Parmesan and Romano cheeses for some extra umami. It all results in a super flavorful and texturally satisfying Meatball, which cooks quickly and easily at home.

Once fully cooked (which only takes 10 to 20 minutes in your air fryer or conventional oven), our Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs make an excellent addition to soups, submarine sandwiches, and, of course, a classic plate of spaghetti, dressed with any of our marvelous marina options (Trader Joe’s Roasted Garlic Marinara Sauce is an especially inspired choice.) They’re amazing as appetizers when served with something rich and tangy to dip them in, like our Thick, Bold & Spicy Red, Sweet Dill Mustard, or Organic Kansas City Style BBQ sauces. And for a fun, flavorful twist on sliders, smash them in the frying pan, cook all the way through, and serve on a sliced Aloha Roll.

Dark Chocolate Covered Bon Bon Cookies.item_title: Dark Chocolate Covered Bon Bon Cookies
Dark Chocolate Covered Bon Bon Cookies.item_story_marketing:
In French, “bon” means “good.” Thus, we can infer that “bon bon” is twice as good. We can further infer that, based on their name, Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Bon Bon Cookies aren’t just good, they’re doubly good.

Our Bon Bon Cookies are crafted for us by an expert chocolatier in Belgium. Each one starts with a crispy, circular vanilla cookie topped with a delicate and fluffy Dark Chocolate mousse, then is enrobed with yet another layer of rich, Belgian Dark Chocolate and finished with a sprinkle of crunchy, roasted cocoa nibs. Double Cream Brie.item_story_marketing:
The idea of any Double Cream cheese is that it contains at least 60% butterfat, guaranteeing a rich and creamy result in every bite... and we’re doubling down on the declaration that Double Cream cheeses are, in fact, doubly delicious. Dubious? Doubtful? Don’t be. Instead, head to the cheese case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and pick up a mini-wheel of Trader Joe’s Double Cream Brie.

Made in the traditional French style by a respected Wisconsin cheesemaker, our Double Cream Brie’s bloomy rind envelops a smooth, rich, creamy cheese, delivering exactly what you want from a classic Brie. It’s delightful on its own, served with TJ’s Chile Crackers, or added to an elevated grilled cheese sandwich. Or, to really lean into its double-creaminess, top your wheel of Brie with honey, nuts, and herbs, then wrap it in TJ’s Organic Crescent Roll dough and bake it at 350°F for about 30 minutes. The resulting “Brie en croûte” will be awesomely ooey... irresistably gooey... and oh-so-delicious.

The idea of any Double Cream cheese is that it contains at least 60% butterfat, guaranteeing a rich and creamy result in every bite. Trader Joe's Double Cream Brie is made in the traditional French style, by a respected American cheesemaker. Its bloomy rind envelops a smooth, rich, creamy cheese, delivering exactly what you want from a classic Brie. It’s delightful on its own, served with crackers, or melted in a fancy grilled cheese. To really lean into its double-creaminess, remove the rind, chop the Brie into cubes, and let it rise to room temperature. Then, using a stand mixer or hand mixer, whip the cheese on medium-high for 3-5 minutes, et voilà—whipped Brie is served!

Whipped Feta Spread.item_story_marketing:
Feta fans know that tangy, fresh-tasting feta cheese brings a pop of pleasing flavor wherever it’s added (pizzas, salads, pasta, et al.). Feta fans also know that the cheese’s crumbly texture can be somewhat limiting in certain culinary contexts. 70% Peruvian Cacao Dark Chocolate Bar.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s 70% Peruvian Cacao Dark Chocolate Bar isn’t just a chocolate bar; it’s an international love story of quality and flavor. It starts with only the finest cacao beans, singularly sourced from Peru, which, thanks to its lush climate and unique, high-altitude geography, is renowned for its high-quality cacao. There, the beans grow in harmony with the land, developing a flavor that’s unique to the Andes—earthy, aromatic, and subtly floral. Once harvested, they make their way across the Atlantic to Italy, where our skilled supplier (a renowned European chocolatier) transforms them into an exceptional Bar.

Vegetable Dumplings.item_story_marketing:

Teriyaki Mushroom Mini Bao Buns.item_story_marketing:

Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels.item_story_marketing:
On its own, caramel is a superlatively capable confection. It’s rich, buttery, and remarkably sweet—a massive presence on the palate. Nowhere is that more evident than in Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Caramels. European Grains & Seeds Bread.item_story_marketing:
Sometimes the easiest way to spice up your day is to riff on an already-established routine. For example, swap your go-to breakfast bread for Trader Joe’s European Grains & Seeds Bread. Gluten Free Oatmeal Coconut Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Imagine sinking your teeth into the perfect oatmeal raisin cookie. First, there’s the initial resistance of the ever-so-slightly crispy edges. Then, just as that resistance gives way to the cookie’s luxuriously soft and chewy interior, you’re hit with a symphony of buttery and brown-sugary flavors, punctuated by pops of super soft and sweet raisins, along with some occasional hints of complementary coconut. “It’s pitch-perfect!” You exclaim. “We agree,” we respond, “and it’s gluten free.” Shocked, you reach for the box, and there it is, plain as day: Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Oatmeal Coconut Cookies with Raisins. Well, I’ll be darned...

Now made using an updated recipe that results in an even softer, even fresher-feeling texture, these Gluten Free Oatmeal Coconut Cookies are a true triumph of gluten free baking. Teensy Candy Bars.item_story_marketing:
In the Trader Joe’s candy aisle, when we go big, we go gloriously gargantuan (see our Pound Plus Chocolate Bars [sku 20468], for example). Did you know, though, that when we go small, we go terrifically Teensy, too? Taking the concept of “fun size” to a whole new dimension, Trader Joe’s Teensy Candy Bars are made for us by the same esteemed chocolatier in Germany responsible for our Halloween-seasonal Wicked Good Mini Chocolate Bars. To make each Teensy Candy Bar, they start with an itty-bitty base of their own dense and creamy nougat, which they cover with sweet and sticky caramel and crunchy chopped peanuts, before enveloping it all in a luxurious layer of milk chocolate.

With their Lilliputian proportions, our Teensy Candy Bars make a superb anytime sweet treat—simply open the pouch, grab a Bar (or five) and enjoy. That said, we find that their size makes them spectularly suited for accessorizing or even decorating other desserts: we recommend sprinkling a few onto a scoop of Chocolate Ice Cream, pressing them into soft, freshly baked thumbprint cookies, or using to adorn a maximalist banana split.

Medium Green Ripe Pitted Olives.item_story_marketing:
Ever wonder why some olives are green and some are black? It’s all about how they’re cured: when picked right off the tree, olives are actually quite inedible. They naturally contain a few phenolic compounds that are extremely bitter to the human palate, but which can be removed by curing them in an alkali solution. In the early 20th century, a speedy curing process was developed using a combination of curing solutions, compressed air, and heat treatments to oxidize these compounds out, which results in a softer texture, milder flavor, and deep black hue. Olives cured the old-fashioned way, like Trader Joe’s Medium Green Ripe Pitted Olives, take much longer to cure, but retain their original green color, are relatively firmer in texture, and comparatively richer with buttery, briny flavor.

So, which situations call for which kind of olive? It really depends on your mood: while both Black Olives and Green Olives make a terrific topping for pizza, pasta, and salads, we find that our Green Manzanilla Olives’ bolder profile and meatier texture make them a more favorable option for those that enjoy more overt olive flavor. Similarly, that also makes them a great choice for inclusion in charcuterie boards and antipasto platters, where their bright green color will also add some verdant, visual variety. And of course, if you enjoy olives as much as we do, they’re also stupendous for simply snacking on by the handful.

Organic Concord Grape Jelly.item_story_marketing:
With their deep, dark juice and lusciously sweet taste, Concord grapes are utterly ideal for making jellies that are jam-packed with flavor. Take Trader Joe’s Organic Concord Grape Jelly, for instance. It’s made for us by a trusted supplier with a proven track record of phenomenally flavorful fruit preserves. They use a mix of Organic Concord Grape juice concentrate and organic sugar (rather than corn syrup) to create a super smooth, joyously juicy, and potently purple Jelly that will elevate everything from breakfast breads and bagels, to homemade jelly donuts and Danishes, to, of course, an everyday PB&J.

Speaking of sandwiches, our Organic Concord Grape Jelly is conveniently contained within a squeeze bottle that’s been affixed with a ribbon-style oblong opening on the cap. This way, the Jelly comes out in a nice, straight line for ease of application on all sorts of sandwich breads. We also find that it makes it easier to spread over a cheese board to provide a bit of complementary fruitiness to an aged Cheddar or Manchego. And even beyond sandwiches and cheeses, this Jelly is just the thing for adding a delightful depth of flavor to homemade barbecue sauces, marinades, and slow-cooker sauces for simmering a batch of Party Size Mini Meatballs.

Strawberry Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream.item_title: Strawberry Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Cones
Strawberry Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream.item_story_marketing:
Picture this: you’ve just finished a romantic dinner with your one and only, a dinner made by you, with tender loving care. While your present company might be expecting the standard dessert indulgences, we’d like to propose an alternative: instead of bringing out the chocolate cake (or perhaps in addition to bringing out the chocolate cake), surprise your beloved with a bouquet of Trader Joe’s Strawberry Hold the Cone! Mini Ice Cream Cones!

Identical in size and shape to their everyday Chocolate, Vanilla, and Chocolate Chip Hold the Cone! counterparts, these latest Cones put a sweet, Strawberry spin on what has become one of our most popular products of all time. Finally, the Cones are dipped, ice cream-side down, in that same chocolatey coating that lines the cone... and the result is an all-occasion Ice Cream novelty to remember. Move over, chocolate-covered strawberries—there’s a new berry-licious treat in town.

Chicken Mole.item_story_marketing:
Mention mole [MO-lay] and many people think of chocolate, and there are, in fact, sensational versions of mole that include chocolate. If you zoom out, however, you soon see the true ways of mole are manifold. After all, the very definition of this Aztec-derived word speaks to its myriad manifestations: sauce. Trader Joe’s Chicken Mole is not a chocolate-based version; it is rather sensational.

Inspired by recipes from Central Mexico, we simmer boneless, skinless Chicken leg meat in a Mole rojo (“red”). This tomato-based iteration is made with dried guajillo and pasilla peppers, which serve to darken the color of the sauce, while also adding some spicy heat. The flavor is further deepened with spices that include garlic, onion, coriander, and cinnamon.

After cooking, the tender pieces of Chicken in the rich Mole are flash frozen, so all you have to do when you get the 16-ounce package home is heat it (in the microwave or on the stovetop) and eat it! Tuck this Mole into some TJ’s Organic Yellow Corn Taco Shells, or wrap it in your favorite TJ’s Tortillas with some cheese and bake with our Enchilada Sauce. Or simply enjoy the authentic Mole flavor served atop a bed of our Spanish Style Rice with a scoop of TJ’s Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole.

Organic Sri Lankan Curry & Rice.item_story_marketing:
Sri Lankan cuisine exists at one of the most compelling culinary crossroads in the world. While it combines influences from both South Asian and Southeast Asian cooking (already two of the tastiest cuisines on the global stage), it’s undeniably a world-class culinary tradition all its own. Just take a look at the flavors, aromas, and textures to be found within Trader Joe’s Organic Sri Lankan Curry & Seasoned Rice with Cashews, for example. Made for us by an esteemed supplier in Sri Lanka, this all-in-one Curry kit contains a packet of stupendously savory, heirloom variety, wild Sri Lankan Rice and a packet of captivatingly creamy coconut Curry sauce, both of which are generously seasoned with spices like cinnamon, curry leaves, cumin seeds, and coriander. To top it all off, you’ll also find a packet of rich, roasted Cashews to provide a bit of protein, along with some complementary crunch.

Simply gently heat the contents of the Rice and Curry packets together, either in a bowl in the microwave or in saucepan on the stovetop, top with Cashews, and you have a full-flavored, phenomenally aromatic entrée for two, ready to serve in a matter of minutes. We suggest spending some of the extra time you’ll have on your hands picking out some sides and sauces to go with it: perhaps our South Asian Naan, our Southeast Asian Roti with Thai Red Curry, or our uniquely Sri Lankan Organic Mango Chutney.

Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos.item_story_marketing:
If you’re a regular at your local taqueria, chances are you’ve tried a taco dorado before. And if you haven’t, you’re in for a tasty, texturally tantalizing treat: imagine a classic, corn tortilla taco packed with savory fillings, neatly folded in half, then fried to a glorious golden (hence “dorado”) brown. Each bite starts with a resounding crunch from the crispy exterior, then continues on to the soft, super flavorful fillings inside. Drawing inspiration from this unbeatable eating experience, Trader Joe’s Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos are made for us by an expert supplier in Mexico, who fills each Taco with a mix of seasoned mashed Potatoes and ever-so- slightly spicy Poblano Peppers.

Ready after just a few minutes in the air fryer, conventional oven, or microwave, our Crispy Potato & Poblano Pepper Tacos make an excellent entrée, particularly when paired with our Southwestern Chopped Salad. They’re also an apt choice for an appetizer, especially when served with something cool or spicy to dunk them in. We recommend a generous dollop of sour cream, our Organic Chunky Homestyle Guacamole, or our Extra Hot Habanero Ghost Pepper Salsa—or a combination of all three.

Spicy Chicken Nuggets.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to classic, heat-n-eat fingerfoods with a kick, Trader Joe’s Spicy Chicken Nuggets don’t just talk the talk—they strut their Spicy stuff! They’re made with all-natural Chicken breast and rib meat, from hens raised on all-vegetarian feed and never given antibiotics or hormones. The bite-sized, classically Nugget- shaped patties are breaded with wheat, rice and corn flours, then covered in a cayenne-based hot sauce and lightly fried to a golden brown. (Hints of garlic and vinegar make the sauce as savory and tangy as it is Spicy, so you can think of them as the fiery lovechild[ren] of classic Chicken Nuggets and game-day hot wings.)

Like we said, these Nugs bring the heat, and since they’re fully cooked and refrigerated (not frozen), they only need a few minutes in the air fryer, oven, or microwave before they’re ready to go. And by “ready to go,” we mean ready to dip. For heat-seekers craving even more savory, spicy flavor, try dipping them in Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce, Hot Honey Mustard Dressing or Spicy Honey Sauce; for Nugget-noshers looking to take a walk on the milder side, go with Organic Kansas City Style BBQ sauce or Buttermilk Ranch Dressing... or whatever sauce suits the mood!

Sliced Bresaola Uncured Beef Prosciutto.item_story_marketing:
Like many traditional foods, bresaola originated out of pure necessity. Way back in the medieval era, fresh meat was scarce during Northern Italy’s frigid winters, so locals would prepare by salting, seasoning, and dry-aging beef to preserve it—much in the same way one would with fresh pork for prosciutto. During the dry-aging process, the beef would lose most of its moisture, reducing its total weight by nearly half and concentrating its rich, meaty flavor significantly. While preservation techniques have certainly evolved, global appreciation for bresaola’s bold and beefy flavor has only grown over the centuries, which is precisely why we’ve brought in Trader Joe’s Sliced Bresaola to our refrigerator cases.

Sliced thin and ready to serve, right out of the package, our Bresaola makes a fantastic filling for a homemade deli sandwich, a terrific topper for a plate of pasta, and an inspired choice for including in a charcuterie board. It astounds as part of a classic Italian appetizer when served with Arugula and Shaved Parmigiano Reggiano, and satisfies when enjoyed on its own as a simple, savory snack. We also emphatically endorse enhancing it with a little Sicilian Lemon Juice and Oregano or Balsamic Vinegar of Modena.

Hot Honey Mustard Dressing.item_story_marketing:
When a product combines deliciousness with versatility, you might say it hits the “sweet spot.” But when you have a product like Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Mustard Dressing—which combines deliciousness, versatility, and heat—we call that the “sweet & hot spot”! This orange-yellow sauce is smooth and creamy, with visible specks of cayenne and crushed red pepper. It has a honey aroma and a tangy, savory heat that will add sweetness and spice to whatever you like.

It’s a no brainer for dipping. Try it with any of our nuggets, like TJ’s Gluten Free Chicken Breast Nuggets, or our Organic Chicken Nuggets. If you really like it hot, we recommend that you dip our Spicy Chicken Nuggets into this Hot Honey Mustard Dressing for a combo that is “fire,” in more ways than one!

Use TJ’s Hot Honey Mustard as a glaze for our Party Size Mini Meatballs, or to marinate Trader Joe’s All Natural Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs before they hit the grill. And, of course, with “Dressing” in the name, you’ve got to assume that this Hot Honey Mustard is tasty tossed with greens, like our Organic Baby Spring Mix. And you would be correct!

Creamy Dreamy Hummus.item_story_marketing:
Hummus is one of those dishes that demonstrates the true benefits of simplicity. Typically, most hummus starts with a base of just four primary ingredients: chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice. From there, you’re free to use it as your canvas—we’ve certainly done so, incorporating other flavors like Roasted Red Pepper, Olive Tapenade, and Crunchy Chili Onion. But even aside from adding flavors, just adjusting the proportions of one of the existing base ingredients yields remarkable results. Take Trader Joe’s Dreamy Creamy Hummus, for instance. Here, our supplier simply increases the ratio of tahini within their recipe to create a texture so thick, rich, and exquisitely Creamy that it’s simply Dreamy.

With its luxuriously smooth consistency and savory, ever-so-slightly tart flavor profile, our Creamy Dreamy Hummus makes and excellent (and easy) appetizer. Simply pair it with something crunchy and dippable, like our Pita Chips or Papadums. It’s also always welcome as part of a mezze plate or crudités platter, and acts as a truly stupendous spread for a grilled veggie sandwich, a Shawarma Chicken wrap, or pita pocket filled with Falafel.

Cookies & Crème Pretzel Slims.item_story_marketing:
Like many great food inventions, the ‘cookies and cream’ flavor has uncertain origins. While we may not know exactly who first had the idea to blend ice cream with crushed-up chocolate sandwich cookies, there’s one thing we can safely assume—that person was a genius! And since the late 1970s, this cookies-and-cream concept has been applied to cakes, milkshakes, candy bars, and even trail mixes. Now Trader Joe’s has added another shining star to the cookies-and-cream universe: Cookies & Crème Pretzel Slims.

The base for these treats is Trader Joe’s Pretzel Slims with their thin, crisp, salty character. Each Pretzel is dunked in a creamy confectionary coating that includes notes of natural vanilla flavor, and crushed bits of Trader Joe’s Chocolate Vanilla Bean Cream Joe-Joe’s cookies. That would be enough—but we couldn’t help but add a final flourish of chocolatey drizzle.

Are Trader Joe’s Cookies & Crème Pretzel Slims worthy of their ingenius heritage? Perhaps you might weigh in. Just swing by your Neighborhood Trader Joe’s, buy a package... and proceed to taste!

Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon.item_title: Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon
Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon.item_story_marketing:
This is no ordinary salmon. In fact, we think it’s pretty special. Trader Joe’s Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon is made for us from a family recipe that dates back more than seventy years. A combination of the traditions of Native Alaskans and those of the Norwegian immigrants who made their way across the world to this same region, our recipe results in a naturally delightful delicacy. Wild Sockeye Salmon from icy cold Alaskan water is smoked slowly over native hardwoods and seasoned with salt.

Sounds simple enough but trust us, smoked salmon of this quality, with flavor this mild and sweet, is rare indeed. You can serve Trader Joe’s Wild Nova Style Smoked Sockeye Salmon with bagels and cream cheese, of course. But why stop there? Try it tossed into your favorite green salad, in omelets or your favorite pasta dish.

Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese Blend.item_story_marketing:
Hailing from its humble beginnings as a derivative of Monterey Jack, the original “American” cheese, when it was invented by the Mexican Franciscan friars of sunny and coastal Monterey, California. Our Pepper Jack Cheese uses a mild, creamy and Shredded Monterey Jack cheese as its base - it is, afterall, where it gets the name “Jack”. However, instead of allowing the Monterey Jack to fully mature and turn into the well-loved, semi-soft cheese that it is, peppers are added during the cheesemaking process. This is where the “Pepper” part of the name comes in. Jalapeño peppers, habanero peppers, and red bell peppers are diced and added into the cheese resulting in perfectly spicy and incredibly herbaceous cheese. You could say we put the ‘pepper’ in Pepper Jack!

These bold flavors go wonderful with quesadillas, and used to top hamburger patties. Whether you’re just finding a shredded cheese to top your salads with a little kick or trying to zest up your summer cookout, Trader Joe’s Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese is waiting in its resealable bag ready to get swept at a moment’s notice.

Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb.item_story_marketing:
As if one needed yet another reason to love butter, we invite you to consider the transformative power that Trader Joe’s Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb brings to the table. It’s made for us in small batches by a creamery with an uncommon knack for compound butters, who mixes in a hefty portion of Parmesan cheese along with dried garlic and parsley into smooth, salted butter. (What do we mean by hefty? Our supplier mixes in so much Parmesan that each four-ounce roll is roughly 25% cheese, by weight!) It all results in a splendidly savory and oh-so-spreadable butter that’s ready to bring some rich, full flavor to all sorts of culinary contexts.

Try melting a bit of our Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb over a plate of soft, scrambled eggs at breakfast, spreading it over a grilled cheese sandwich at lunch, or adding a pat to a freshly baked potato at dinner. For some easy, delightfully umami-rich snacks and sides, melt some of this Butter in the microwave and slowly drizzle it over a bowl of popcorn, a plate of corn of the cob, or a sheet pan of your favorite roasted veggies. And if you’re ever in need of some quick garlic bread (and who isn’t, really?), simply spread a bit over a split baguette, toast in the oven at 400°F for about 10-12 minutes, and enjoy!

Caesar Salad Dip.item_story_marketing:
There are few flavor profiles out there as satisfyingly savory, captivatingly creamy, and remarkably rich in umami as a classic Caesar salad, so we’re always working to find ways to place it into new culinary contexts. Our latest foray into Caesar-ified fare, Trader Joe’s Caesar Salad Dip, might be our most ambitious experiment yet. That’s because our supplier packs each tub with a creamy base that includes Caesar-y seasoned sour cream, mayo, anchovy paste, and Parmesan cheese, as well as finely shredded Romaine lettuce to give every bite some crisp, leafy contrast.

Excellent when enjoyed as an appetizer with your favorite chip, cracker, or crostini, Trader Joe’s Caesar Salad Dip is a game-changer for game-day get-togethers, a coup for cocktail parties, and an asset to everyday, anytime snacking. Just like the Salad that inspired it, its full flavors and rich textures make an excellent lead-in to all sorts of savory entrées, like a freshly seared steak or air-fried salmon fillet. We also like it as a sandwich spread, too—in fact, we find that it makes an especially excellent sandwich when spread over a split, toasted baguette and topped with Simply Roasted Chicken Breast.

Lemon Stuffed Olives.item_story_marketing:
Here at Trader Joe’s—particularly during the holidays—we’re big on Chalkidki olives. That’s because Chalkidiki olives are big on flavor, big on buttery texture, and, well, generally quite big. That makes them especially ideal for stuffing with other foods that complement their bold and briny flavor profiles, as can be seen (or more importantly, tasted) in our creamy, tangy, and super savory Blue Cheese Stuffed Chalkidiki Olives. New for this year, we have Trader Joe’s Lemon Stuffed Olives, which take a decidedly more citric approach to yield similarly sumptuous results.

To make each batch, our supplier in Greece starts with pitted, generously-sized Chalkidiki Olives, cured according to Greek tradition to ensure a firm, meaty texture and full, fruity flavor. They then stuff each Olive with tart and zesty Lemon peel, pack them in brine, and send them our way, where they await being added to cocktails, mezze plates, and charcuterie boards by you. We recommend serving them with cheeses, slicing them and using as a topping for homemade pizza and focaccia, and simply snacking on them, right out of the jar. We also recommend picking them up from your neighborhood Trader Joe’s sooner rather than later, as supplies are limited.

Whipt™ Plant Based Dairy Free Whipped Co.item_title: Whipt™ Plant Based Dairy Free Whipped Coconut
Whipt™ Plant Based Dairy Free Whipped Co.item_story_marketing:
When our suppliers are challenged to provide all we need for our customers, we will occasionally source alternate products to sell in the meantime. Of course, in these cases our goal is always to provide a ‘fill-in’ that is as high-quality as what we’ve been selling all along. In the case of our current non-dairy whipped cream alternative needs, we’re working with the folks at Whipt™ to bring in their light and fluffy Plant Based Dairy-Free Coconut Whipped Topping to our stores for a limited time.

Vegan, gluten free, and kosher, Whipt™ Coconut Whipped Topping is a excellent option for finishing off baked goods, coffee drinks, and all sorts of sweet treats, while also accommodating a wide range of dietary preferences. With its luxuriously soft and airy texture texture, and delicately sweet flavor, we find that it’s especially suited for using as a topping for a brownie, a bowl of (also vegan!) Chocolate Non-Dairy Frozen Dessert, or even just a plate of fresh, cut fruit. And with the holidays just around the corner, you’re going to want to make sure you’ve Whipt™ at the ready for adding a dollop to a slice of cake after the big meal!

French Onion Popcorn.item_story_marketing:
When you’ve been in the snack game for as long as we have, you learn a few things. First, you learn that inspiration for a snack can come from anywhere. Second, you learn that the inspiration for some of the greatest snacks you’ve ever tasted can come from the most unexpected places. To wit: practically no one would have expected that soup-flavored Popcorn would be so unbelievably delicious, and yet here we are with Trader Joe’s French Onion Popcorn.

Modeled after the cheesy, caramelized onion-y, and umami-ful flavors of a fresh crock of French Onion soup, each kernel of this superlatively savory Popcorn is seasoned with a mix of garlic powder, onion powder, and Parmesan cheese, along with a mix of spices to evoke the essence of a rich, flavorful broth in every bite. Enjoy Trader Joe’s French Onion Popcorn by the handful while watching a movie, sprinkle around a charcuterie board or cheese plate for some light, contrasting crunch, or simply munch with abandon as an anytime snack. Just be sure to pick up a bag while you can, because this limited-supply Popcorn is only available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s in the late autumn and winter—soup season, in other words.

Elevated Cracker Assortment.item_story_marketing:
Crackers are often seen as sidekicks in the snack world—quiet companions to cheeses, spreads, and charcuterie. But this holiday season, Trader Joe’s Elevated Cracker Assortment is here to put crackers center stage. Made in the United Kingdom with by the same esteemed biscuit supplier (U.K. “biscuit” = U.S. “cracker”) behind our everyday TJ’s Chile Crackers, this Cracker trio will Elevate your snack game from everyday to extraordinary.

The Assortment comes with three types of distinctly delightful Crackers. Each variety is made with buttermilk and extra virgin olive oil (Elevated, indeed!), each one is perfectly sized for snacking & stacking, and each one is packaged in its own elegant cardboard serving tray. First up, we have Plum & Date Toasts—crisp, dark- toasted crackers studded with bits of dried plum and dates (they make up 40% of the recipe). They’re a little crunchy, a little chewy, and pair beautifully with creamy cheeses like Brie and mascarpone. Next, we have Buttermilk Crackers, whose mild and slightly tangy, buttermilk flavor makes them great bases for bolder meats and cheeses, like TJ’s Truffle Salami and TJ’s White Stilton with Cranberries. Finally, there are Lemon & Black Pepper Crackers—they’re infused with lemon juice concentrate, lemon purée, and black pepper, and they’re excellent complements to smoked salmon, tinned fish, and any cheese that could benefit from a hint of brightness and a peppery kick. Three great Crackers; one Elevated Assortment—grab a box and let the sophisticated snacking begin!

Mini Mushroom Tartelettes.item_story_marketing:
Combining the umami elegance of sliced white and shiitake mushrooms, the aromatic excellence of chopped garlic and shallot, and the enchanting cheesiness of Parmesan, cream cheese, and ricotta, then delivering them all together in flaky, bite-sized crusts, Trader Joe’s Mini Mushroom Tartelettes are hors d’oeuvres for all occasions. Whether they’re enjoyed as a starter at a sophisticated dinner party with friends, as a straight-from- the-air-fryer midnight snack, or even as an entrée when paired with a leafy green salad, their mix of savory, herby, and buttery flavors are certain to satisfy.

Beyond satisfying the palate, which these Tartelettes do with aplomb, the fact that they’re super easy to prep is properly satisfying, too: just a few minutes in the conventional oven or air fryer, and they go from frozen to golden brown and crispy. And, of course, the remarkably reasonable retail at which we’re offering them might be their most satisfying trait of all. While our Mini Mushroom Tartelettes are hors d’oeuvres for all occasions, they’re not available for all seasons. You’ll only find them in our freezers during the holidays, and only while supplies last.

Garlic Gondolas.item_story_marketing:
Just as gondolas are the ideal vehicle for traversing Venice’s iconic system of canals, it turns out that bread- based Gondolas just so happen to be the ideal vehicle for rich garlic and melty cheese. That’s the discovery our buyer made when first encountering Trader Joe’s Garlic Gondolas, which are made for us by an esteemed supplier in Italy. Each one starts with hearty, rustic pizza dough, which is formed into a Gondola-esque shape, then filled with a gloriously garlicky, buttery sauce and sprinkled with grated cheese. After that, they’re baked in a stone oven until crisp, then flash frozen, so that you can easily enjoy at home.

Seriously: all it takes is about 10 minutes at 425°F to fill your kitchen with the enchanting aroma of roasted Garlic, after which you’re free to enjoy your Gondolas as an appetizer, side, or even an entrée. Each Gondola eats a bit like a mix between pizza and garlic bread—like a slightly open-faced calzone—and as such, pairs particularly well with soup, a bit of pasta, or a leafy green salad. And if you’re more in the mood to make your Gondola a meal, try topping it with a protein and some chopped veggies, and set sail.

Olive Tapenade Hummus.item_story_marketing:
“The secret of happiness, you see, is not found in seeking more, but in developing the capacity to combine olives and hummus.” —Socrates

Okay, we admit that Socrates definitely didn’t say that, but our product developers probably did when they dreamed up the mezze marvel known as Trader Joe’s Olive Tapenade Hummus. In the center of each tub lies a just-right amount of briny Olive Tapenade made with black olives, manzanilla olives, capers, and olive oil. Not to be outshined by its piquant partner, the Hummus base is special in its own right. With twice the tahini of traditional hummus, it’s especially smooth and nutty with complementary sweet and savory flavors. Mix both spreads together, and you have a bold, balanced Olive Tapenade Hummus that’s sure to get a smile out of even the biggest of stoics.

If you have the virtue of patience, plate your desired amount of Hummus and bring to room temperature before enjoying as a dip for veggie sticks, Pita Bite Crackers, and Papadum Lentil and Chickpea Crisps. Or, spread it over a piece of Lavash Bread and top with cooked Gyro Slices & chopped cucumbers, then roll it all up into a Middle East-inspired wrap.

Jingly Jangly.item_story_marketing:
Jingle, jangle, jingle, jangle... that’s the sound of a one-horse open sleigh dashing through the snow! But what does "jingle, jangle" taste like? Trader Joe’s Jingle Jangle tastes like a captivating combination of dark and milk chocolate-covered pretzels, dark chocolate covered caramel popcorn and Joe-Joe’s cookie bits, milk chocolate candy gems, and both milk and dark chocolate mini peanut butter cups. Every year, it seems like our customers buy more and more of these festive tins, and since we expect this year to be no different, and we’ve stocked up to make sure everyone can get their share of Jingle Jangle. Plus, in response to the ever-growing Jingle Jangle demand, we created a more portable version that we call Jingly Jangly. 

Trader Joe’s Jingly Jangly comes in a petite bag with about a cup’s worth of this iconic, classic candy mix. Stash a bag of Jingly Jangly in your backpack or purse for anytime, anywhere, Jingle Jangle fun!

Manchego Cheese.item_story_marketing: Produced exclusively in Spain’s La Mancha region, Manchego is a sheep’s milk cheese that’s been produced for hundreds of years. (Cervantes mentioned it in his Don Quixote.) It’s still crafted exclusively from the whole milk of the region’s Manchega sheep according to strict, traditional methods. From the six months careful aging to the basket-weave pattern on the cheese’s rind, to the aromas of flowers, nuts, and lavender, Trader Joe's Manchego is traditional in all ways but one: price. Generally, the price for this very special cheese tends to be very high. But because we sell a great deal of Manchego, we’ve been able to negotiate a terrific cost from our supplier, which in turn enables us to offer it to you for an excellent price. Try it shaved over a salad, as part of a charcuterie board with Truffle Salami, or really break the mold and melt slices over a burger to create a buzz of international proportions.

Cotswold Double Gloucester Cheese.item_story_marketing:
Cotswold is a variation on classic Double Gloucester cheese that has been imbued with chopped onions and chives for added flavor. It begins its life as a pasteurized whole milk cheese that originates in Gloucestershire County, England. It’s a golden yellow, semi-hard cheese that is similar to cheddar, but not quite as hard. The “double” variety is aged longer than “Single Gloucester” which lends to a firmer cheese with a stronger, more savory flavor.

The flavors of our Cotswold Double Gloucester are creamy, buttery, sweet and mild, yet full-flavoured like a cheddar cheese. With the added onions and chives, each bite has an extra-savory zing guaranteed to satisfy. Double Gloucester is a common pub cheese in England, making an iteration such as our Cotswold Double Gloucester a wonderful pairing with any beer or a bold Zinfandel, Shiraz, or Chardonnay. So remember to stop by the wine and beer section after picking up a block of cheese from our cheese cooler.

Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt Pla.item_title: Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt Plain
Strained Thick & Creamy Greek Yogurt Pla.item_story_marketing:
Food trends come and go, but every so often, a culinary innovation will come along that truly thrills our taste buds. Trader Joe’s Strained Thick & Creamy Plain Greek Yogurt is one such innovation. Made with whole milk and cream, our supplier employs a special straining process to remove excess whey from the finished Greek Yogurt, resulting in a velvety, Thick & Creamy texture, but with a less tangy flavor than our other Greek yogurt offerings. What’s more, the Plain Yogurt is cultured after pasteurization (hello, live and active cultures!) and boasts 15 grams of protein per ¾-cup serving to boot!

We’re offering this kosher-certified Strained Greek Yogurt in an impressively sized 32-ounce tub, because you’ll truly want to enjoy it that often: topped with granola and fresh fruit, swirled into smoothies and sauces for extra creaminess, or mixed with lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic for a savory chicken marinade that yields unbelievably moist and flavorful results. You’ll find this delightful dairy innovation in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, every day.

Vanilla & Cream Yogurt.item_story_marketing:
After our former flavored yogurt cups supplier could no longer meet our customers’ demand (a testament to how tasty our yogurt truly is), we searched high and low for a new source.. Finally, after months of testing and tasting (yum), we’re pleased to welcome Trader Joe’s Vanilla & Cream Yogurt cups to our refrigerators... and yours.  

Made with pasteurized milk from cows never treated with rBST, this classic, sweetened Yogurt gets its Vanilla & Cream flavor from natural Vanilla  flavor and, well,  Cream! It’s rich, it’s creamy, and it’s ready-to-go—each package comes with four, four-ounce cups, perfectly portioned for lunchboxes, afternoon snacks, and quick breakfasts on-the-go. We can hear you now: “All this for less than 70¢ a cup?! Yogurta be kiddin’ me, Trader Joe’s!” But we’re not kidding you, dear customer. Quite the contrary; we take yogurt—and value—very seriously.

After our former flavored yogurt cups supplier could no longer meet our customers’ demand (a testament to how tasty our yogurt truly is), we searched high and low for a new source..
