Cherry Tomatoes on the Vine.item_story_marketing:
In pretty much any circumstance, a fresh cherry tomato is going to be plump, sweet, and delightfully juicy. When it’s a fresh, greenhouse-grown cherry tomato, though, that’s all the better. And when it’s a fresh, greenhouse- grown cherry tomato that’s still on the vine? Well, now you’ve got something really special. All this to say that we’re excited to announce that something really special has just arrived at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s product section: fresh, greenhouse-grown Cherry Tomatoes on the Vine!

Hand-picked for us at the peak of ripeness, these Cherry Tomatoes on the Vine are full-to-bursting with flavor, making them an excellent ingredient for all sorts of applications. After a quick rinse, they can be enjoyed totally raw, right out of the package as an easy snack (especially when paired with a bit of Chicken Bacon Ranch Dip or hummus). Sliced, diced, or chopped, they’re great for tossing into salads or for homemade pico de gallo or guacamole. And when blistered in a saucepan, skillet, or oven, they’re a great addition to pasta dishes, and a terrific topper for grilled fish, roast chicken, and creamy polenta.

Perfect Bar Chocolate Mint.item_story_marketing:
According to his thirteen children, Dr. Bud Keith was a “health food guy” before “health food” was a thing, constantly tinkering with healthy recipes to feed his king-sized family. As the story goes, one day, he ground up a bunch of dried fruits and vegetables, mixed them with freshly ground nut butter and honey, took one bite and declared, “It’s Perfect!” –and with that simple exclamation, Perfect Bars® were born.

Available in our stores for the fall and winter seasons, Chocolate Mint Perfect Bars® are sweet, moist, and satisfyingly dense, with an irresistible, melt-in-your-mouth texture. They’re made primarily of organic peanut butter, and flavored with peppermint oil, organic dark chocolate, and a mix of organic dried whole food powders. The Bars are cold-pressed (not baked) and don’t contain any added preservatives or emulsifiers—and because of this, they should be kept in the refrigerator so their flavor and consistency remain intact. They can last up to one week at room temperature, so you can toss one in your purse, backpack, or workout bag to fuel you for the day ahead!

Hot Chocolate Stirring Spoon.item_story_marketing:
We’ve been innovating the hot-chocolate-on-a-stick world in recent years. Last year, we sold a hot cocoa stirring spoon with salted caramel and mini marshmallows. Before that, we sold a hot cocoa stirring spoon with both milk AND dark chocolate—plus mini marshmallows, of course. This year, we’re going back to basics with our Hot Chocolate Stirring Spoon. As before, this handy Spoon is Hot Chocolate waiting to happen. All it requires is a mug of steaming hot milk (or non-dairy beverage), into which you simply dunk & stir. This action results in the melting, and subsequent incorporation, of the chocolate goodness into your drink. And don’t be fooled! While it may be “back to basics,” so to speak, what we’re talking about here is classic, semi-sweet chocolate made for us in the UK, that is among the highest quality chocolate in hot cocoa spoon-dom. 

Of course, those cute, vegan Mini Marshmallows will inevitably end up bobbing at the brim, beckoning a sip and a slurp as soon as your drinkable chocolate has cooled enough to enjoy. And like last year, the underlying Spoon is made entirely of wood.

Pink Lady Apple Chips.item_story_marketing:
Is it possible for an apple to be an overachiever? Pink Lady® apples would say yes. As the first apple cultivar to blossom and the last to be harvested, they soak up about 200 days of sunshine before landing in your kitchen. As a result, they boast an especially crisp bite, rosy-blush color, and balanced, sweet-tart flavor—flavor that’s amplified in Trader Joe’s Pink Lady® Apple Chips.

It all starts in Washington state, where our supplier harvests the Apples at peak freshness. They’re thinly sliced, then vacuum crisped until delightfully crunchy. What’s vacuum crisping, you ask? It’s a gentle frying method that uses a vacuum-sealed chamber to crisp the Apples at low temperature with minimal oil, helping preserve and magnify their flavor. They’re topped off with a dusting of cinnamon sugar, culminating in sweet, effervescent Apple Chips with a paradoxically juicy finish.

Snack on gluten free Pink Lady® Apple Chips right out of the bag, or crumble them over Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt or French Vanilla Ice Cream (perhaps with Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce on top?). Speaking of caramel sauce, you can always use it as a dip for your Apple Chips, or drizzle it over them for a dessert-y spin on nachos.

Pizza Ranch Salad Kit.item_story_marketing:
Would it be hyperbolic to describe pizza as "universally beloved?" Perhaps, but it's hard to deny pizza's overwhelming popularity, and when you break down the average slice of pizza to its constituent parts, it's easy to see why: rich, tangy tomato sauce, super savory cheeses, satisfylingly crisp crust, and herby, aromatic seasonings...it's a set of flavors that deserves to be celebrated in other culinary contexts, too. Which is exactly why added Trader Joe's Pizza Ranch Salad Kit to our refrigerators. Made with a base of fresh, shredded Romaine lettuce, red cabbage, and carrots, along with a set of pizza-evoking toppings like herby flatbread strips, four-cheese crisp crumbles, and grated Parmesan, each Kit also contains a superlatively creamy Ranch dressing flavored with seasonings like dried garlic, onion, and tomato powder to tie everything together.

Once tossed together, every bite of this Salad Kit brings to mind the feelings and flavors of a slice of cheese pizza, deliciously dipped in Ranch dressing. As such, we can't help but recommend serving it with one of our many fantastic frozen pizzas, like our Parlanno, Uncured Pepperoni, or family-sized Organic Cheese & Tomato varieties. That said, it's an equally excellent accompaniment to a hearty pasta, soup, or really another other savory entrée you can name. Or, if you'd prefer, it also makes a great entrée in its own right when topped with your favorite protein.

10 Minute Farro.item_story_marketing:
Nutty and chewy, with a toothsome bite that makes it an able addition to dishes of all kinds, farro typically needs to be cooked for 30-45 minutes. Our Italian supplier, however, uses an innovative process to partially pre-cook this ancient grain, so that Trader Joe’s Quick-Cook Farro can be ready in about 10 minutes—truly! 

From there, it’s adaptable to just about any meal idea you might have in mind. Add this Quick-Cook Farro to Soup for an extra dose of protein and fiber. Give it a supporting role in a grain salad for lunch—its hearty texture means in won’t get mushy if you’re taking said lunch on the go. Or, make it the base of a cozy, seasonally appropriate skillet dinner of Chicken Sausage and Apples.

With Quick-Cook Farro’s  impressive nutritional profile and quick-cooking convenience, you might expect an outsized price tag to match—not so at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s!

Crunchy Pops.item_story_marketing:
Architectural marvels like the Colosseum, the Pyramids of Giza, and Macchu Picchu have had the masses asking “how on earth did they do that?!” since time immemorial. It’s time to add Trader Joe’s Crunchy Pops to this pantheon of engineering feats, though their incredibly airy structure and pleasantly savory flavor will swiftly deem explanations inconsequential.

A lightweight blend of potato starch, pea flour, and corn flour undergoes not one, but two cooking processes. Air puffing gives the Pops their bite-sized lattice construction and unbelievably airy texture, while baking contributes satisfying crunch and subtle toasted flavor. Olive oil and salt tie everything together into a savory, light, and crunchy snack that’ll have you munching first and asking questions later.

Nosh on Crunchy Pops right out of the bag, pack a snack bag-full into lunch boxes, or heap a handful onto your plate alongside barbecue fare. For a quick cafe-style meal, serve alongside a Turkey Apple Cheddar Sandwich, a bowl of Lentil Soup with Ancient Grains, and Cut & Peeled Organic Carrots of Many Colors.

Freeze Dried Tart Cherries.item_story_marketing:
With the popularity of Trader Joe’s 100% Tart Cherry Juice, it’s only natural that mouth-puckering Freeze Dried Tart Cherries have landed on our shelves!

Freeze Dried Tart Cherries start as whole cherries that are hand-picked and pitted in the Kutahya region of Turkey. When fresh, the fruit is large and heart-shaped with firm flesh, reddish-purple coloring, and a tart taste. Their size may shrink to the size of a marble after 48-60 hours of drying, but their color and flavor? They’re amplified to their most sour, deep garnet-red form with newly crisp texture. Free from preservatives like sulfur dioxide, each resealable bag only contains Tart Cherries in tip-top, Freeze Dried form.

When eaten on their own, Freeze Dried Tart Cherries make for a naturally tart alternative to sour candy. Add delightful bursts of sourness to morning meals and desserts by sprinkling over Organic Plain Yogurt, overnight oats, or French Vanilla Ice Cream. Or, incorporate them into syrups and baked goods when you want notable Tart Cherry flavor without adding extra water.

Dark Chocolate Ganache Mini Sheet Cake.item_title: Dark Chocolate Ganache Mini Sheet Cake
Dark Chocolate Ganache Mini Sheet Cake.item_story_marketing:
Cake is too often relegated to special occasions. That’s partially because it takes too much time and effort to bake one for ‘no particular reason.’ Of course, premade cakes are always an option, but what’s typically available for purchase is either too fancy (and expensive) for everyday enjoyment, or just poor quality. Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Ganache Mini Sheet Cake is the yummy solution for people who crave quality cake—even when it’s nobody’s birthday.

This cake is “Mini”—about 6 servings. It’s a single layer of moist, flavorful chocolate cake made with buttermilk for extra richness. A delicious Dark Chocolate Ganache icing (made with butter, cream, & cream cheese) is generously spread on top, adding a decadent touch to this simple cake. Our Mini Sheet Cake is casual and small enough that your family can enjoy it as a special treat anytime. It’s also fancy and big enough to serve at an intimate dinner party. (And, you can always add candles and an icing-message on top for a mini-birthday celebration.) No need to refrigerate—the re-closeable, clear-top lid helps to keep it fresh for up to six days.

So, don’t wait until it’s someone’s birthday before you enjoy your next slice of cake. Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Ganache Mini Sheet Cake is the perfect price and the perfect size to justify a celebration everyday!

Chantilly Cream Vanilla Bean Mini Sheet.item_title: Chantilly Cream Vanilla Bean Mini Sheet Cake
Chantilly Cream Vanilla Bean Mini Sheet.item_story_marketing:
Cake is too often relegated to special occasions. A delicious Vanilla Bean buttercream icing (made with butter, cream, and cream cheese) is generously spread on top, adding a decadent touch to this simple cake. Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bar.item_story_marketing:
Oh, how we love these Chocolate Bars. Perhaps to an unnatural level, but we can live with that. Have you had Trader Joe’s Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bars? They are made from top-quality chocolate that is simply melt- in-your-mouth delicious. Our supplier is a well-known artisan confectioner in a small-town just outside of Antwerp, Belgium – Belgium is to chocolate, as Switzerland is to cheese, as Italy is to pasta.

Pound Plus Bars have been staples in our candy section for more than 20 years. Customer’s show pounds of love for them and they buy them again and again. Why? Because they’re more than a pound of delicious, creamy, dreamy chocolate. In this case, it’s Milk Chocolate with 33% cocoa solids, neatly packaged and easy to break apart and share with friends (if chocolate sharing is your thing) – each Bar measures 8x5 squares, that is.

Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bar with Almon.item_title: Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bar with Almonds
Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bar with Almon.item_story_marketing:
Oh, how we love these Chocolate Bars. Perhaps to an unnatural level, but we can live with that. Have you had Trader Joe’s Pound Plus Milk Chocolate Bars with Almonds? They are made from top-quality chocolate that is simply melt-in-your-mouth delicious with a special Almond crunch. Our supplier is a well-known artisan confectioner in a small-town just outside of Antwerp, Belgium – Belgium is to chocolate, as Switzerland is to cheese, as Italy is to pasta.

Pound Plus Bars have been staples in our candy section for more than 20 years. Customer’s show pounds of love for them and they buy them again and again. Why? Pound Plus 72% Cacao Dark Chocolate.item_story_marketing:

This makes for easy s’mores separation with TJ’s Honey Graham Crackers and marshmallows, or melt onto stawberries, blueberries, or in a glass of warm milk.

Black Beans.item_story_marketing:
With a rich and earthy taste and soft yet hearty texture, it’s no wonder the humble Black Bean is a dietary staple in Latin America, the Caribbean, and the American Southwest. Soaking and cooking dry Black Beans is an hours-long process unbefitting busy weeknight cooking, but with Trader Joe’s Black Beans in your pantry, this cost-conscious legume goes from the can to your plate in minutes.

Aside from a just-right amount of salt, our Black Beans are unseasoned, giving you the ideal canvas for quick and satiating Bean-based dishes of both the vegetarian and meat-containing varieties. Simply season and heat as desired, and get to assembling filling—and delicious!—lunches and dinners. 

Season the Beans with our Chile Lime Seasoning Blend and serve with Spanish Style Rice for an extra quick and extra delicious meal. Mix them into a Southwestern-inspired salad with your greens of choice, cooked Roasted Corn, grilled Pollo Asado, Cilantro Salad Dressing, and cotija cheese. Or, season them with Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend and plate with warm Papas Rellenas and Plantain Crisps for Cuban-inspired eats.

Sliced Seedy Multigrain Bread.item_story_marketing:
They say that good things come in threes; Trader Joe’s Seedy Multigrain Loaf proves they also come in sevens! With a kitchen-sink blend of seven seeds and grains, each slice ups the textural ante for toast and sandwiches.

Sunflower kernels and flax & sesame seeds are gently roasted to amplify their nutty flavor before uniting with hulled millet and barley, rye, and oat flakes. The seeds and grains are then sprinkled on wheat flour dough, and the resulting Loaf-to-be undergoes a low and slow fermentation process that transforms it into a chewy, hearty, and texturally intriguing bread befitting the entire toast-to-sandwich spectrum.

Conveniently pre-sliced, Seedy Multigrain Loaf lets you skip the crumby fractions and zero in on culinary calculations. Organic Apricot Preserves + Supreme Brie + Oven Roasted Turkey Breast = sophisticated weekday sandwiches. Mashed avocado + Nori Komi Furikake + jammy egg halves = Japanese-inspired toast. Or, simplify the equation with just a pat of Cultured Salted Butter on a toasted slice or two. The options are infinite!

Brioche Style Liège Waffles.item_story_marketing:
Did you know there is more than one kind of Belgian waffle? Breakfast eaters most often enjoy Brussels-style waffles, which are fairly large and rectangular with light, airy insides, and an exterior crunch—similar to Trader Joe’s Belgian Waffles. But another Belgian waffle has been gaining global fans in recent years, and it hails from the city of Liège. Trader Joe’s Brioche Style Liège Waffles follow in this tradition.

Made for us in Belgium, our Liège Waffle dough not only includes flour, yeast, water, and salt—but also incorporates cultured butter, pearl sugar, and egg. This recipe yields a denser Waffle with buttery, brioche-like flavor. Compared to Brussels-style waffles, these are smaller and roundish, with rustic, uneven edges. And there’s a distinct crunch that comes from the bits of sugar strewn throughout these handheld batter-cakes.

Waffle lovers will be enamored by the fact that Trader Joe’s Brioche Liège Waffles can be enjoyed at room temperature, no toasting required. Enjoy them for an afternoon snack, as many Europeans do. Or grab one on your way out the door in the morning for a quick, satisfying breakfast. Of course, you can still opt to top them with whatever you like. Try serving some Brioche Style Liège Waffles after dinner with a sprinkle of powdered sugar, or a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream. You’ll find Trader Joe’s Brioche Style Liège Waffles on the shelves in our bakery section, every day.

Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies.item_story_marketing:
It’s hard not to feel like a kid again when biting into a crisp chocolate chip cookie. The butteriness of the cookie, the softness of the chocolate, even the sound of the crunch all have a tendency to take one back to a simpler time. Our tasting panel certainly found that to be true of Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Crispy & Crunchy Chocolate Chip Cookies, every bite of which offer all the time-transporting tastes and textures you could want in a classic chocolate cookie—and all without the inclusion of any gluten.

There used to be a time when folks felt the need to qualify gluten-free foods as being “good...for gluten free.” Nowadays, though, gluten free alternatives have made such strides that it practically goes without saying: these Chocolate Chip Cookies aren’t just good for gluten free—they’re good, period! And especially so when packed in school lunches, enjoyed as an afternoon snack, or used to make creamy ice cream sandwiches. We recommend pairing a Cookie or two with a glass of ice-cold milk, or your favorite non-dairy beverage, to truly maximize that like-a-kid-again feeling.

Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle Seasoning B.item_title: Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle Seasoning Blend
Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle Seasoning B.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s beloved, catch-all condiment is now available as an exciting new Seasoning Blend! Made with the same base of spices as appear in our Crunchy Chili Onion (i.e., onion. garlic, dried bell peppers, & chili pepper flakes), plus a bit of brown sugar and dried Szechuan pepper to round it out, Trader Joe’s Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle is just as universally utile as its predecessor. And now, thanks to its Sprinkle-able new form factor, you can take its satisfyingly savory-spicy taste, crispy-crunchy texture, and slightly sweet and Szechuan-tingly sensations to whole new dimensions at the dinner table and beyond!

Give this Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle a generous shake over a plate of French fries, warm from the air fryer, into a bowl of ground beef before forming it into burger patties, or atop a sheet pan of freshly roasted veggies. It adds a delightful depth of flavor to baked tofu, a certain savory mystique to soups of all kinds, and a pleasantly crunchy pop of texture when mixed into popcorn. Whether it’s scrambled eggs at breakfast, a salad dressing at lunch, or a pan-seared steak at dinner, a little Crunchy Chili Onion Sprinkle can make a big difference.

Kumato Brown Tomatoes.item_story_marketing:
Vine-ripened, intensely flavorful, and (did we mention?) fantastically sweet, our Kumatos are ready to enjoy when you get them home, or you can store them at room temperature for several days—unless, of course, your “room” is less than 40º Fahrenheit. We don’t, however, recommend storing these or any other tomatoes in the refrigerator. The cold temperature will result in a loss of the tomato’s natural sugar, which in turn results in a loss of flavor.

Their flavor and idiosyncratic appearance make them ideal for dishes that really star tomatoes. They’re excellent partners to our Fresh Mozzarella Snackers, or you can just drizzle slices with olive oil and a shake of salt—they’re that good.

Yellow Squash.item_story_marketing: “Thin-skinned” isn’t generally seen as a sought-after quality—unless you’re talking about Yellow Squash. This veggie is currently at peak-season perfection, so why not take advantage of its abundance and add it to your shopping list? Its aforementioned thin skin makes Yellow Squash ideal for slicing into ribbons and tossing with lemon juice, halved cherry tomatoes, and a few spoonfuls of TJ’s Basil Pesto Sauce, and its tender flesh holds up nicely when sliced into planks, drizzled with olive oil, and charred on the grill.

Organic Silver Dollar Pancakes.item_story_marketing:
It’s true what the say: breakfast really is the most important meal of the day. But that doesn’t mean it has to be the most labor-intensive. In fact, with Trader Joe’s Organic Silver Dollar Pancakes, the only thing separating you from a stack of scrumptious, home-style, bite-sized Pancakes is a minute or two in the microwave. That means you have all the more time to focus on what might be the most important part of such an important meal: what, exactly, you’ll choose to top them with!

With their subtly savory, from-scratch taste, our Organic Silver Dollar Pancakes are a natural fit with our Organic Vermont Maple Syrup. That’s hardly where we’d stop, however: hot from the microwave, these Organic Pancakes are especially delicious with a pat of melty butter, a cool dollop of whipped cream (or Coconut Whipped Topping, for that matter), or even a scoop of ice cream. And we simply adore them with sliced strawberries, sweet fruit preserves, or a nice spread of Speculoos Cookie Butter.

Tikka Masala Curry Sauce.item_story_marketing:
Rich in flavor, vibrantly hued, luxuriously creamy, and exhilaratingly aromatic, tikka masala is one of those dishes that’s truly capable of captivating all of one’s senses at once—even just the sound of it simmering is enough to pique our appetites. It also happens to be a dish that’s spectacularly suited to vegan variations, like the recipe we use in Trader Joe’s Tikka Masala Curry Sauce. Each batch is made with a savory, velvety base that includes onion, tomato paste, and ground watermelon seeds, and flavored with a selection of seasonings and spices including garlic, turmeric, tamarind, and ginger. Altogether, this Tikka Masala Sauce is great for crafting Curries that will enchant the senses of vegans and non-vegans alike.

Conveniently shelf table (until opened) and endlessly customizable, our Tikka Masala Curry Sauce is a great for everything from quick weeknight dinners to weekly meal prep. Simply choose your veggies (diced potatoes, peas, and cauliflower are always a good start) and a protein (tofu or lentils to keep it plant-based, chicken to keep it classic), sauté them all in a saucepan until cooked through, then add the Sauce and simmer for a few minutes. Once your Curry is ready, you’re free to serve over basmati rice or Organic Riced Cauliflower, and accessorize with sides like Naan and Mini Vegetable Samosas.

Pita Chips.item_story_marketing: From their salty, toasty flavor to their resounding, baked-not-fried crunch, Trader Joe’s Pita Chips are true staples of the snack aisle. With their distinguished dipping power and versatility, they’re practically tailor-made for serving alongside any dip, salsa, or Mediterranean dish you can imagine. They’re just substantial enough to hold the heft of hummus, and just straightforward enough to augment the awesomeness of flavorful fare like TJ’s Almond Chipotle Dip—all while remaining light and crispy enough to support straight-from-the-bag snacking, too! You could even crumble them and use them in place of croutons in a Greek salad. Options, people.

Organic Tuscan Kale.item_story_marketing:
Lacinato kale, also known as Tuscan or Dinosaur Kale, is a member of the same family as cauliflower, broccoli and collard greens. The Lacinato variety has dark blue-green leaves, with an ridged texture (like dinosaur skin!). Like all kales, Trader Joe’s Tuscan Kale is nutrient-dense, packed with vitamin C, calcium, fiber, antioxidants and beta-carotene. 

Trader Joe’s Tuscan Kale is a nutrient-dense, quick-cooking and great-tasting green that is cut, washed and ready to use. It’s a convenient and healthy side dish for a busy weeknight meal. Sauté, boil or braise and then serve as-is, or incorporate into soups, stews, or any recipe that calls for greens. Kale pairs well with a variety of sauces and spices. Toss the Kale with oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper and bake in the oven for some delicious Kale chips that will be the talk of the town!

Sea Salt Chocolate Chunk Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Imagine sinking your teeth into the perfect cookie: first, there’s the initial toothsome resistance of the crisp outer layer, and the sweet aromas of butter and vanilla. Then, that resistance gives way to the soft, chewy interior and full flavors of semisweet chocolate, brown sugar, and sea salt. Imagine the chocolate and soft cookie melting in your mouth, expressing all kinds of sweet and savory flavors as you wash it down with a chilled glass of milk (or non-dairy beverage). Now, what if we told you that this exact experience is readily available at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s? Imagine no more: we present to you The Sea Salt Chocolate Chunk Cookie.

Now made using an updated recipe that results in an even softer, even fresher-feeling texture, each box contains six Sea Salt Chocolate Chunk Cookies that are big in both size and flavor. In fact, they’re just about the perfect size and shape for making delicious cookie ice cream sandwiches, and the bits of coarse, crunchy Sea Salt interact wonderfully with a scoop of French Vanilla Ice Cream. That said, if you’re more in the mood for a simpler, solo Cookie experience, try warming one up in the microwave for a few seconds just prior to enjoying.

Gluten Free Chocolate Chunk Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Imagine sinking your teeth into the perfect chocolate chip cookie. First, there’s the initial resistance of the cookie’s crisp outer layer. Then, just as that resistance gives way to the cookie’s soft, chewy interior, you’re hit with a symphony of buttery, brown-sugary, and, of course, chocolatey flavor. “It’s pitch-perfect!” You exclaim. “We agree,” we respond, “and it’s gluten free.” Shocked, you reach for the box, and there it is, plain as day: Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Chocolate Chunk Cookies with Sea Salt. Well, I’ll be darned...

Now made using an updated recipe that results in an even softer, even fresher-feeling texture, these Gluten Free Chocolate Chunk Cookies are a true achievement in gluten free baking. Each box contains six Cookies made with a blend of oat flour, rice flour, tapioca starch, brown sugar, and plenty of butter. The real scene- stealers, however, are the rich, semi-sweet Chocolate Chunks throughout and the coarse Sea Salt sprinkled on top. Together, they offer up an effortless harmony of sweet and salty—it’s the kind of Cookie confluence that’ll bring you back for another bite. And another. And another—thank goodness we’re selling them six to a box. You’ll find them in our bakery section.

Cinnamon Sugar Cashews.item_story_marketing:
Pumpkin spice aside, there’s hardly a flavor combination more suited to fall than that of cinnamon & brown sugar. The sweetness of the brown sugar deftly complements the warm spice of cinnamon, creating a captivating combination that caused our tasting panel to kick their heels in delight when they tasted—and approved!—our latest seasonal nut offering, Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Sugar Cashews with Honey & Brown Sugar.

To create this simple yet satisfying snack, our Thai supplier takes impressively sized, slightly salty Cashews and gilds them with a sweet glaze imbued with plenty of Cinnamon and Brown Sugar, along with honey to round out the warm, sugary notes. Packed in a totable canister, the sweetly spiced, buttery crunch of these eminently snackable Cashews is enjoyable during all manner of autumnal pursuits, from weekend tailgating and entertaining, to the slightly less exciting (but no less important) weekday work-commuting and homework- helping. Snack on them right out of the canister, or serve alongside wedges of TJ’s Toscano Cheese with Cinnamon and Pumpkin Cranberry Crisps for a seasonally on-theme cheese board.

Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce.item_story_marketing:
When it comes to pasta sauces, we offer more variety than we do in some other food categories. While you may only desire the singular, best Organic Ketchup [sku 55860] to satisfy your ketchup cravings, your cravings for different styles of pasta sauce may fluctuate day to day, meal to meal. With this in mind, we concluded that our assortment of sauces was missing a richer, bolder, tomato-based option. This is where Trader Joe’s Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce comes in!

The name sort of says it all, but let’s break it down a bit... This Red Sauce begins as any homemade tomato sauce might, with diced tomatoes in juice, tomato paste, garlic, diced onion, and oil (we opted for extra virgin olive oil here). The addition of basil, honey, and sun-dried tomatoes work together to develop a more nuanced flavor profile than a standard red sauce. So far, so Bold—where’s the Spicy? The heat comes with a carefully concocted combo of peppers that includes crushed red pepper, ancho chili pepper powder, black pepper, and paprika. Finally, all these ingredients are simmered until reaching a Thick, rich texture.

Trader Joe’s Thick, Bold & Spicy Red Sauce is so good on all kinds of pasta, from Organic Spaghetti to Chickpea Fusilli. Beyond pasta, it also works incredibly well as a tasty dipping sauce for your oven-warmed Ciabatta Baguette, or for TJ’s ready-to-bake Organic Garlic Bread.

Enchilada Sauce.item_story_marketing:
Enchiladas might just be the very definition of comfort food: layers of hearty rolled tortillas, rich, savory, and often meaty fillings, gloriously melty cheese...and, of course, vividly full-flavored sauce to bind it all together. In fact, the sauce might just be the most important element of enchiladas to get right, which is why we proudly carry Trader Joe’s Enchilada Sauce on our shelves. It’s made for us by a trusted supplier, who starts with a base of tomato paste and red jalapeño purée, then seasons it with ground red chiles, onion, garlic, and chipotle pepper powder. What they don’t use are any gums, natural flavors, or artificial preservatives, so that your homemade enchiladas will taste homemade, every time.

Savory, smoky, and ever-so-slightly spicy, our bold and full-flavored Enchilada Sauce won’t just make your enchiladas tastier, they’ll make them a lot easier, too: simply roll corn or flour torillas up with your favorite fillings (we find it’s a little easier if you fry the tortillas in oil for a second or two beforehand), line them up in a baking dish, cover with Enchilada Sauce and your favorite cheese, and bake! And if that wasn’t enough, we also find that it’s quite suited for making Mexican cuisine-inspired casseroles, or even using as a sauce for making chilaquiles, too.

Thai Style Peanut Dressing.item_story_marketing:
When is a salad dressing more than a salad dressing? How about when it’s also a great dip, condiment, marinade, sauce for a uniquely sweet and spicy pizza... All of these would make an entirely apt description for Trader Joe’s Thai Style Peanut Dressing, but, truth be told, “Trader Joe’s Thai Style Peanut Dressing (and Dip, and Condiment, and Marinade, and Pizza Sauce...)” just wouldn’t quite fit on the bottle. It’s made for us using the same recipe as the dressing found in Trader Joe’s Crunchy Slaw, a longtime Crew and customer favorite in our West Coast stores, where its complex mix of sweet, savory, and spicy flavors earned it a spot as a solo act in Trader Joe’s across the country.

Our Thai Style Peanut Dressing is so versatile, that even within just the context of salads, it’s marvelously multifaceted: we recommend it for everything from light, leafy salads to hearty slaws, all the way to creamy pasta and potato salads, too. As for its dip qualifications, give it a spin with spring rolls or savory meat skewers. As a condiment, it’s excellent on burgers and bánh mì-inspired creations. It makes a magnificent marinade for grilled chicken wings or steak, and a super sauce for a Thai-style pizza with chicken breast, cilantro, and sliced green onion.

Gluten Free Baguette.item_story_marketing:
In the world of bread, baguettes are serious business. In fact, the baguette has been deemed such an iconic part of France’s culinary history, that the tradition of baguette-making was recently added to UNESCO’s Intangible Cultural Heritage Lists, placing it in the same global esteem as Flamenco dance, Kabuki theatre, and yoga. With such a significant cultural presence, we thought it would be a shame if folks who don’t eat gluten missed out on all the fun, which is why we’re happy to introduce Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Baguette to our bakery sections.

Made with a mix of tapioca starch and oat flour, as well as a bit of gluten free sourdough starter to give every bite a delightfully tangy, sourdough tinge, Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Baguette strikes an artful balance between artisanal and rustic. We find it’s best when warmed in an oven at 400°F for about ten minutes, after which its crust becomes particularly crisp, and the whole Baguette is ready for any situation that calls for a baguette. It makes an especially hearty sandwich bread (gluten-free bánh mì, anyone?), it makes great crostini when sliced into rounds and toasted, and can even just be torn or sliced into hunks and dipped with your favorite olive oil.

Wheat Crisp Crackers.item_story_marketing:
There’s something sublimely simple about a stately, square, wheat cracker. Slightly sweet and elegantly salty, the humble wheat cracker can be counted on in all kinds of culinary contexts, including (and perhaps especially) enjoying as a standalone snack. It’s been a while since we’ve carried such a cracker on our shelves, and the time felt right to reintroduce one to our snacks section—we just had to be sure that the one we brought in was as satisfyingly crispy as those we’ve enjoyed in the past, while still substantial enough to hold up to heavy-duty cheese slices and hearty dips. After a few rounds through our tasting panel, we knew we had it with Trader Joe’s Wheat Crisp Crackers.

Made for us by a Canadian supplier, who bakes each Cracker to a crispy, crunchy, gloriously golden brown, our Wheat Crisp Crackers make a capital companion to any cheese plate or charcuterie board, where their subtle blend of savory and sweet can complement even the most complex of flavor profiles. They more than hold their own when used to scoop up hummuses and other savory dips, and take particularly well to being topped with fruit spreads, cream cheeses, and combinations thereof, too. And, of course, they’re also great for simply snacking on while catching up on a TV show, or catching up with a friend.

Steamed Vegetable Soup Dumplings.item_story_marketing:
From the moment they were introduced, our Steamed Chicken Soup Dumplings and Steamed Pork & Ginger Soup Dumplings became instant sensations among our customers. Inspired by the winsome dim sum tradition of Chinese xiao long bao, these aromatic and savory, soup-filled dumplings are such a darling, in fact, that we’ve received countless requests to make a vegan version, as well. After trying a few variations, our tasting panel found that a mix of jackfruit, carrot, cabbage, spinach, and ginger for the filling, along with a hearty, aromatic broth (made with vegan-friendly agar-agar, rather than gelatin) made for a truly captivating combination—and thus, Trader Joe’s Steamed Vegetable Soup Dumplings were born!

Just like our Pork and Chicken variations, our Steamed Vegetable Soup Dumplings can be made in a matter of minutes in the microwave or steamer on your stovetop. Also like their predecessors, once heated through, the soup inside of them does become quite hot—we recommend serving them in a deep spoon, carefully puncturing the top of the side of the dumpling with your teeth or some chopsticks, then letting the soup seep into the spoon to cool down until it’s ready to slurp. We also heartily recommend enjoying them with a bit of Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce and Crunchy Chili Onion for an even more satisfying Soup Dumpling experience.

Bubble Waffles.item_story_marketing:
If you’re a fan of bubble tea beverages (a.k.a. boba), then chances are you’ve seen Bubble Waffles sold right along with them. Also known as gai daan zai in Cantonese, they first appeared on the Hong Kong street-food scene way back in the 1950s. Later nicknamed “Bubble Waffles,” at least in part for their uncanny resemblance to actual bubble wrap, they’ve been a standby in cafés, sidewalk stalls, and home kitchens ever since... and now, in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, too! (We can sense your bubbling joy from here!)

Made with coconut milk, wheat flour, cane sugar, rice bran shortening, and vanilla bean paste, our vegan Trader Joe’s Bubble Waffles are fluffy yet chewy, sweet yet savory, and simple yet versatile. Heat them from frozen in your air fryer, toaster oven, or microwave, and their crispy edges and mochi-like middles are ready to be topped with everything from fresh fruit & whipped cream, to Cookie Butter & bananas, to French Vanilla Ice Cream & All Occasion Sprinkle. You can even top them with savory fare, like shredded Le Gruyère Cheese and chopped leeks, or fried eggs and Sriracha Sauce. Really, the sky’s the limit here—don’t let anything burst your Bubbles! Except for you, when you’re eating them, of course.

Dark Chocolate Covered Pistachios.item_story_marketing:
For just a moment, consider the complementary nature of dark chocolate and pistachios with us, won’t you? In terms of flavor, there’s the earthy, delicately sweet notes of a finely roasted pistachio, which plays remarkably well off of the rich, ever-so-slightly bitter elements of dark chocolate. And texture-wise, the tooth-sinking smoothness of dark chocolate superbly rounds out a pistachio’s tender interior after its initial, delicately snappy bite. It’s like they were made for each other—a match made in snacking heaven, if you will. We certainly will, which is precisely why we’ve introduced Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Covered Pistachios to our shelves.

Inside each pouch, our supplier has smothered shelled, dry roasted, and salted California Pistachios in a perfectly proportioned layer of deep Dark Chocolate so that each balanced bite takes your taste buds on a trek across the sweet-salty spectrum. They make an unbeatable anytime snack, can be mixed in to your own custom trail mixes, and are especially adept for adding to charcuterie boards and cheese plates, to provide even more captivating contrast. We also find that they make the ideal palate cleanser for serving in between sips at an at- home wine tasting with friends.

Cheddar Macaroni & Cheese.item_story_marketing:
Our boxed Mac & Cheese is back! While we have numerous heat & eat, cheesy-mac options in our freezers every day, there’s something about boiling fresh pasta and stirring it together with butter, milk, and cheese that really stirs up one’s nostalgia. Trader Joe’s Cheddar Macaroni & Cheese rises to meet all of your childhood memories and more!

Each box contains little tube-shaped Macaroni that you boil in a saucepan to your desired tenderness. We recommend 7-9 minutes. To the drained pasta, add 4 tablespoons of butter (we suggest salted), ¼ cup of milk, and the included cheese packet. The Cheddar Cheese seasoning blend creates a creamy, ultra-cheesy sauce to coat the tubes inside and out. And that classic orange color only comes naturally, from annatto and paprika.

Trader Joe’s Cheddar Macaroni & Cheese is so good, just as it is. But you can also doctor it up, as you please. For an extra rich & tangy sauce, try mixing 1-2 tablespoons of Trader Joe’s Plain Greek Whole Milk Yogurt into the warm, drained pasta, just before adding the Cheese packet. Or add a couple squirts of TJ’s Sriracha Sauce for a little bit of heat. And why not make it a meal by crumbling in some cooked Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties? However you prepare our classic Mac & Cheese, it’s sure to satisfy the kids you know—including the kid in you!

Panzerotti Pizza Bites.item_story_marketing:
What look like mini calzones, taste like cheese pizza, and eat like some of the tastiest hors d’oeuvres around? New Trader Joe’s Panzerotti Pizza Bites, that’s what! Made for us in Southern Italy by a supplier who specializes in this very appetizer, these two-to-three-bite-sized, lightly fried Pizza pockets take the concept of “after-school pizza rolls” and elevates it to flavorful new heights!

Picture this: each Trader Joe’s Panzerotti Pizza Bite begins with a pleasantly chewy, half-moon-shaped pouch of pizza dough, which gets subsequently stuffed with a melty, mozzarella cheese blend and bold Italian tomato sauce, then quick-fried in vegetable oil. Simple? Yes. Simply irresistable? Also yes. Just heat them from frozen (we’re talking 12 minutes in a conventional oven, 8-10 minutes in an air fryer, or 1-2 minutes in a microwave here, folks—minimal effort), and you’ve got one delicious appetizer or snack on your hands... or rather, you’ve got several delicious Panzerotti Pizza Bites in your hands!

Pad See Ew.item_story_marketing:
An indisputable icon of Thai restaurant menus and street food stalls the world over, pad see ew translates to “fried with soy sauce,” and was likely popularized within Thailand by Chinese immigrants in the early 20th century. A bit like a localized, Thai-cuisine-informed variation of chow fun (which was likely a direct inspiration), pad see ew is traditionally made with wide, flat rice noodles, which are fried in a wok with various veggies and garlic before being finished with a splash of light and dark soy sauce to give it a bold, savory, and umami-rich flavor. And that’s the same, time-tested technique that our supplier in Thailand uses when making Trader Joe’s Pad See Ew, a rich, flavorful, and totally vegan version of this classic dish that’s now available in our freezers.

After mere minutes in the microwave, Trader Joe’s Pad See Ew makes an excellent work lunch, dinner entrée, or savory side dish. Every bite expresses a delightful depth of flavor, as well as a remarkable range of textures, from the tender chewiness of the noodles, to the snap of the carrots and Chinese broccoli, to the soft, tooth- sink-ability of the tofu chunks and tofu sheets. We recommend serving it alongside our (also vegan) Thai Green Curry, some fluffy jasmine rice, and a plate of stir-fried Baby Bok Choy.

Pulled Chicken Salsa Verde.item_story_marketing:
In addition to developing foods with high-quality ingredients that are combined using exceptional recipes, we are also keen to develop Trader Joe’s products that are convenient, time-saving meal solutions for our customers. Trader Joe’s Pulled Chicken Salsa Verde is one of those products that checks all the boxes!

Similar to Trader Joe’s Smoked Pulled Chicken, this Pulled Chicken recipe begins with seasoned, boneless, skinless Chicken breast. But here, the meat isn’t smoked. It’s seasoned with salt, white pepper, and garlic & onion powders, then slow-cooked in a Salsa Verde that includes roasted tomatillos, green chiles, cilantro, onion and garlic. The fully cooked meat is then shredded, so its really easy to tuck into tacos, burritos, quesadillas, or to pile on top of chips for nachos. And it’ll save you time on a busy weeknight, since all it takes to prepare is about four minutes in the microwave. Add a couple more minutes to that if you’d prefer to heat it in a saucepan on the stovetop. Either way, you’ll have a terrifically tender & flavorful protein you can use in a wide variety of simple, satisfying ways.

Fresh Mozzarella Cheese Snackers.item_story_marketing:
Maybe you enjoy Trader Joe’s String Cheese, or our Organic Light String Cheese. These individual sticks of milky mozzarella are a great option when you want a little protein boost, or are craving a bit of cheese. Now we’ve added another option to our family of handy cheese snacks: Trader Joe’s Fresh Mozzarella Cheese Snackers.

These bite-size balls of fresh mozzarella are made from milk that’s freshly collected in the Treasure and Magic Valleys of southern Idaho; and it comes from cows that are not treated with rBST hormones. Making the Mozzarella involves microbial enzymes, which should please any cheese-loving vegetarians. The soft, yet reslient texture of the final product—with its creamy, milky flavor—should please anyone who loves good cheese!

Each eight-ounce, resealable package contains eight, smaller, 70-calorie snack pouches that are ideally portioned for whenever that cheese craving creeps up. Enjoy the Fresh Mozzarella by itself and benefit from five grams of protein per pouch. Of course, you can always pair your pouch with other healthy snackables, such as Mini Pearl Grape Tomatoes and Organic Cut and Peeled Carrots!

Double Chocolate Wafer Cookies.item_story_marketing:
Wafer cookie enthusiasts might recall that, for years, we sold a certain branded chocolate wafer cookie in our stores. They were certainly delicious, but at Trader Joe’s, we’re all about kaizen—and we knew there was room for improvement. Now, many months and several versions later, we’re excited to introduce the chocolatey manifestation of our sweetest efforts: Trader Joe’s Double Chocolate Wafer Cookies.

Made for us in Italy, these bite-sized, cubical Cookies contain four layers of a hazelnut-infused, chocolate cream filling sandwiched beteween delicate, crispy, cocoa wafers. They’re certainly simliar to those aforementioned branded chocolate wafers, but they’re even crispier and boast a richer, even more chocolatey flavor. They’re perfect as a small, sweet snack-on-the-go and/or an excellent companion to a cup of coffee or tea. You’ll find 8.8-ounce bags of Trader Joe’s Double Chocolate Wafer Cookies in our cookies & candy section.

Mango Cream Bars.item_story_marketing:
Flavor-wise, Trader Joe's Mango Cream Bars are a combination of creamy vanilla and sweet-tart mango.  Rather than the flavors existing side-by-side, the creamy vanilla ice cream is entirely surrounded by sweet, fruity mango sorbet. It’s the same format as our Tangerine Cream Bars, only with Mango. 

You might also find that Trader Joe’s Mango Cream Bars are a bit richer overall. That’s because the first ingredient is vanilla ice cream (it was water in the original version). Plus, the fruity part is made with purée of both Magdalena and Alphonso mango varieties, delivering a tart & sweet, totally tropical taste!

Sweet Chili Mango Complete Salad Kit.item_title: Sweet Chili Mango Complete Salad Kit
Sweet Chili Mango Complete Salad Kit.item_story_marketing:
Combining the congenial crunch of cruciferous veggies like cabbage, kale, Brussels sprouts, and radicchio, with zesty, mango-forward flavors inspired by Thai cuisine, Trader Joe’s Sweet Chili Mango Salad Kit gives you everything you need to serve a super tasty salad for your next meal—besides, we suppose, a salad bowl and some tongs. Inside each all-in-one Kit, you’ll find the aforementioned blend of crisp, shredded veggies, crunchy roasted sunflower seeds, toasted quinoa, dried bits of mango, and a Thai-style sweet and spicy vinaigrette. With just a quick toss of these ingredients, you’ll instantly have a Salad with tangy, tropical flavors and layers of complementary textures in every bite.

Equally excellent as a side as it is a main (particularly when topped with your favorite protein), we find that this vegan Salad Kit’s constituent Sweet Chili Mango flavors are especially suited for serving alongside fare like spring rolls, stir-fries, and aromatic curries. That said, we also find that its spicy and fruity aspects make it an apt choice for incorporating into seafood tacos, a base for a Tempeh bowl, or using as a topping on a Turkey Burger.

Spaghetti Squash.item_story_marketing:
It would be really romantic to say that Spaghetti Squash was cultivated in late Renaissance Italy, when Reubenesque human figures dominated frescoes, making for overly self-conscious citizens, who subsequently sought out low calorie, low carb versions of spaghetti noodles. In actuality, this Squash sometimes cleverly known as “squaghetti,” was simply named for its cooked texture, which resembles long, thin noodles.

Whether you motivation is ample nude figures in Flemish Renaissance paintings, or just the inability to fit into the jeans you wore last fall, Spaghetti Squash does provide a healthy and yummy, seasonal alternative to the typical plate of carbs.

To create a spaghetti substitute plate, simply cook your Squash until tender. Microwaving for 5-10 minutes works just fine, but you can also bake it in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes, or until soft. After it cools a little, carefully cut the softened Spaghetti Squash in half lengthwise, remove the seeds, and use a fork to loosen the spaghetti-like fibers that have emerged during cooking. Next, lightly sauté the “squaghetti” with a little oil in a pan on the stovetop. This will allow some of the excess moisture to steam off. Finally, put it in a bowl and top with your favorite pasta sauce!

As we enter the season of holiday feasts, here’s a meal that is not only delicious, but that can also serve to balance out all those extra helpings of potatoes and stuffing that you know you’re going to have.

Sugar Bee® Apple.item_story_marketing: In the early 1990s, an orchardist discovered a new kind of apple growing in his Minnesota Honeycrisp orchard. With a little detective work, he determined that local bees had taken the pollen from an unknown tree nearby and cross-pollenated it with Honeycrisp blossoms. The SugarBee® was born! Fast-forward to present day, and you, dear customers, can enjoy the crisp, firm texture and crunchy bite of SugarBees®. Their flavor hints at caramel and molasses, with distinct notes of honey—a fitting homage to their raison d’etre (reason for bee-ing, if you will). Snack on slices alongside a bowl of our Maple Spiced Nut Mix for an authentically autumnal treat. Or peel and slice these bee-uties to tuck into your seasonal pies, tarts, and turnovers. Yum!

Savory Squash Pastry Bites.item_story_marketing:
Entertaining guests? How about just wondering what’s for dinner? Our newest frozen appetizer answers both questions with fanciful fall flair. Introducing Trader Joe’s Savory Squash Pastry Bites!

First things first—unwrap the Pastry Bites and place them on a baking sheet. After about 12 minutes in a 400°F oven (or half that time in an air fryer), you’ll be rewarded with a buttery Pastry crust teeming with a pumpkin & butternut Squash-forward filling, along with a Savory symphony of flavors courtesy of not one, but four different cheeses—namely, creamy mascarpone and ricotta, tangy feta, and pleasantly sharp Parmesan. Finished with chopped chives, these Pastry Bites lend an air of elegance to an appetizer platter or buffet spread for a harvest fête (don’t forget the bubbly!), and are equally at home on a weeknight dinner plate alongside a crisp green salad topped with crumbled White Stilton® Cheese with Apple & Pear.

While these Savory Squash Pastry Bites may look upscale, their price is, happily, not! You’ll find them in the freezers at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, for a limited time.

Sweet Potato Habanero Hot Sauce.item_story_marketing:
In the collective imagination, autumn flavors aren’t typically associated with a whole lot of heat, per se—and if you ask us, that’s a shame. As we approach the autumn months, and temperatures begin to lower, it’s the perfect time for hearty chilis, capsaicin-loaded curries, super-spicy soups, and red-hot roasted veggies and proteins of all kinds. In support of this autumnal argument, we submit Trader Joe’s Sweet Potato Habanero Hot Sauce. Made for us by a famed hot sauce supplier out of Atlanta, Georgia, each batch is made from a base of vinegar, sweet potatoes, and habanero peppers, as well as a mix of autumnally-appropriate spices like cinnamon, ginger, allspice, and cloves.

This marriage of peppery heat and fall flavors results in a one-of-a-kind Hot Sauce that’s as versatile as it is unique. Aside from its use in the afore-mentioned hearty soups and roasts that autumn is known for, it also goes great with everyday fare like pizza, chicken wings, tacos, and all sorts of savory breakfast options. And for a fiery, dip that makes a great late summer or early autumn appetizer, simply mix a teaspoon or two with Greek Yogurt and enjoy with French fries or Tots.

Pizza Sauce.item_story_marketing:
At Trader Joe’s, a product doesn’t pass muster just once—it must do so again and again, long after it launches, to ensure our customers are as excited about it as our tasting panel was when it was first presented. Recently, our buyer applied this standard for satisfaction and deliciousness to our preexisting pizza sauce, and knew we could do better. And after a few rounds of tasting and tweaking an array of sauce options, we did—allow us to (re)introduce Trader Joe’s Pizza Sauce!

With a bright tomato flavor and more subtly seasoned profile than its predecessor, this Pizza Sauce provides a savory base layer that complements pizza toppings without overpowering them, and makes for a mighty tasty Breaded Mozzarella Cheese Sticks dip, too. An added bonus: it’s packed into shelf-stable jars, so you can always have a jar of Pizza Sauce at the ready when the craving strikes.

In addition to our tasting panel standards for satisfaction and delicious, this kosher-certified Sauce passes muster when it comes to value, too. If “pizza party” is in your day planner, pop on over to your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, where you’ll find jars of Pizza Sauce on our grocery shelves for an incredible price, every day.

Gluten Free Cheese Pizza.item_story_marketing:
Trader Joe’s sells Gluten Free Pizza Dough if you’re in the mood to make a pie from scratch. But if you’re looking for a ready-to-bake, gluten free solution, look no further than Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Cheese Pizza with a Cauliflower Crust.

You’ve seen this kind of pie before, even in our freezers, so we can’t exactly claim it’s revolutionary. We can say that the delicious Gluten Free crust (first ingredient: Cauliflower) develops a nice crispness in just 10-12 minutes in the oven. It handily delivers our tangy tomato sauce, and melty mozzarella & provolone cheeses right to your mouth.

Perhaps what’s most impressive about this Gluten Free Cheese Pizza is the possibilities. While we’ve engineered this pie to be enjoyable just as it is, it’s also a blank canvas for your own pizza creativity. And with a Trader Joe’s store full of toppings, it’s safe to say, the possibilities are endless!

Crispy Battered Calamari.item_story_marketing:
There’s nothing like hitting the bar at happy hour and enjoying some fried appetizers and discounted drinks with friends, although... hitting the home “bar” with some appetizers from TJ’s has its perks. Besides not needing to leave your house, and saving money on tips, you also get the opportunity to enjoy tasty appetizers from our freezers, like Trader Joe’s Crispy Battered Calamari.

We worked with seafood specialists in Italy to develop our own version of the classic Italian Anelli alla Romana (“Roman Rings”). Our Calamari is made with squid rings and tentacles that are lightly battered with a combination of wheat flour, rice semolina, and baking soda. This helps develop a Crispy crunch during cooking in your conventional oven or air fryer. And they’re seasoned with salt, black pepper, garlic, onion, and chili pepper; just the right amount of flavor to enjoy as-is, or with a simple squeeze of fresh lemon juice. 

Of course, dipping these Crispy Battered squid into your favorite TJ’s sauce (we have so many!) adds yet another layer of deliciousness. You’ll find 16-ounce packages of Trader Joe’s Crispy Battered Calamari every day in our freezers. Keep some in your freezer, for the next time you and your friends decide to have a happy hour at home.

Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey P.item_title: Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties
Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey P.item_story_marketing:
When you read the words “juicy burger,” turkey is not likely the first meat that comes to mind—but what if it was? Our product developer set out to answer this very question while working to create summertime stars for grilling season (May to September, to be precise), and much to our tasting panel’s delight, he emerged victorious from the test kitchen with Trader Joe’s Caramelized Onion & Bell Pepper Turkey Patties.

Made with 100% thigh meat, these grill-ready Turkey Patties are unbelievably—dare we say impossibly—juicy. The Caramelized Onion brings plenty of umami to the table, while the vegetal sweetness of the Bell Pepper deftly complements the savory Turkey in each tender bite. Thanks to their fuss-free prep and quick-cooking nature, you’ll have more time to ponder your preferred burger accoutrements (Brioche Bun? Sliced Swiss Cheese? Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce? Yes, yes, and oh, yes!), as well as more time to bask in the glow of a relaxing summer’s evening. For a limited time, you’ll find this incredibly priced, grilling season must-have in the refrigerators at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s.

Norwegian Sourdough Rye Chips.item_story_marketing:
In Scandinavia, rye has been a staple since at least the Middle Ages. But why rye? The key to rye’s rise lies in this grassy crop’s ability to flourish in a colder climate. It also had to do with rye’s dense, earthy, and pleasantly sour character when milled and used in baked goods. Trader Joe’s Norwegian Sourdough Rye Chips capitalize on rye’s goodness by delivering this dark, delicious grain in a crisp, seedy cracker.
 
A bakery in Norway makes our Sourdough Rye Chips. First, they bake bread from a wheat and rye sourdough that includes whole-grain rye berries, sunflower seeds, and flax seeds. The bread is thinly sliced, fried in sunflower oil, and finished with a touch of salt. Each curved, irregularly shaped Chip has a super crunch that leads to nutty notes and rich rye flavor.
 
We enjoy Trader Joe’s Norwegian Sourdough Rye Chips as a snack right out of the bag, but you can also use them to add crunch to your salad. And they’re strong enough for dipping into something savory, such as Chunky Artichoke Jalapeño Dip. For a more substantial snack, pair them with Oak Smoked Salmon Pieces and thin slices of Denmark Havarti.

Little Leaf Farms Baby Crispy Green Leaf.item_title: Little Leaf Farms Baby Crispy Green Leaf
Little Leaf Farms Baby Crispy Green Leaf.item_story_marketing:
Since their founding in 2015, the folks at Little Leaf Farms® have been dedicated to the ideal of local, sustainable, and—most of all—delicious produce. From their greenhouse facilities in Massachusetts and Pennsylvania, they use recycled, UV-sanitized rainwater to cut their groundwater use by 90%, and recycled PET plastic for their packaging. They also proudly employ pesticide-free, herbicide-free, and even hands-free growing practices, so that when you open up a package of their Baby Crispy Green Leaf Lettuce, it’s totally ready to eat—no washing required.

Now available in our East Coast stores, Little Leaf Farms® Baby Crispy Green Leaf Lettuce is just as tender and texturally satisfying as its name implies. Mild and delicately sweet, with a faint peppery note on the finish, these Leaves make an excellent (not to mention effortless) salad when tossed any of our dressings, like our Vegan Creamy Dill, Organic Italian, or French Vinaigrette with Shallots. We also find that their crisp, refreshing texture make them an able inclusion for all kinds of sandwiches, burgers, and wraps.

Avocado Oil.item_story_marketing:
It should come as no surprise that, here at Trader Joe’s, we’re avid advocates of avocado. And that’s true in all of avocados’ formidable forms, whether it’s mashed up in a flavorful guacamole, sliced up and adding crucial texture to a sandwich, or pressed into a lush, velvety Avocado Oil.

Indeed, Trader Joe’s Avocado Oil carries the flavor and character of avocado. It’s a luxuriously smooth, velvety Oil is made from avocados grown Mexico, which offers an ideal avo-growing climate. This delicate, buttery oil is naturally high in monounsaturated fats (10 grams per serving), and with a roughly 500oF smoke point, it makes an excellent cooking oil. (For reference, olive oil has a smoke point closer to 350oF). Its clean, delicate flavor is a great match for all kinds of applications, from sautéing to baking to searing to garnishing.

Avocado Oil is an excellent addition to your pantry and a good alternative to olive or other vegetable oils.

String Cheese.item_story_marketing:
It’s no secret that kids love Trader Joe’s String Cheese. It may surprise you that adults are as smitten with this stringable snack as their progeny. Once you know Trader Joe’s String Cheese comes to us from a fourth generation, family-owned, Wisconsin cheese company, the love really starts to come into focus. And when you discover that the entire cheese making process – from fresh-from-the-farm milk (from cows raised without the use of rBST) to packed-and-ready-to-ship cheese – takes only about three hours, you will be so filled with love that you’re sure to find yourself with a craving for this mild, mozzarella-style cheese that’s portable and pulls apart with such ease.

We think String Cheese is an excellent snack for anyone, really, whether you’re a kid or just a kid at heart – for a mid-morning pick-me-up, a boost before a workout or anytime at all.

Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain.item_title: Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain Bar
Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain.item_story_marketing:
Take a moment to consider the cereal bar with us, won’t you? Dependably delicious, and always there for you when you need a little pick-me-up, a good cereal bar can make the difference between a clear mind and a haze of hangriness. That’s one reason why we’re proud to add Trader Joe’s Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain Bars to our already-estimable selection of cereal bars. Another reason? Each Bar combines the power of hearty oats, sweet fig paste, and rich chocolate chips to create a superlatively satisfying snacking experience.

Delightfully dense, with a nice pop of chocolate in every bite, our gluten free and kosher Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain Bars are ideal for enjoying on road trips, toting along on hikes, or packing in your gym bag for a little post-workout boost to your day. We also find that they’re phenomenally kid-friendly, excellent for bringing in backpacks as a pre-lunch snack, a post-lunch dessert, or an afterschool sweet treat. Whatever your situation, however your day is going, a Trader Joe’s Organic Chocolate Chip Baked Whole Grain Bar is certain to improve upon it—just as a good cereal bar ought to.

Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain B.item_title: Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain Bar
Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain B.item_story_marketing:
Take a moment to consider the cereal bar with us, won’t you? Dependably delicious, and always there for you when you need a little pick-me-up, a good cereal bar can make the difference between a clear mind and a haze of hangriness. That’s one reason why we’re proud to add Trader Joe’s Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain Bars to our already-estimable selection of cereal bars. Another reason? Each Bar combines the power of hearty oats, sweet fig paste, and aromatic baking spice to create a superlatively satisfying snacking experience.

Delightfully dense, with a nice element of vanilla-tinged sweetness in every bite, our gluten free and kosher Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain Bars are ideal for enjoying as a quick morning munch while commuting, or packing in your gym bag to bring a little post-workout boost to your day. Whatever your situation, however your day is going, a Trader Joe’s Organic Iced Oatmeal Baked Whole Grain Bar is certain improve upon it—just as a good cereal bar ought to.

Mini Shrimp Bao.item_story_marketing:
Of all the various carbs and starches that the world’s cuisines have produced, we have to admit that we have a true soft spot for the bao bun—and for its soft and pillowy texture, in particular. That, combined with its mild, delicately savory, and just a touch sweet flavor, makes the bao bun an especially compelling conveyance for hearty proteins and aromatic sauces, as Trader Joe’s Mini Shrimp Bao rather deliciously demonstrate. Made for us by an expert supplier in Vietnam, each box contains eight miniature, clamshell-style Bao laden with a well-seasoned shrimp patty, as well as a sweet and sticky lemongrass, lime, and chili sauce for dipping.

Excellent as an appetizer, hors d’oeuvre, or side dish, Trader Joe’s Mini Shrimp Bao offer a marvelous medley of complementary flavors and textures in every bite. Individually, each Bao takes less than a minute to microwave, and when prepped together, only a few minutes in the steamer before they’re tender, tasty, and ready to serve. They can be enjoyed as they are, right out of the box, or, if you prefer, dressed to your liking; we’re partial to garnishing each Bao with quick-pickled cucumber ribbons, shredded carrots, and freshly torn cilantro leaves.

Slow Roasted Tomatoes.item_story_marketing:
While there’s nothing like biting into a fresh, homegrown tomato at the height of the season, the height of the season comes but once a year. Thankfully, there’s no need to settle for subpar when seeking sun-soaked tomato flavor—simply reach for a jar of Trader Joe’s Slow Roasted Tomatoes.

These Tomatoes come to us from a fourth-generation tomato processor in Turkey. (Fun fact: Turkey is the third- largest tomato-producing country in the world!). They bring firm, vibrantly colored, field-grown tomatoes into their solar-powered facility, where they Slow Roast them for eight hours. This process intensifies their inherently bright and tangy flavors and yields a tender, soft-dried texture that falls somewhere between a fresh Roma and a classic sun-dried tomato. Marinated in a combination of sunflower and extra virgin olive oils with a touch of garlic and oregano, the scarlet Slow Roasted Tomatoes boast an irresistible, umami-infused quality and sun-soaked tomato flavor that rival their fresh counterparts.

Ideal for topping salads and sandwiches or serving on a cheese board with TJ’s Chevre, you might even stir a few Slow Roasted Tomatoes into a bowl of Cottage Cheese with freshly ground black pepper for a quick snack.

Ciabatta Baguette.item_story_marketing:
Ciabatta and baguette? Before now, you might have thought that ciabatta is ciabatta and a baguette is a baguette. But why can’t we have the best of both worlds? What if ciabatta was a baguette? And this baguette had all the enchanting qualities of ciabatta? Cue Trader Joe’s Ciabatta Baguette, the best of both bread worlds.

The loaf is in the shape of a baguette (meaning “wand” in Italian), but the bread itself is ciabatta bread. Ciabatta dough contains a higher moisture content than traditional baguette dough—over 70% in this case—giving it a thin, slightly caramelized crust and a light crumb with large holes. Better yet, it’s made with just a few in- gredients: unbleached wheat flour, water, sea salt, yeast, and malted barley. Though our supplier makes large quantities of bread, they are still able to achieve the sought-after artisanal taste and texture. And, really, what’s more artisan than the uniting of two esteemed artisan breads?

Slice as you would a baguette and dip to your heart’s content, preferably in Sicilian Selezione Extra Virgin Olive Oil and Balsamic Vinegar of Modena. It also makes an excellent panini. Or, go the traditional route: use it to soak up extra sauce from a heaping bowl of spaghetti—ciabatta is famous for its ability to be dipped without falling apart. For a bit more crunch, place the bread in a 400˚F oven for a few minutes.

Ciabatta Demi-Baguette.item_story_marketing:

And this baguette had all the enchanting qualities of ciabatta? Cue Trader Joe’s Ciabatta Demi-Baguette, the best of both bread worlds.
